articleTitle: Path planning of robot based on artificial potential field method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The development of robot technology is faster and faster with the continuous advancement of artificial intelligent technology, which plays a vital role in human lifestyle and social progress. This paper focuses on the application of the artificial potential field method in the case of static obstacles with unknown environmental information. The traditional artificial potential field method has the problem of local minimum. In order to solve this problem, the gravitational function and repulsive function in the traditional artificial potential field method are modified, and the concepts of safe distance and time distance detection method are added. It is proved by MATLAB simulation that in some cases, the modified artificial potential field method can bypass the local Minima and reach the destination smoothly.

articleTitle: Patient-Specific Seizure prediction from Scalp EEG Using Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Epilepsy is a chronic disorder of the central nervous system. Accurate prediction of seizures using the patient's scalp EEG signal is of great importance in clinical practice. This paper proposed a personalized seizure prediction model based on Vision Transformer. First, the raw EEG signal of each patient EEG for CHB-MIT was filtered and the preictal and interictal periods were extracted for labelling. Then, the processed EEG signal was transformed into a two-dimensional spectrograms by means of the short-time Fourier transform(STFT). Finally, the processed two-dimensional spectrograms are fed into the Vision Transformer model to complete the feature extraction and classification prediction of specific epileptic EEG signals. The results showed that epilepsy prediction using Vision Transformer was best the chb21 patient (94.6% accuracy, 98.6% Recall, 89.8% Specificity, 90.5% Precision and an AUC value of 0.989).

articleTitle: IMG-CenterNet: An optimized algorithm based on CenterNet for pedestrian detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of deep learning in the field of target detection, there are more and more types of algorithms with higher accuracy. Different from the traditional anchor_based algorithm, CenterNet proposed in recent years is an anchor_based algorithm which has the advantages of high accuracy, simple network and fast detection speed. Although CenterNet is already light and its accuracy can be maintained at a relatively high degree, there is still a space for further improvement. In order to get a better detection effect, IBN_Net normalization method and group convolution are introduced into the residual module of CenterNet to improve the accuracy of network detection and reduce parameters. In addition, Mosaic data enhancement method is also used to optimize the training mode of the algorithm to enrich the detection background and optimize the detection performance. Compared with the original network, the MAP has been improved by nearly 3% and the number of parameters is also 30% lower.

articleTitle: TS-YOLO:An efficient YOLO Network for Multi-scale Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the problem that the You Only Look Once(YOLO) v4 still has missing detection in multi-scale object detection, we proposed a novel deep convolutional network structure TS-YOLO with three spatial pyramid pooling(SPP) modules in YOLOv4. SPP plays an important role in multi-scale object detection, it can extract more semantic information in complex scenes. In this paper, we add two more SPP modules and redesign the pooling core sizes in SPP on the basis of YOLOv4. Our training was on the Pascal VOC data set and the experimental results show that our TS-YOLO not only detects more objects but also has 2.21% higher accuracy compared with original YOLOv4, demonstrating the excellent performance of our model in multi-scale object detection.

articleTitle: Computing Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing Networks: Full or Partial Offloading?
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the surge of vehicular users and the development of mobile applications, the management of big data has become a challenge for the Internet of Vehicle (IoV). Fortunately, mobile edge computing (MEC) bringing the cloud computing and storage resources to the edge of mobile access network is a potential solution, which is capable of effectively reducing task response time and alleviating the pressure of the backhaul network. This paper proposes a joint computing offloading and transmit power allocation scheme for vehicular edge computing networks. Specifically, the vehicle with limited computing capacity and battery lifetime offloads part of computing tasks to MEC server deployed the roadside unit for processing. The offloading data size and the transmit power are jointly optimized to minimize the energy consumption of the vehicle, under the constraint of task response time. Through the analysis of the relationship between the energy consumption and latency of completing the task, we obtained the channel gain threshold for vehicle performing full offloading or partial offloading. Moreover, for the partial offloading, the optimal offloading data size and transmit power and obtained with the convex optimization method. The superiority of the proposed offloading strategy is verified by numerical results, and the effects of some important parameters on the performance of our strategy are also illustrated.

articleTitle: Research on iOS Remote Security Access Technology Based on Zero Trust
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Under the situation of regular epidemic prevention and control, teleworking has gradually become a normal working mode. With the development of modern information technologies such as big data, cloud computing and mobile Internet, it's become a problem that how to build an effective security defense system to ensure the information security of teleworking in complex network environment while ensuring the availability, collaboration and efficiency of teleworking. One of the solutions is Zero Trust Network(ZTN), most enterprise infrastructures will operate in a hybrid zero trust/perimeter-based mode while continuing to invest in IT modernization initiatives and improve organization business processes. In this paper, we have systematically studied the zero trust principles, the logical components of zero trust architecture and the key technology of zero trust network. Based on the abstract model of zero trust architecture and information security technologies, a prototype has been realized which suitable for iOS terminals to access enterprise resources safely in teleworking mode.

articleTitle: Improved A-star Algorithm based on Topological Maps for Indoor Mobile Robot Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low planning efficiency of traditional A-star algorithm in large indoor scenes, this paper proposes to improve the A-star algorithm based on the use of topological maps to improve the efficiency of A-star path planning in large scenes. First, use 2D lidar to construct a grid map to obtain high-precision environmental information. Secondly, the depth camera is used to capture indoor objects and construct a topological map. Finally, the connectivity of nodes in the topological map is used to improve the path planning problem of the A-star algorithm in large scenarios. Experiments show that the improved algorithm can quickly plan a path in large scenarios. Compared with the original A-star algorithm, this algorithm shortens the time cost and reduces the amount of calculation. Improve the planning efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Infrastructure Monitoring Platform of Intelligent High Speed Railway
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the improvement of technology and business management ability, especially the need of data governance, railway stakeholders have higher expectations and requirements for the level of railway infrastructure informatization. In order to support the development of railway infrastructure information, the monitoring platform will provide services for all the proposed projects, under construction projects, operation and maintenance projects of China Railway, which promotes the informationized and standardized management of infrastructure in the whole life cycle of railway construction, operation and maintenance. Monitoring platform adopts digital twin technology, integrates BIM+GIS model management, accesses to real-time Internet of things sensor data, establishes railway construction, operation and maintenance integrated monitoring big data center, realizes real-time monitoring of high-speed railway infrastructure. Through the virtual and reality mapping and interactive integration of all elements, all data, all models and all spaces, which realized the great transformation of high-speed railway management and operation from phenomenon driven to data driven, breaking through the key technologies of intelligent prediction and early warning of high-speed railway infrastructure, so as to better improve the service level and management efficiency of high-speed railway.

articleTitle: Straight lane line detection based on the Otsu-Canny algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Lane line detection plays a guiding role in the safe driving of vehicles. A lane line detection algorithm is designed to improve the accuracy of the lane line detection system: First of all, precondition the road image. The preprocessing consists of the following algorithms: image grayscale processing, histogram equalization, median filtering, and Canny edge detection. Secondly, extract the region of interest (ROI) of the picture. Finally, realize the fitting of lane line through Hough transform. In this paper, use the Otsu algorithm to realize the threshold adaptation of the Canny algorithm. Then the lane line recognition is completed by Canny edge extraction and Hough transform.

articleTitle: Research on edge detection algorithm of work piece defect in machine vision detection system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Surface defect detection based on machine vision is widely used in product quality detection in manufacturing industry. To improve the accuracy and efficiency of surface defect detection, an improved defect edge detection algorithm is proposed based on the study of Sobel operator. Firstly, the defect image is collected by the detection platform. Then, the defect image is processed by the median filter to eliminate some small noise and interference. Finally, the improved Sobel operator is used to calculate the gradients in eight directions, then the gradients of each pixel are calculated to obtain the gradient image, and the iterative threshold method is used to segment the gradient image, to extract the defect edge. Experimental results show that the improved Sobel algorithm can improve the shortcomings of easy edge loss, poor noise suppression ability, and insensitivity to edges in other directions, and has good edge continuity, good edge positioning ability, and unilateral performance, which improves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research On Object Detection Method In Driving Scenario Based On Improved YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The detection of vehicles and pedestrians is driving ahead has been a hot topic in the field of computer vision research. Although the current field of object detection developed rapidly, there are still problems such as the limited effect and slow detection speed of small object detection. Based on YOLO v4, this study proposed an algorithm that takes into account both detection speed and detection accuracy. First, MobileNet v1 was applied to improve the slow detection speed and reconstruct the original feature extraction network. Secondly, the deleted original 13 x13 prediction head and the added <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$104\times 104$</tex> prediction head were applied to resolve the general detection effect of small targets. Finally, the K-means algorithm was applied to cluster analysis data set and generate the initial anchor box of the network. The improved algorithm results showed that the average accuracy (mAP) reached 90.32%, and detection speed can reach 35FPS. The mAP was reduced by 2.66% compared with the YOLO v4 algorithm, but the model size was only 23.70% of the original one, and the detection speed was 1.66 times that of YOLO v4. Therefore, the improved algorithm is a reliable algorithm that can be applied to target detection in driving scenarios.

articleTitle: AM-YOLO: Improved YOLOV4 based on attention mechanism and multi-feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the problem that target detection models such as FASTER RCNN, YOLO and SSD focus too much on the depth of the network and neglect to make full use of the deep semantic feature information of the image, this paper proposes a new network: AM-YOLO. The network makes full use of contextual relationship between shallow and deep layers to achieve multi-feature fusion of the target. In AM-YOLO, SE blocks are firstly added in the backbone network to differentiate the channel importance of feature maps. Then a new path aggregation network is proposed to achieve the full fusion of shallow and deep features. This paper uses YOLOV4 as the baseline, PASCAL VOC07+12 for dataset and the experimental results show that on the 3060 GPU, the map of AM-YOLO is improved by 2.86% compared with YOLOV4 model, which validates the comprehensive performance of AM-YOLO.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Vehicle Formation Control Based on MPC and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The formation control problem of intelligent driving vehicles originates from the research on task planning and cooperation of multi-agent system, which is mainly aimed at how multi-intelligent driving vehicles cooperate to complete multi-task team driving behaviors such as formation preparation, formation maintenance, formation change and obstacle avoidance in traffic environment. From the control point of view, The vehicle queue is controlled by a plurality of single vehicle nodes, and individual vehicles are controlled through information interaction among the nodes, and then coupled with each other to form a dynamic system, so that the vehicle queue forms a multi-agent system, which is modeled and analyzed to realize an adaptive formation control model based on MPC and particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, Collaborative control of intelligent vehicle formation is simulated to achieve coordinated control of vehicle queue based on multi-agent system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of 5G Virtual Private Network for Electric Power Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the construction of Energy Internet, 5G power virtual private network will play an important role in it. This paper first analyzes the adaptability of power business and 5G technology. Then, a networking architecture of 5G power virtual private network is proposed, including the 5G network slice planning, wireless network structure, bearer network structure, core network structure, etc. At last, in order to verify the network performance, two typical electric power businesses are piloted. The results show that, 5G power virtual private network can meet the communication requirements of electric power business.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem that in path planning research, the traditional ant colony algorithm suffers from slow convergence and is easily trapped in local optimal solutions. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm that can find the optimal path with fewer iterations. The pheromone initial distribution strategy based on the idea of quadrant discrimination is proposed to make the pheromone differentially distributed, thus improving the orientation of the pheromone at the early stage of the algorithm search. The heuristic function is improved by introducing the distance between the next node to the target node and the number of grids that the path passes through to increase the influence of local paths. The pheromone concentration adaptive update strategy is proposed, and the dynamic pheromone volatility factor is introduced to make the pheromone concentration vary in a controlled range. Experiments demonstrate that, under the same environment, the improved algorithm in this paper reduces the path length by 11.80% and 7.15%, and the number of convergence iterations by 55.86% and 38.82%, respectively, compared with the traditional ant colony algorithm and the algorithm in literature [6]. The improved algorithm is significantly better than the other two algorithms in terms of convergence speed and path length, which effectively shortens the optimal path length and the number of iterations of the robot, and has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Control of Wind Turbines with Practical Prescribed Time Stability Based on Wind Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To increase annual production capacity and ensure operational reliability for wind turbines (WT), maximum power point tracking (MPPT) always needs to be realized by tracking the optimal tip speed ratio (TSR), which depends on the accurate measurement of wind speed. However, it is difficult to obtain precise measured values. In addition, due to uncertain parameters and external interference, the maximum power point cannot be tracked quickly and accurately, resulting in the decline in annual power generation. In this paper, a RBFNN is used firstly to estimate the wind speed, which avoid using costly anemometers. Then a MPPT control scheme based on the practical prescribed time method is proposed. It is proven that the tracking error is always within the given boundary range. Moreover, both the settling time and the tracking precision can be preset in advance by designer. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-mode Control System and Autonomous Cruise Method for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The surface garbage cleaning of urban river is a new scenario for the application of USV, but the fault-tolerance of the USV control system designed by using an operating system and a communication link is insufficient. At the same time, the incomplete isolation between remote control and computer control methods has also led to frequent accidents during the operation of USV. What's more, the existing cruise mode of USV cannot effectively clean up the rubbish on the shore. In response to these problems, we first designed a set of control systems with dual operating systems and dual communication links using the idea of redundancy, and used relays to realize the isolation of multi-mode control methods. Then we carried out the motion modeling of the developed USV, and verified the match between the experimental ship and the model through the rotation experiment. Finally, we proposed an autonomous cruise method of USV to realize the autonomous cleaning of the whole water area.

articleTitle: An Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on A Star and Velocity-Obstacle Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of autonomous navigation of unmanned surface vehicle, it is necessary to avoid static/dynamic obstacles. Therefore, a combined obstacle avoidance algorithm for the unmanned surface vehicle based on path planning and velocity obstacle algorithm is designed in the paper. A priori sea chart and perceived static obstacles are used to obtain a sea static situation map, then we complete static obstacle avoidance through A* path planning algorithm. Using the real-time sensing of dynamic obstacles, the dynamic obstacle avoidance is completed through VO algorithm (Velocity-Obstacle). Finally, efficiency of the avoidance algorithm is proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Emotional Analysis Platform of College Students' Public Opinion Information Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Starting from the current emotional analysis of college students' public opinion information by using big data at home and abroad, this paper introduces the theoretical basis of emotional analysis model of college students in detail. On the basis of this theory, the emotional analysis model of college students is established, and the experimental design of emotional analysis platform is conducted with this model. The research results can provide reference for grading monitoring and crisis warning of public opinion information in big data network, and at the same time give more accurate decision support for schools and society.

articleTitle: Lasso Regression Based on t-Distribution Coot Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Lasso regression is a supervised linear regression method in the field of artificial intelligence (AI). Generally speaking, its idea is adding an L1 regularization term to a linear regression to achieve two purposes: the first purpose is to overcome the original linear regression collinearity or the irreversibility of the matrix in the solution; the second purpose is to obtain the sparse solution, which will be more efficient in computer operation. Usually, Lasso regression is a least squares normal form plus an L1 regularization term. both of them are convex functions, and the sum of convex functions is still convex. Therefore, gradient descent (GD) method generally used to solve the optimization problem of such convex functions, however, as the L1 regularization term in Lasso regression is not differentiable, the gradient information cannot be obtained, thus, GD method cannot solve Lasso regression problem properly. In this paper a t-distribution coot optimization algorithm has been proposed to overcome the above shortcomings and difficulties in Lasso regression, and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is proved by experiments.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: The impact of 5G communication technology on electrical power systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 5G communication technology is a composite network technology with innovations in radio frequency, network and transmission. It can meet specific performance indicators in different scenarios. Therefore, the application of 5G technology will also promote the rapid development of all walks of life. As an industry closely related to communication, the arrival of 5G will bring changes to the current power system operation and provide solutions for its existing pain points. The needs of all links and various terminal scenarios in the electrical power system will also promote the popularization and development of 5G communication technology.

articleTitle: Detection of Piston Surface Defects Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, enterprises and users have higher and higher requirements for the quality of engine pistons. At present, the piston detection methods of many manufacturers are mainly contact detection and manual detection. However, the size of piston surface defects is usually small and irregular, and the surface reflectance is strong, it is difficult to detect defects. Therefore, taking the piston as the research object, a piston surface defect detection system is developed based on machine vision to detect and identify the piston surface defects. Aiming at the image processing of piston surface defects, a set of image processing flow based on HALCON is designed. It mainly includes image preprocessing, binarization, morphological processing, and threshold segmentation. The research shows that the system has certain reliability, detection efficiency, and accuracy, so that the detection system can be applied to practical production.

articleTitle: Predication of remaining useful life of aircraft engines based on Multi-head Attention and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the large amount of high-dimensional time series data generated by sensors, and the insufficient utilization of time series information in the network model in the prediction on remaining useful life (RUL) of aircraft engines, a data-driven model for RUL prediction based on a Multi-head Attention mechanism and a long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) is proposed in this paper to optimize RUL of aircraft engine. The model can select the key features in the time-series data, then input them into the LSTM layer to mine the internal connections, and finally obtain RUL predicted results through two fully connected layers. Using the CMAPSS dataset provided by NASA for verification and comparing with other algorithms, the accuracy of this method outperforms shallow neural networks based on support vector regression (SVM) and deep learning methods such as convolutional neural networks (CNN), multi-layered LSTM and multi-layered BiLSTM, which provides a powerful support for health management of aircraft engines, operation and maintenance decisions.

articleTitle: Offloading and Delay Optimization Strategies for Power Services in Smart Grid for 5G Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid increase of data-intensive and computation-intensive applications in smart grid, how to realize and complete corresponding application requests by utilizing the powerful computing capacity of cloud computing and the response characteristics of communication resources and short-time transmission of edge computing has become an urgent problem to be solved in the current smart grid. This paper studies the timely delay optimization of power business unloading based on 5G edge computing, which mainly solves the unloading decision problem faced by power terminal equipment unloading hybrid tasks to edge server or cloud server. First, this scheme considers the average delay weighted sum of unloading hybrid critical tasks. Secondly, the dynamic penalty function is introduced in this scheme, which breaks through the shortcoming of the traditional power grid system that can not provide deterministic service for deterministic business. Finally, the paper puts forward an improved solving Lagrange multiplier algorithm, in the precondition of unloading the success rate of higher priority task, get minimum cost of overall system time delay in the unloading plan simulation results show that compared with the traditional task processing schemes, the proposed scheme can effectively improve the system overall revenue, reduce the average user task delay.

articleTitle: Optimization calculation method of transmission line loss with multi-parameter correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Line loss rate is an important technical and economic index for national assessment of power supply enterprises, and the accuracy of line loss calculation becomes more and more important. The current line loss calculation method does not consider the influence of load level, clock accuracy and metering device, resulting in a large difference between the actual result and the calculated result, which is not conducive to the lean development of line loss management. In this paper, the influence of temperature and humidity on theoretical line loss is considered, and a mathematical model for calculating synthetic line loss rate is established to eliminate the error caused by using single line loss, and the line loss rate is modified by multiple parameters. The case shows that this method is more accurate and closer to the actual line loss rate, which has strong engineering practice significance.

articleTitle: Overview of anti-jamming technologies for satellite navigation systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of the electromagnetic environment in space, navigation signals are susceptible to various interferences when they reach the ground receivers, and may even fail to work normally due to interference. In view of the above situation, this article analyzes and summarizes the anti-jamming technology of the satellite navigation system. The interference of the navigation system is classified, time domain and transform domain anti-jamming technology are studied, and then the space-domain anti-jamming technology based on array antenna, space-time anti-jamming technology and adaptive beamforming technology are studied. The detailed research and summary of anti-jamming technology of global satellite navigation system in this article are of practical significance to the in-depth research and realization of navigation anti-jamming technology.

articleTitle: Computation Offloading and Resource Allocation based on Cell-Free Radio Access Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the high latency problem of computing task processing in traditional cellular radio access network, a method of computing task offloading and resource allocation based on cell-free fog radio access networks was proposed. A large number of wireless access points (AP) provide services in a “user-centric” manner. Fog-access points (F-AP) and cloud servers provide edge and cloud computing and caching functions, and establish a three-level offloading model of local, edge and cloud for computing task. Through deep reinforcement learning Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) method to make the optimal offloading decision and resource allocation for computing tasks, thereby reducing the overall delay of the system. The simulation results show that the optimal unloading decision significantly reduces the system delay and improves the system performance to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Mobile robot path planning based on ABC-PSO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm converging fast, easy to fall into local optimum, poor accuracy, and artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm global and local search ability is strong but the convergence speed of the optimization process is slow, a solution is proposed. The search process and optimization process in the artificial bee colony algorithm are added to the optimized particle swarm algorithm, namely the ABC-PSO algorithm, which has good global search capabilities and fast convergence. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of particle search, an adaptive inertia weight method is proposed, which uses different weight values at different stages. The final results show that the algorithm in this paper can find the optimal path quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on Startup of Synchronous Reluctance Motor Based on Square Wave Injection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the position sensorless vector control of synchronous reluctance motor, the starting performance affects the control effect at medium and high speed. In order to improve the overall control effect, it is necessary to improve the starting performance. This paper studies and improves the starting effect of synchronous reluctance motor. Taking advantage of the salient pole characteristics of the synchronous reluctance motor rotor structure, the method used in this paper is the high frequency square wave injection method. By injecting a high frequency square wave voltage signal, the rotor position information is obtained from the high frequency response current. The method can accurately estimate the rotor position at zero and low speed, and realize the reliable starting of the synchronous reluctance motor. The simulation results show that the method improves the startup effect of the synchronous reluctance motor and verifies the correctness of the control algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of engineering drawing recognition system based on Yolo V4
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to realize the detection of devices in engineering drawings, this paper proposes an engineering drawing recognition method based on YOLOv4 algorithm, which is applied to the detection of component targets under circuit diagrams. Traditional drawing auditing is mostly done by manual means. With the development of information technology, applying image technology and pattern recognition to drawing auditing is a hot spot for the application of artificial intelligence in drawing auditing. YOLO is a simple and uncomplicated algorithm that can make predictions based on the whole picture information and learn the picture features more generally. The components (capacitors, resistors, inductors and other basic components) in the circuit diagram are identified, and their number and location are indicated.

articleTitle: Huber Loss Function Based on t-Distribution Yin-Yang-Pair Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Generally, all artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms can be eventually transformed into optimization problems for solving loss functions, and there are two common types of loss functions: mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE), which have their own advantages and disadvantages. The error between the data reflected by MAE is more accurate and stable, but its derivative is discontinuous and non differentiable, so its efficiency in solution process is low; MSE is differentiable, but it has the tend to enlarge and reduce the data error. The popular method in the field of AI is to use Huber loss function, which combines the advantages of both MAE and MSE, as a framework. Huber loss function is usually solved by gradient descent (GD) method or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method, but these methods are easy to fall into local optimum and cannot find the global optimal solution. In this paper, a t-distribution Yin-Yang-Pair optimization algorithm has been proposed, such algorithm does not depend on gradient information and is easier to find the global optimal solution for Huber loss function, Via numerical experiment, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm has been verified.

articleTitle: Visual Recognition Method for Deformable Wires in Aircrafts Assembly based on Sequential Segmentation and Probabilisitic Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Manipulation object recognition is necessary for robotic manipulation planning and control. However, wire harnesses to be automatically assembled in aircrafts have small radial scale and complex structure which make them hard to be recognized. A method in order to accomplish multi-branch wire harness objects recognition is presented, which involves segmentation and estimation. Segmentation is performed in a sequential approach based on Cartesian distance, color similarity and bending continuity, among which the bending character considering rigidity diminishing thesis provides the segmentation result with physical interpretability. Gaussian Mixture Model is employed to making an estimation to complete the missing wire parts resulted from occlusion and omission on the segmented results. Effects of the method have been verified on a point cloud dataset with over 200 aviation wire objects. It has been demonstrated that aviation wire harnesses with multi-branches and occlusion can be distinguished and completed with a success rate over 96%.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Detection in UAV Vision based on Neural Processing Units
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the reduction of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) hardware cost and the development of deep learning algorithm, the real-time object detection algorithm applied in UAV vision has great advantages in many fields. However, due to the limited energy consumption and computing power of embedded devices used in the drones and the variable object scales and complex backgrounds in the UAV vision restrict the applications in object detection based on the drones. In this paper, we optimized the generation of anchor boxes, introduced a new module to increase the receptive field to improve the detection of small targets, and used adaptively spatial feature fusion in the feature pyramid to increase feature fusion of multi-scale features. At last we pruned the model to make it lighter and faster, and got the Average Precision (AP) of 89.7% for UAV car aerial images and the speed of 35.7 FPS by running on Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which proves the feasibility of the intelligent object detection algorithm's efficient processing in hardware resource limited environment.

articleTitle: A Target Location Algorithm Based on Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: How to find the trapped rescue workers in the fire disaster is the first problem to be solved. This paper designs the signal waveform, receives the echo data based on the AWR1642 millimeter wave radar sensor produced by TI company. The radar has high speed resolution, is prone to Across Doppler Unit (ADU) phenomenon, and the target signal-to-noise ratio and signal-to-clutter ratio are small in the fire environment, so it is difficult to realize the focus detection of the target. In addition, the radar has low angular resolution and is difficult to achieve accurate target positioning. The range and velocity of the target are estimated through signal processing processes such as Moving Target Indication (MTI), Radon-Fourier Transform (RFT) focusing and cell average constant false alarm rate (CA-CFAR) detection, and then obtains the angle information through multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm processing to complete the target positioning.

articleTitle: Sheep Identification with Distance Balance in Two Stages Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Sheep identification plays an important role in precision sheep breeding. In this paper, we propose an identification method based on computer vision and deep learning. The whole procedure is divided into two conjunction stages. Sheep face detection stage searches the candidate area in the image firstly. We adopt YOLO framework and optimize it with an overlap-free model. A comparative study is analyzed on various backbone networkse.g., EfficentNet, ResNet, etc. The second stage extracts the feature vector of the candidate sheep face area into a 2048 vector. The distance balance policy is used to maximize the distance of different sheep faces and to minimize that of the same ones. We also introduce a dataset of 547 sheep containing over 5000 images that are suitable for sheep identification task. All images are annotated with the bounding box to mark the position and size of the sheep face, and tag with the ID number as the identity of the sheep. Experiments on this dataset show that our proposed method can achieve the sheep identification accuracy in 85%, and the EfficientNet as the backbone can overwhelm the other networks. For an original image, it can detect the sheep face in 0.024s, and get the recognition result in 0.16s. Compared with the traditional RFID and ear-tag technology, the fast speed and high accuracy of sheep face identification show the great potential of using it in husbandry in the near future.

articleTitle: Radar Emitter Signal Identification Based on Intra-pulse Features
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Intra-pulse feature extraction is important to apply for intercepting complex modulation radar signal with low probability. Based on intra-pulse minute feature analysis for several typical radar signals, a fast recognition approach is obtained for intra-pulse complex-modulated radar signals. This approach can recognize four kinds of signals with three characteristic parameters, which are extracted from signal continuous wavelet transform eigenvalue, frequency domain moment kurtosis coefficient and frequency domain moment skewness coefficient. When the signal-noise ratio(SNR) is higher than 0 dB, the probability of signal recognition is greater than 98%. The simulation experiments can further verify the validity of this approach.

articleTitle: Acceleration and optimization of artificial intelligence CNN image recognition based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Before CNN, image recognition methods mainly relied on artificial design features, which can only represent the medium and low-level information in the image, and it is difficult to extract the deep-level information of the image. CNN simulates the human brain by establishing a deep neural network to analyze, learn and interpret data. It has strong expression ability and generalization ability, and can better represent the deep-seated information of images. At present, CNN has been widely used in many scenes, including image classification, speech recognition, video analysis, document analysis and so on. Most of the existing artificial intelligence image recognition systems are implemented by software and often accelerated by GPU. However, GPU has high power consumption and is not suitable for CNN reasoning, so it can not make use of the parallel computing power of CNN. To solve the above problems, this paper studies the application method of CNN image recognition acceleration and Optimization Based on FPGA, designs and optimizes the CNN forward model by using Intel FPGA board. The experimental results show that FPGA has low power consumption, the power consumption of CPU is 2.1 times, while the power consumption of GPU is 6.5 times. The average recognition time of the algorithm is 50% shorter than that of Lenet-5,AlexNet and VGG16, and the recognition time of 10000 sample pictures is 165μs. Compared with 426.6μs required by DSP chip system. Compared with the methods proposed in the literature in related fields in recent years, the proposed method has higher throughput and computational performance.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Modulation recognition based on BP neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Digital modulation is the most popular signal modulation method in the field of communication at present. Artificial neural network has a broad application prospect in the field of signal recognition because of its powerful ability of automatic recognition, automatic analysis and even information perception. In this paper, a classifier based on BP algorithm is designed by extracting the characteristic parameters of each modulation mode, which is composed of four BP neural networks. Finally, the classifier is trained by the characteristic parameters, and the classifier is verified by random signals, so as to explore the recognition with higher automation and faster speed.

articleTitle: Cloud computing resource node allocation algorithm based on load balancing strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, cloud computing has developed into a high-performance computing service model integrating the technical advantages of distributed computing, utility computing, load balancing, parallel computing, network storage, hot backup redundancy and virtualization. However, due to the lack of effective algorithm at the beginning of DAG task scheduling to ensure the load balance of resource node allocation during task scheduling, this paper proposes a cloud computing resource node allocation algorithm (NA-LB) based on load balancing strategy. The algorithm records the changes of virtual machine operating parameters in the cloud computing resource pool as vector values of spatial vectors, Therefore, the mathematical calculation method of load balance is given and used as the load balance index to measure the allocation of resource nodes. At the same time, the task replication strategy is used to further optimize the task resource node allocation process. The experimental results show that NA-LB algorithm can effectively shorten the DAG data processing time and show good load balance.

articleTitle: A design of object detection system in fog
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Images taken by intelligent monitoring equipment, unmanned driving, and intelligent transportation in foggy days have greatly affected the later object detection and information extraction. The main purpose of this research paper is to study and report how to implement an object detection system in foggy weather, and to implement a higher-precision Retinex algorithm on FPGA. The system uses Xilinx's ZYNQ 7 series development platform, the detection method is based on Tiny-YOLOv2. The Gaussian filter in Retinex algorithm uses a full variational design to enhance image quality and increase processing speed. The results prove that the accuracy of the YOLO object detection system is greatly improved after the retinex algorithm is processed, and it meets the requirements of fog object detection.

articleTitle: Power line parameter identification based on a binary nonlinear regression algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Various new energy, energy storage, and adjustable loads are incorporated into the distribution network to participate in the adjustment of the distribution network side, making the operation of the distribution network side more flexible. As an important part of the distribution network, the power lines of the distribution network are directly affected by this change. Therefore, the online detection of distribution network parameters in the distribution network becomes more and more important. Currently, smart devices can perfor15wm parameter estimation and topology recognition in a data-driven manner. However, many current methods require the use of phasor measurement units to measure the phase angle of the node voltage, which is not feasible for current relatively traditional power distribution networks. Based on the more accurate power detection of the current distribution network, this paper proposes a method for estimation of the line parameters of the distribution network without considering the voltage phase angle information. Based on the limited measurement data of the distribution network, the measured electricity is all amplitude. By modeling the transmission line of the distribution network, the problem of solving the transmission line parameters is transformed into a binary nonlinear regression problem. The binary nonlinear least-squares regression method is used to identify the transmission line parameters, and the residual analysis is used to eliminate anomalies data. After that, the reliability and accuracy of the method are analyzed for the identification results under different data volumes and different error levels. Finally, the line parameters within a day were identified under the condition of line temperature changes. By comparing the results of electrothermal coupling, the changes of line parameters in a day can be more accurately identified.

articleTitle: Ridge Regression Based on t-Distribution Marine Predators Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of big data analysis, it is often necessary to process and analyze the sample set, predict and classify unknown data by properly using the internal laws of the sample set. Machine learning (ML) is one of the effective methods to solve this kind of problems. Multiple linear regression is a basic model in ML, which can solve some regression prediction problems; however, it cannot solve the problem of multicollinearity, as the matrix in the loss function cannot be inversed. Ridge regression can be used to solve the above problem, as it adds L2 regularization on the original loss function to avoid over fitting of the data. Usually, gradient descent (GD) method or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method are used to solve the loss function. but in the process of parameter optimization, its optimization function is required to be convex, it is easy to fall into local extreme value, and it is difficult to set hyperparameters. In this paper, t-distribution marine predictors algorithm, which is based on swarm intelligence optimization has been selected to replace the traditional gradient dependent method to optimize the loss function solving process in ridge regression. Via numerical experiment, it has been verified that the proposed algorithm have better performance.

articleTitle: Grid reactive power optimization research under the background of source network load and storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Interactive regulation of grid load and storage is one of the key functions to realize energy interconnection, which is a higher stage of power grid development and a new stage of intelligent power utilization. In this paper, a multi-time scale reactive power joint optimization model of active distribution network with “source-network-Ioad-storage” interaction in electricity market environment is established, and stochastic model predictive control is adopted to realize progressive control layer by layer. The prior optimal dispatching is based on the prior market electricity price and the output forecast of renewable distributed generation, and the running state of active/reactive controllable sources and contact switches is arranged, so as to maximize the benefits on the basis of ensuring reliability. Intra-day rolling optimization eliminates voltage over-limit according to short-term forecast information; Real-time feedback correction focuses on operation safety, and performs more precise regulation based on ultra-short-term prediction information to suppress voltage fluctuation. Finally, the analysis of an example shows that the proposed model and method can improve the economy and reliability of distribution network significantly.

articleTitle: Effect Analysis of Z-N Method Combined with GA on PID Parameter Optimization of Screw Extruder
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Taking the screw extruder commonly used in chemical industry as the research object, the second-order model of its transmission control system is given. It is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink and adjusted using the Ziegler-Nichols method, which is commonly used in engineering and has an overshoot of more than 22% and an adjustment time of about 4s; the GA-PID method is used for optimization and has an overshoot of less than 0.5%, an adjustment time of about 2s, and a steady-state error of 0. The simulation results demonstrate that the Z-N technique combined with GA for PID parameter optimization requires less than 20 iterations, has a quick convergence rate, is resilient, and has high control quality.

articleTitle: Design of an Autonomous Navigation Intelligent Spraying Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the future, agriculture will become more and more intelligent, and the application of agricultural robots will become more and more extensive. Nowadays, there are more and more indoor plantings, and the indoor environment is closed, which is more complicated than outdoor. In this environment, manual application of pesticide is generally used, which can easily lead to poisoning and pesticide residues of the pesticide applicators. The autonomous navigation intelligent spraying robot designed in this paper integrates artificial intelligence into agriculture, which uses the visual servo system to make the robot find its way automatically. The spraying robot identifies the plant position information and spray on the target, thus reducing the harm of pesticides to the pesticide applicators and greatly reducing the labor cost and increasing the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Safety helmet wearing recognition based on improved YOLOv4 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In safety helmet wearing detection, traditional methods have problems such as low detection accuracy due to small object size. In this paper, we propose an improved helmet wearing detection algorithm YOLOv4-P. Firstly, we use k-means clustering algorithm to readjust the prior bounding box parameters to improve the matching between the prior bounding box and the object, and secondly, we introduce the Pyramid Split Attention (PSA) model to further process the multi-scale feature information. The network structure of YOLOv4 is improved by adding a layer of network features to improve the detection accuracy through feature fusion. Experimental results show that the improved model YOLOv4-P has an average accuracy improvement of 2.15% over the YOLOv4 algorithm on the SHWD helmet target detection dataset, satisfying the accuracy of the helmet wearing detection task.

articleTitle: Mimic Defense Equivalent Scheduling Algorithm Based on Service Quality and Credit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: First, for the characteristics of current Web application services under attack, this paper establishes an executor scheduling model based on the quality of service and credit in Mimic Defense system, and calculates the credit of each executor by combining evaluation factors such as Heterogeneous, credit and quality of service. Then, based on the difference of executors and the similarity of service quality, this paper schedules the optimal executors in the resource pool, which can guarantee the quality of Web Services while avoiding the frequent occurrence of scheduling to achieve the controllability of security. Finally, this paper compares and analyzes the algorithm with other scheduling algorithms. According to the simulation results, it can be seen that the algorithm designed in this paper can effectively improve the defense capability of the system and achieve a better balance between dynamics, reliability, and stability under the resource-constrained environment.

articleTitle: Design Controller Based on RBF Neural Network for the Rewinding Tension System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The control precision of the rewinding tension system is an important index for the roll-to-roll gravure printing machine. However, the PID control based on the common fixed parameters cannot solve the problems of strong coupling, multi-interference and time-varying parameters of the tension system, which severely limits the improvement of the rewinding tension control precision. Therefore, a PID feedforward control based on RBF neural network is proposed in this paper, to solve the key problems that restrict the improvement of control precision of the rewinding tension system. Firstly, a feedforward controller is designed for the disturbances existing in the rewinding tension system. Then, PID parameters online self-tuning method is designed based on RBF network. Finally, the performance of the designed controller is verified by simulation in MATLAB. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy has good anti-interference and decoupling performance, and realizes the online self-tuning of PID parameters.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Method for Image Recognition-based Fire Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Ideal smart fire detection systems should be able to detect the fire and trigger the automatic alarm at an early stage. Meanwhile, it should also trigger the automatic fire extinguishing system and broadcast the fire alarm under different fire conditions in order to avoid further damage and losses. The most critical problem for a smart fire detection system is to determine the existence/condition of the fire based on different kinds of information. The smart fire detection system should have fast reaction and be very reliable in the action process. Most of the modern smart fire detection systems are based on multi-sensor systems, or image/video surveillance system. In this work, we propose to combine the multi-sensor detection system with image recognition. When the decision from the multi-sensor system is uncertain or the data is not available/faulty, images are used to assist the fire detection process, which could make the whole system more robust and reliable. We are aiming at extracting important features from the images by using machine learning methods. Then, different classification methods will be applied to detect the fire conditions. We make use of the existing images collected from real environments to evaluate the proposed approach. In addition, we investigate and discuss the detection results using different classification methods, which verifies that the image-based fire detection scheme combined with multi-sensor system can achieve better efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: 3D Estimation of Single Image based on Homography Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to extract three-dimensional information from a single plane image under the condition of lacking camera parameters, this paper proposes a scheme combining perspective transformation and pseudo inverse method to realize the rough extraction of three-dimensional information from a single image. On the basis of the existing geometric model of camera imaging, taking points from the two-dimensional image and calculating the perspective transformation matrix, the homography matrix is obtained, and then the basic parameters of the camera can be marked through the corresponding relationship between the matrix and the camera internal and external parameter matrix. Pseudo inverse method is the inverse process of camera imaging, that is, it can estimate the final three-dimensional space coordinates from the pixel coordinates of the captured plan through the pseudo inverse matrix, and realize the one-to-one correspondence between two-dimensional coordinates and three-dimensional coordinates. The experimental results show that the algorithm is fast and convenient. Compared with the traditional Zhang's calibration method, this calibration result error is less than 5%, and the execution time is shortened by 70%.

articleTitle: A 5G Network Slice Resource Orchestration and Mapping Method based on Power Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the lack of end-to-end global delay optimization methods for power services at present, this paper proposes a 5G network slice resource orchestration and mapping method based on power service characteristics. Firstly, the end-to-end network slice mapping model for power business is constructed from access network slice and core network slice. Secondly, considering the limited resource of node computing and link transmission, the end-to-end global delay minimization problem is proposed under the premise of ensuring the minimum transmission rate and reliability of slices. Finally, a resource scheduling and mapping algorithm based on graph theory depth-first search (GDFS) is designed. Prioritize from the three aspects of slicing, virtual network function and physical resources, filter and prune each candidate matching pair, and iteratively solve the problem. Simulation results show that the proposed resource orchestration and mapping method can guarantee the delay, rate and reliability requirements of power services, and greatly reduce the end-to-end global delay.

articleTitle: Cost Prediction of Distribution Network Project Based on DART Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Strengthening lean management of distribution network construction is the most direct measure to ensure and improve people's livelihood and optimize user service requirements. It is also an inevitable requirement for building the international leading energy internet with Chinese characteristics. Due to the large number, relatively small scale, and diverse types of distribution network projects, it is difficult to predict the project cost. Based on the historical sample data of distribution network cost analysis, this paper constructs a distribution network project cost prediction model based on DART model, which can accurately predict the static investment of distribution network engineering. The research results can help investment decision makers quickly judge the rationality of the project cost at the initial stage of the feasibility study, improve the evaluation efficiency and cost accuracy, and effectively promote the standardization and lean management of the distribution network project cost.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of PI Controller for Isolated Bidirectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The dual active bridge is an important circuit in a wide range of circuits. Due to its characteristics such as its small size and circulating currents. An isolated bidirectional dc-dc circuit is proposed comprising of a capacitor at the output. This work discusses the performance of the dual active bridge converter with an open loop control and with cascaded control using PI controller. The performance is analyzed using MATLAB Simulink to simulate the results. Results show that cascaded PI control provides better dynamic for the DAB and the accuracy is higher than an open loop or single loop PI controlled system.

articleTitle: Application research of IEEE Std.1459–20 10 in three-phase three-wire system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, different kinds of power theories are relatively uniform in the definition of reactive power, which has clear physical significance, but the understanding of non-reactive power (power other than reactive power) varies considerably. On the basis of the IEEE Std.1459-2010 standard, this paper studies three-phase balance, load asymmetry, load nonlinearity, power supply distortion and asymmetry in three-phase three-wire circuits, employs this power theory to break down and calculate each power component, and designs reasonable parameters for power compensation. In the end, the simulation circuits are built by PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the accuracy of theoretical calculation and the effectiveness of compensation.

articleTitle: Research on battery management system based on flyback DC-AC converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a battery management system is designed based on flyback isolated DC/AC balance circuit. The bidirectional DC/AC active balance topology based on zero voltage switch resonance is studied, and the circuit miniaturization of the management system is realized by capacitive isolation drive. The prototype experiment shows that the balance current of the system scheme based on flyback DC/AC converter can reach 1A, and the balance management does not depend on the unit voltage sampling, which can automatically realize the two-way balance between multiple units in the battery pack.

articleTitle: Cloud computing task scheduling algorithm based on dynamic priority
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the large-scale and complex development trend of task scheduling in the current cloud computing environment, the traditional task priority scheduling algorithm is difficult to ensure the system load balance. A cloud computing task scheduling algorithm based on dynamic priority and scheduling decision is proposed(TS-DP). The algorithm calculates the task dynamic priority according to the task value and task urgency. At the same time, imitating the behavior of fireflies, the task scheduling decision variables are obtained by attraction (the user's expected earliest completion time), fluorescence brightness (task processing time constraint) and load balance, and then the tasks are scheduled to the executable computing node corresponding to the maximum decision variable value according to the task priority. Experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the resource scheduling performance of cloud computing, shorten the completion time of the total task, and achieve good load balancing, especially when the number of tasks and the scale of nodes are large.

articleTitle: UAV path planning based on modified ant colony algorithm and DUBINS curves
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the communication loss caused by the heavy rain and other major natural disasters in Henan Province, when the emergency vehicles could not enter the scene, in order to quickly restore the communication, the method of unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) flying over the affected area to set up a temporary base station is studied. The UAV needs to avoid obstacles, so a path planning method based on the combination of modified ant colony algorithm and DUBINS curves is proposed. By this algorithm, the global path of UAV is shorter, the path is smooth and the kinematics constraint is satisfied. Finally, the feasibility, validity and superiority of the proposed algorithm are showed by comparing with the basic ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow Under Renewable Enery Integrated For AC/DC Grids With VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Managing uncertainty and variability in power injections has become a major concern for power system operators due to increasing levels of fluctuating renewable energy connected to the grid. This paper analyzes the influence of renewable energy power prediction error on system's branch power and bus voltage. The power flow adj ustment ability of VSC for system is analyzd. Then an OPF model of VSC-HVDC System considering renewable energy access is proposed. The proposed model can better adapt to the impact of power fluctuation and improve the economy of the system by using the adjustment ability of VSC. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by IEEE39 bus system.

articleTitle: Multi-step-ahead Host Load Prediction with VMD-BiGRU-ED in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cloud computing resource load has the characteristics of nonlinearity, non-smoothness, high noise and high fluctuation, and it is difficult to achieve better prediction results by using a separate prediction model. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a combined VMD-BiGRU-ED prediction model based on VMD algorithm, GRU and encoder-decoder structure, which combines the advantages of strong VMD signal decomposition ability and high GRU prediction accuracy to accurately predict cloud computing resource load. To evaluate our model, we conduct experiments using the cluster public dataset provided by Alibaba Cluster-trace-v2018. The experimental results show that our proposed combined VMD-BiGRU-ED prediction model outperforms the single prediction model and other combined prediction models in terms of prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation of brain tumors based on DFP-UNet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation plays an important role in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment. Manually segmenting brain tumors is time-consuming and highly dependent on the expertise and experience of radiologists. In this paper, we propose an automatic brain tumor segmentation network named DFP-UNet to improve the accuracy of segmentation. Two improvements are made with respect to the UNet model: 1) use the pre-trained DenseNet121 model based on the ImageNet dataset as the encoder, 2) design a feature pooling block (FPB) as the decoder. In addition, some data preprocessing operations are carried out to alleviate the problems of low image contrast and limited training data for medical images, including image enhancement, data augmentation and normalization. Five-fold cross-validation is performed on the brain CE-MRI dataset to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that DFP-UNet can achieve an average dice score of 81.69±1.14%, which outperforms the state-of-the-art method by a large margin on the same dataset.

articleTitle: Study on Partial Discharge Characteristics of Typical Defects of Oil-paper Capacitor Bushing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Oil-paper capacitive bushings are widely used in the outlet device of power transformers to connect the transformer and the external electrical network and play the role of insulation and support. It must meet the requirements of electricity, heat, magnetism, and machinery during operation. Its insulation status is related to the power grid. Operational reliability. In this paper, based on the actual failure causes of the casing, four typical defect models of the casing are prepared, and the partial discharge experiment platform of the casing is built. The partial discharge signal of each model is collected based on the pulse current method, and the partial discharge PRPD spectrum and four two-dimensional Spectrogram, study the partial discharge characteristics of the bushing under AC voltage, obtain the partial discharge data of the typical defects of the bushing through experimental research, and study the discharge characteristics, in order to improve the condition moni-toring and operation and maintenance efficiency of the bushing.

articleTitle: Research on Asynchronous Motor Vector Control System with Fuzzy Slide Mode Speed Regulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The performance of asynchronous motor vector control system based on traditional PI speed regulator in exterior disturb response is not perfect. This paper proposes a newly design of vector control system with fuzzy slide mode regulator which is robust to sudden torque load and has less overshoot in sharp speed variation. The simulation result shows that the performance of fuzzy slide mode regulator in asynchronous motor speed control is superior to the PI ones in dynamic responding and robust characters.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Resource Optimization Scheme for MEC Task Offloading Based on Policy Gradient
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As an effective tool, reinforcement learning (RL) has attracted much attention in the field of mobile edge computing (MEC). For MEC task offloading, we hope to find a high-quality task offloading strategy faster. The Policy Gradient (PG) algorithm, as one of the RL algorithms, is known for its fast convergence. And the PG algorithm does not need to consider the state transition, and can run directly to get the result. In a queuing task scenario of a single terminal and a single edge server, the PG algorithm can quickly obtain a high-quality offloading scheme. The Greedy algorithm is also a commonly used decision-making method in MEC task offloading. Thus, we use the Greedy algorithm as the experimental control group and compare it with the exhaustive algorithm. Through the simulation platform, it can be judged that on the basis of randomly taking the initial value, the PG algorithm can save more than 50% of the overhead. Although the Greedy algorithm has advantages when the number of tasks is small, as the number of tasks increases, the overhead of the Greedy algorithm will become higher and higher due to the long decision time. Therefore, the PG algorithm is more effective in our scenario, which can obtain a high-quality offloading scheme through a shorter decision time. complexity.

articleTitle: Intelligent agricultural monitoring system based on lot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the gradual attention of the state to agricultural production, as well as the rapid development of artificial intelligence, Internet of things and other science and technology. The deep integration of traditional agricultural production and Internet of things technology has injected new power into new agricultural production and brought a qualitative leap. The intelligent agriculture system proposed in this paper uses high-performance embedded MCU and configures high-precision sensors. Collect data on air environment, soil temperature and humidity, rainfall, diseases and pests, EC, pH. Use 5G network to return the data, save it in the remote server and analyze the data curve. By making an experimental prototype and collecting data analysis, we can predict the water and nutrients needed by plants in different seasons. Then customize the cultivation scheme. The effectiveness and practicability of the method are verified by a large number of experimental data. At the same time, the management platform also provides services including pest prediction, intelligent irrigation, big data prediction, agricultural logistics, online experts and so on. And greatly improve the planting efficiency and crop yield.

articleTitle: Realization of Electric Power Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The data transmission channel is the carrier of data collection and information interaction, and its function is mainly to realize the communication between the substation collection terminal and the master station. In order to ensure the stability of data transmission, the transmission channel between the collection terminal of the sub-station and the main station adopts the regional power dispatch data network or the Inner Mongolia provincial power dispatch data network, and the communication protocol adopts a variety of expanded versions of the 102 protocol. The dispatching data network adopts IPover SDH technology for networking and transmission based on optical cable channels. The reliability and safe transmission of the dispatching data network affect the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Therefore, this paper studies and analyzes the safe transmission and safety protection of the electric dispatching data network.

articleTitle: Network Slicing for IoV: QoS-Oriented Radio Resource Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To satisfy the quality of service (QoS) requirements for different applications in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), the network slicing technology is applied for IoV in this paper. Considering the traffic admission control, the average total throughput of the infotainment service slice is maximized under the constraints of low-latency and high reliability of the security service slice. Moreover, the spectrum resource block (RB) allocation and transmit power allocation are jointly considered, while ensuring the transmission rate of the infotainment service slice. The resource management of IoV is modeled as a mixed integer stochastic optimization problem, which is reduced into a simpler one with the help of Lyapunov optimization theory. Then, the simplified optimization problem is equivalently decomposed into two sub-problems corresponding to traffic admission control and RB and transmit power allocation, respectively. Based on block coordinate decent (BCD) and Lagrangian methods, an alternative optimization algorithm is proposed to solve the sub-problems iteratively.
