Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed resource allocation scheme can effectively improve the average total throughput for the infotainment service slice, and can strike a dynamic balance between delay and throughput by tuning the introduced control parameter. Besides, compared with the benchmark schemes, the proposed scheme shows superior latency performance.

articleTitle: Design and application of freshwater ecological ranching monitoring system based on LoRa and NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the weakness of short transmission distance and small coverage in the current freshwater ecological ranching monitoring system, a water quality monitoring system based on LoRa and NB-IoT technology is proposed. The system takes STM32F407VET6 as the main control chip and RS-485 communication as the interface of data interaction. The detailed design method of the control system is adviced. The experimental test shows that the application of LoRa and NB-iot technology can overcome the weakness of narrow monitoring range and low transmission efficiency of the existing monitoring system, and the system has the advantages of stability and reliability, and has a good prospect of popularization and application value.

articleTitle: Intelligent fault diagnosis technology of power transformer based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Transformer is the key equipment of power system, and its stable operation is very important to the security of power system In practical application, with the progress of technology, the performance of transformer becomes more and more important, but faults also occur from time to time in practical application, and the traditional manual fault diagnosis needs to consume a lot of time and energy. At present, the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology provides a new research direction for timely and accurate detection and treatment of transformer faults. In this paper, a method of transformer fault diagnosis using artificial neural network is proposed. The neural network algorithm is used for off-line learning and training of the operation state data of normal and fault states. By adjusting the relationship between neuron nodes, the mapping relationship between fault characteristics and fault location is established by using network layer learning, Finally, the reasoning process from fault feature to fault location is realized to realize intelligent fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: PID parameter tuning algorithm of rotor UAV Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of cascade proportional integral derivative (PID) in the flight control system of small rotary-wing UAV flight control system, it is difficult to manually adjust the parameters and the parameters obtained after the optimization is poor, an improved particle swarm algorithm with nonlinear dynamic weights is proposed., And use it in the tuning process of UAV PID parameters. Taking the quad-rotor UAV as the specific research object, firstly, the mathematical model of the UAV is established, and an improved particle swarm optimization method is adopted to process the inertial weights for nonlinear dynamic drop processing, which greatly improves its search performance and optimization efficiency. To make up for the shortcomings of the traditional particle swarm optimization method, finally through Matlab/Simulink simulation comparison and analysis. The experimental results show that the parameters adjusted by the improved particle swarm optimization method can enable the system to achieve better control performance indicators and shorter adjustment time, so that the UAV has a better dynamic performance, and it also eliminates manual tuning. It reduces the time of parameter setting and has certain guiding significance for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Application Research of Transmission Line Icing Monitoring Based on Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Icing on the conductor is the main cause of accidents such as tower toppling and line breaking in winter, This has restricted the development of power grid to a great extent and brought huge economic losses to the country. With the construction of smart transmission lines, a variety of transmission line monitoring devices are widely deployed. The traditional icing monitoring device has some problems, such as complex installation, easy interruption of power supply and communication. This paper focuses on the application of optical fiber sensing technology in transmission line icing monitoring, On the one hand, the principle and technical characteristics of distributed optical fiber sensing based on Raman scattering, Rayleigh scattering and Brillouin scattering are analyzed, On the other hand, a transmission line icing monitoring network scheme based on multi parameter distributed optical fiber sensing is proposed, Finally, the prospect of distributed optical fiber sensing technology for transmission lines is put forward.

articleTitle: Research on friction disturbance compensation method in low-speed region of permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the instability phenomenon of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) running in a low-speed region is compensated. Based on the PI control strategy, the friction model is used to compensate for the nonlinear part dominated by friction torque. The Stribeck friction model is used to build the model of system friction. Compensation of linear load disturbance using load observer. The simulation results show that the friction model and the disturbance observer method reduce the influence of friction nonlinearity on the low-speed performance of the system and improve the tracking accuracy and disturbance rejection ability of the system.

articleTitle: Troubleshooting and Maintenance of SDH Optical Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the fault classification of SDH optical transmission system, describes the location of the fault and the processing method of the fault. Finally summarized the content and specific requirements of the maintenance of SDH optical transmission system. Combined with the actual operation and maintenance work, the basic configuration and function of SDH equipment are described, and the specific application of SDH equipment in Xianning power communication is analyzed Using the basic principle of SDH and the theoretical basis of mapping process, this paper discusses the methods to solve the major and difficult faults in actual maintenance work The treatment and analysis process of common faults in daily operation and maintenance of SDH optical terminal equipment and some problems in daily maintenance are summarized and summarized

articleTitle: Offloading Strategies for Mobile Edge Computing Based on Multi-Attribute Preferences in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the emergence of new services such as intelligent inspection and distributed power supply, power wireless networks carry more and more types of services, which have different requirements for communication delay, reliability, bandwidth, and service priority. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) can meet the differentiated quality of service requirements of today's smart power services, while also improving business efficiency. In this paper, we propose a multi-attribute preference offloading decision scheme for power MEC scenarios. The method mainly focuses on the preference of different power services for service quality requirements, and constructs a resource allocation scheme that can guarantee the priority transmission of urgent power services while taking into account user preferences, with the goal of minimizing user task delay costs and energy costs, so as to maximize system benefits. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of this scheme.

articleTitle: STM32-based Anti-fall Smart Vest System for the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increasing trend of population aging in our country, how to take care of the elderly has become the focus of attention from all walks of life. In order to reduce the occurrence of incidents that the elderly did not receive timely assistance due to falling, this article designed a smart vest system with STM32 single-chip microcomputer as the main control chip, which uses ultrasonic sensors to obtain the distance between the elderly and obstacles to realize the anti-collision reminder function. Connect the six-axis acceleration sensor for fall detection and control the ejection of the airbag to complete the fall protection function. At the same time, the alarm information is sent to the target associated mobile phone through the GSM network, and the HTTP communication protocol is used to communicate with the OneNET platform (China Mobile Internet of Things Open Platform) carry out data interaction and realize the function of positioning for help. The system also uses human heart rate sensors and body temperature sensors to collect real-time data on the physiological state of the elderly; this system adds a strong guarantee for the health and safety of the elderly.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Crater Detection on Martian Surface Using SUN et 3+
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Crater detection algorithms (CDAs), playing a key role in deep space exploration and planetary science, could help researchers determine the age and depth of the planetary surface by identifying the location, size and amounts of impact craters on planetary surface. In this paper, we propose a simplified full-scale skip connected UN et termed SUN et 3+ to achieve fast and accurate crater detection on Mars surface with digital elevation model (DEM) data. The full-scale connection in SUNet 3+ could incorporate low-scale and large-scale features of craters to improve detection accuracy. And the skip connection could improve the computation efficiency with less network parameters than other UN et-series models. The experimental results show that our proposed architecture achieve a 84.97% accuracy with 13.6 MB size which make it possible to deploy the algorithms on aerospace crafts with high computation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Information Security Protection of Industrial Internet Oriented CNC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Machine tool is known as the mother of industry. CNC machine tool is the embodiment of modern automatic control productivity. In the context of the rapid development of the industrial Internet, a large number of equipment and systems are interconnected through the industrial Internet, realizing the flexible adaptation from the supply side to the demand side. As the a typical core system of industrial Internet, CNC system is facing the threat of industrial virus and network attack. The problem of information security is becoming more and more prominent. This paper analyzes the security risks of the existing CNC system from the aspects of terminal security, data security and network security. By comprehensively using the technologies of data encryption, identity authentication, digital signature, access control, secure communication and key management, this paper puts forward a targeted security protection and management scheme, which effectively strengthens the overall security protection ability.

articleTitle: Obstacle avoidance navigation method for robot based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the navigation problem of mobile robots indoor environment, the traditional navigation algorithm based on D3QN has some problems such as sparse reward and slow training speed of the neural network. This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning Algorithm (LN-D3QN) based on the D3QN network to realize collision-free autonomous navigation of mobile robots. To improve the efficiency of mobile robot learning and exploration, the Vision Sensor is used to acquire the input data from the environment, and the layer normalization method is used to normalize the input data. An improved reward function is designed, which improves the reward value of the algorithm, optimizes the state space, and alleviates the problem of sparse reward to some extent. The data is stored in a priority experience replay pool, and the network is trained using small batches of data. In addition, we evaluate our method by experiment related to indoor navigation. The experiments show that the robot trained by the improved D3QN algorithm can adapt to the unknown environment more quickly than the basic D3QN algorithm. The network's convergence speed is also improved, and it can complete the obstacle avoidance navigation task more efficiently.

articleTitle: 5G Smart Pole and Internet of Thing Use Case
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: 5G Smart Pole is an IoT pole which consists of a streetlight as its hardware, IoT devices with different functions and an intelligent network interface with 5G communications protocol. It's an independence device, which can link to the Internet directly without a computer. It has a built-in gateway and a sensor server to access the digital information from IoT devices, and also to control and to set up them. Digital output of 5G Smart Pole enables the hardware pole to easily integrate multi-applications, including digital illumination, digital monitoring system, push notifications, emergency reporting and long-distance environmental monitoring. 5G Smart Pole is usually stationed at the LAN environment in the street to perform these applications. 5G Pole also collects IoT data dynamically and provides various services. One of use cases is expected to combine the temperature and humidity pole detector DHT11 with 5G smart poles to determine which plants are suitable for growth around the 5G smart poles based on the collected data uploaded to the cloud platform. This IoT project develops an optimized QoS/QoE management system that suits the 5G Smart Pole environment in order to utilize the restricted bandwidth resources more effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of epidemic disease monitoring cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The main research content of this paper is a monitoring platform for cardiovascular epidemic diseases. It is mainly aimed at the people who have been diagnosed with cardiovascular diseases, provide them with daily monitoring in their daily life, timely help patients find the disease, and timely adjust their lifestyle such as diet and sleep, so as to achieve the effect of disease control and prevention. The platform is realized by using big data analysis, cloud computing, machine learning and other technologies. This paper will introduce the requirements analysis of the system, including the system design, including the design of core algorithms, hoping to provide timely disease monitoring services for patients with cardiovascular epidemics through the use of information technology.

articleTitle: Predicting Presence of Amphibian Species Using Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The presence of amphibian species can be regarded as the basis of any natural assessment. Generally speaking, the more amphibian species and populations analyzed, the higher the value of the habitat. In the problem of predicting presence of amphibian species, it is very difficult to assess because a large number of habitats are distributed on a vast land and the time available for field investigation is limited. The usual method is to use the local environment variable space that can be collected remotely from the satellite images and GIS systems, and combine it with machine learning method for classification and prediction. The dataset obtained in the experiments can be regarded as an ordinal classification, and some features are ordinal, which has monotonic dependence with the decision. In this paper, we introduce a feature selection algorithm to evaluate the feature space, and select sensitive features. Furthermore, we apply a machine learning algorithm to evaluate the performance of the selected feature subset, and obtain a prediction model. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively remove irrelevant features and improve the performance of prediction model.

articleTitle: Design of Devops environment based on cloud platform architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper designs a cloud-based R&D simulation environment construction method, builds an enterprise-level online DevOps system, opens up all aspects of R&D, testing, and production, realizes the online integration of the entire process of R&D, testing, and release, and improves the R&D and testing environment. Automated testing, automatic deployment capabilities, improved production environment “one-click release” capabilities, shortened the overall cycle of R&D and testing, explained the construction methods of unified code warehouse, dependent warehouse, and mirrored warehouse, realized centralized management of company code, and unified management of dependent warehouse version. Solve the problem of code leakage and reduce the risk of safe operation.

articleTitle: Stepped frequency signal property analysis based on Ambiguity function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Ambiguity function (AF) is an effective tool for radar signal analysis and waveform design, which is only determined by the transmitting waveform. AF reflects target resolution and clutter suppression ability of radar under the best receiving mode. Among high resolution radar signals, stepped frequency (SF) signal is a kind of reliable and efficient radar signal. Therefore, the research of SF signal has attracted extensive attention in recent years. In order to analyze the property of SF signal in detail, in this paper, we propose a property analysis method of SF signal based on AF to provide important basis for waveform design. Through mathematical modeling and experimental verification, we find the amplitude modulation term which controls the primary performance of SF signal. We also analyze and compare the performance of linear stepped frequency (LSF) signal and random stepped frequency (RSF) signal to find that the performance of AF of RSF signal tends to be better than LSF signal under the same conditions. In addition, we found that when the frequency shift is zero or the time delay is zero, the AF performance of LSF and RSF signals is similar by the formula derivation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization Method of Multi-category Goods Placement Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A two-dimensional bin packing model was established to solve the problem of goods placement in the material box, which was optimized to improve space utilization. By discretization of the model, a bin packing algorithm with left-bottom priority is designed. By adopting the improved genetic algorithm with the optimal individual retention strategy, the optimal sequence of various kinds of goods in the material box is obtained. Two types of experiments of multi-algorithm comparison simulation and multi-solution simulation are designed. The first type of experimental results show that the algorithm has some advantages in fitness and convergence speed, and the second type of experimental results show that it can provide multiple optimal solutions for solving small-scale bin packing problems.

articleTitle: A dynamic broadcast radius-based clustering and routing algorithm for WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With development of Internet of Things, wireless sensor networks (WSN) become larger and larger and if the present clustering and routing methods are widely used in large scale WSN, “energy hole” problem will deteriorate. To alleviate “energy hole” problem of WSN, a dynamic broadcast radius-based clustering and routing algorithm (DBRCR) is proposed. The algorithm calculates node broadcast radius every round, and based on the broadcast radius the neighbor table is established. Then according to the degrees of nodes, construct clusters iteratively. Finally, finding intra-cluster communication path based on data transmission success rate and routing for the inter-cluster communication based on nodes' residual energy and transmission energy consumption to minimize the data packet-loss rate and prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Research on Target Recognition Method of Tunnel Lining Image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity and diversity of ground-penetrating radar-based tunnel disease target imaging, as well as the relatively complex disease image identification process, low recognition rate, and the inability to achieve end-to-end identification, this paper proposes an improved Faster-R-CNN method for tunnel lining image target identification. The method can quickly and accurately determine the location of the disease images and classify them. The effectiveness of this method is verified by taking the common disease images such as steel arch and uncompactness in tunnel lining structure as the real measurement recognition objects, which provides a new method for automatic ground-penetrating radar image interpretation.

articleTitle: Research on High-speed Maglev Energy-saving Driving Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Maglev train, as a new transportation mode, has the advantages of strong environmental adaptability, convenience and swiftness, and has a vast development prospect in the future rail transit field. The driving control strategy of the maglev train mainly focuses on obtaining the shortest running time and the lowest energy consumption. In this paper, the force of the maglev train is analyzed at first, and then, considering the ramp, line speed limit, traction, and braking force constraints, the energy-saving model of the maglev train with time constraint are established. Based on the above model, a pseudo-spectral method is designed to solve the optimization problems. First of all, we preprocess the ramp and speed data. Then we use the pseudo-spectral method to solve the model. Finally, we obtain the shortest running time driving curve, optimal energy-saving driving curve with the time constraint and optimal train running time allocation energy-saving driving curve. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has an obvious energy-saving effect.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Audio Stream Processing Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Realize audio stream processing based on ZYNQ hardware platform. On the PS side of ZYNQ, the open source FFmpeg library is used to parse the audio compression data MP3 from the network audio data, and the audio compression data MP3 is audio decompressed to obtain the original audio data PCM, which is transmitted to the PL side of ZYNQ through DMA, based on Vivado The ila logic analyzer in the development environment captures the transmitted PCM data and displays the waveform. After testing and verification, the design function is stable, the software program starts efficiently and supports multiple protocols. The PL logic analyzer can capture the transmitted PCM data. In summary, this design can well realize the function of audio stream processing.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming Trajectory Planning of Infrared Imaging Air-to-air Missile
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: When an infrared imaging air-to-air missile attacks a fighter target in head-on condition or tail attack condition, due to slow separation between the artificial infrared decoys and the fighter target in the field of view of the seeker, the probability of the missile anti-jamming will be greatly reduced. We say that the missile is in the low probability area of anti-jamming. If the target fighter releases artificial infrared decoys in the guidance sensitive period before the missile encounters the target, it may not only cause the seeker to lose the target prematurely and then the missile fails to hit the target, but also increase the miss distance because of the guidance signal interference by the decoys even when the seeker still keeps tracking the target till the end. In this paper, an anti-jamming trajectory planning is researched and proposed. First, judge whether the attack situation is in the anti-jamming low probability area. Second, if it is in low probability area, control the missile to implement appropriate trajectory maneuver to avoid head-on attack situation and tail attack situation. Third, choose an reasonable time to exit the anti-jamming trajectory and switch to the terminal guidance to ensure the guidance accuracy. Fourth, terminal guidance algorithm adopts the line of sight (LOS) angular acceleration compensation guidance (AACG), which can improve the guidance accuracy even when the guidance signal is interfered. Finally, numerical simulation of six degree of freedom guidance system is carried out. The simulation results verify the effect and feasibility of anti-jamming trajectory planning of infrared imaging air-to-air missile.

articleTitle: Does the Development of Regional Financial Inclusion Affect Economic Growth?
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper uses the panel data of 31 provinces and cities in China in 2016, starting from 6 indicators in three dimensions, constructing a regional financial inclusion index, establishing a panel data model, and longitudinally comparing the degree of inclusive financial development in different regions in China. Studies have shown that although the overall development of inclusive finance is stable, it shows a trend of “high in the east, low in the west, and weak in the middle”. At the same time, inclusive finance has something to do with the depth of regional development and per capita disposable income, what's more, disposable income is positively related to inclusive finance. When we improve the development of inclusive finance in the western region, we can also increase the depth of financial development and optimize the allocation of financial resources, thereby contributing to the economic growth of different regions.

articleTitle: Information-driven resource allocation for epidemic controlling on multiplex networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The topic of epidemic controlling has now attracted wide attention from scholars in varies disciplines. In this paper, we focus on the problem of how the self-protection awareness and preferential contact between individuals influence the spreading dynamics. To this end, a coupled resource-epidemic model on top of double layer multiplex networks is proposed. We consider that the awareness of the susceptible individuals is affected by the information of the number of infected neighbors, and the process of resource allocation is determined by the awareness of the susceptible ones. In addition, it is assumed that the infected individuals can contact one neighbor at a time, and the preferential contact between the infected and susceptible nodes will affect the dynamical property. To verify the assumption, we conduct extensive Monte Carlo simulations on double layer networks. To mimic the spreading process of the epidemic, the Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model is adapted in this paper. First of all, we study the impact of awareness on the spreading dynamics and find that, with the increase of the awareness, the threshold of the epidemic decreases and the infected density in the stationary state increases, which suggests that in a pandemic, the healthy individuals should help the infected ones actively in order to suppress the epidemic. In addition, we find that with the increase of the parameter of preferred contact, the epidemic threshold first decreases and then increases. There exists a critical parameter, at which the threshold reaches lowest. Overall, the epidemic can be better suppressed when the infected nodes contact more preferentially to the nodes with large degree nodes.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Beam Sonar Grid Data Prediction Based on Improved CNN-BP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to establish an accurate multi-beam sonar grid data prediction model and solve the problem of calculation of artificial reef air volume, a multi-beam based on the combined model of improved convolutional neural network (Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) and BP neural network is proposed. Sonar grid data prediction method. First, the improved CNN is used to perform a full convolution operation on the data to extract local features, and then input into the BP to further mine the internal rules, so as to realize the prediction of the multi-beam sonar grid data. Experiments were carried out with multi-beam sonar grid data in a submarine enclosure, and cross-validation was carried out using the empty space of artificial reefs. Finally, it compares with traditional Kriging, BP, GA-BP, PSO-BP models. The results show that the improved CNN-BP model has the best prediction results on multi-beam sonar grid data and artificial reef air volume, which verifies the feasibility, reliability and high accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification Bin Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the increasingly common problem of urban garbage disposal,this paper designs an intelligent classification bin based on image recognition and artificial intelligence technology,which mainly consists of mechanical sorting module, image recognition module and control and communication module. The device achieves automatic waste identification and classification through artificial intelligence technology, reducing the human cost and pressure of waste classification, and has high application prospects.

articleTitle: A review on emergency response and recovery method for large area outage of power grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The safety operation of power grid faces challenge of natural disaster, operation accident, and external attack, which usually results in large area blackout event and threatens public safety. This paper comprehensively reviewed the emergency response and recovery method for large area outage of power grid. The emergency plan and optimal method, risk evaluation, warning, emergency disposal and recovery method were summarized in the literature. The key aspects of common and special classification for large area blackout, the corresponding main risks, and emergency procedure in the emergency plans were extracted. Meanwhile, the risk evaluation, warning procedure and disposal method for large area blackout were retrospected. Finally, the emergency recovery algorithm, model, and strategies were summarized. The work could provide theoretical and technical support for the procedure of emergency plan, response, warning, and recovery of large area blackout events.

articleTitle: Global trajectory optimization of mobile robot based on Minimum Snap
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since the path planned by the traditional A * algorithm consists of a series of discrete spatial points and does not contain time and control quantities, it cannot be directly used for trajectory tracking of mobile robots. To address this problem, this paper uses the Minimum Snap method to transform the traditional path planning algorithm and the planned path into a continuous smooth trajectory containing both time, velocity and acceleration information. The trajectory is optimized by introducing the trajectory shape constraint and velocity and acceleration constraint, so as to generate a global trajectory suitable for the path tracking of mobile robots, while the generated trajectory differs too much from the original path shape and the robot motion trajectory is not smooth due to the robot's own physical constraints are not considered. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments, and the method is applied to a robot autonomous navigation system under ROS (Robot Operating System) to confirm the practicality and reliability of the method.

articleTitle: Multimodal network structure design of power communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the network characteristics, network requirements and multimodal network advantages of the future ubiquitous power Internet of things. Using SDN idea to upgrade the existing network planning, the complex power communication network architecture is preliminarily designed, and the function and performance of the architecture are tested and demonstrated through the verification system. The design idea and test method are given in this paper.

Author Keywords: Multi mode network Power Internet of things SDN Network Architecture

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Drop Fuse
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of an intelligent drop fuse. This paper analyzes the system composition of intelligent drop fuse, and introduces the hardware and software design principle, architecture and implementation method of intelligent drop fuse. This design mainly applies the intelligent fuse terminal in the station area, which is used to monitor the position signal of the drop fuse in real time, report the fuse drop state information, and effectively shorten the fault location and troubleshooting time, so as to reduce complaints and provide services. The wireless communication module implements a weighted random backoff transmission algorithm, which can determine the transmission time and priority of data according to the urgency of data in the process of data transmission, avoid data collision and ensure the arrival of data as much as possible.

articleTitle: Research on distributed cross-domain authentication mechanism for 5G MEC edge network in substation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The birth of 5G technology provides the basic network for the electric power industry applications. With the advantages of the large bandwidth, low latency, high mobility, service offload, it gives rise to the substation intelligent robots, unmanned aerial vehicles, distribution gird station monitoring, etc. Considering the openness of the wireless signal and the sensitivity of the power grid equipment information, authentication policies must be designed based on the 5G network architecture to reduce the risk of unauthorized access. This paper proposes a multi-factor authentication mechanism through the secondary authentication framework based on 5G network. The proposed identity authentication factors include trusted identity identification, radio frequency signal characteristics, geographic location information, traffic statistics, etc. The reliability of each factor is calculated in real time through the secondary authentication gateway, and the terminal access legitimacy is analyzed. The access authentication process of substation 5G edge network is designed according to 5G secondary authentication framework to ensure the legitimacy of terminal identity and block suspicious terminals in time. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed distributed cross-domain authentication mechanism is verified by analyzing various attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Logic Search Method MPPT Control of Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Synchronous Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Traditional wind power generation systems have shortcomings such as oscillation and instability when tracking the maximum power point, and the selection of the tracking strategy directly affects the power generation efficiency and stability of the wind power system. How to track the maximum power point effectively under the premise of ensuring the normal operation of the system is the top priority of the power control of wind power system. Based on the in-depth analysis of the system structure, this paper proposes a method of using fuzzy logic search to realize the maximum power tracking control of the direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous wind power system, and the method is simulated and verified. The results show that this method has better control performance than the traditional hill climbing method and has better control performance.

articleTitle: Research On Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based On Improved RRT* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) has been widely used in robot navigation as a fast and efficient path planning method. Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) is one of the extensions of RRT, which outperforms the RRT algorithm because it can approximate the optimal path as the number of iterations increases. However, as the number of sampling points increases, the time to obtain the optimal path is too long, the algorithm converges significantly slower, and it is difficult to pass narrow obstacles in a short time. In this paper, we propose an improved RRT* algorithm, which first samples nodes in the dynamic target region to narrow the sampling range; expands tree nodes by target biasing strategy to reduce the randomness of tree growth; and generates more sampled nodes near the narrow obstacle nodes to make them have a higher probability of passing through the narrow channel. Simulation results show that our algorithm can find feasible paths quickly. Compared with the original RRT* algorithm, the algorithm performs better in terms of time and path cost.

Author Keywords: asymptotically optimal rapidly expanding random tree (RRT*) algorithm

articleTitle: Research on watermarking removal algorithm based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Noise2noise is a classical algorithm for image denoising in neural network deep learning. In this paper, some improvements are made to Noise2Noise (N2N for short), such as changing the underlying network of the original network to empty convolution, using SRResNet in SRGAN to improve the image quality, and selecting an adaptive parameterized Relu activation function. At the same time, the improved N2N algorithm is trained and tested by using self-built watermark data set. Experimental results show that the improved N2N algorithm can achieve good watermark removal effect, and can not only remove single visible watermark, but also remove large-scale watermark images in batches, which has strong practical value for image restoration and other fields.

articleTitle: Research on Retinal Vessel Segmentation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low precision and large error in the segmentation task of retinal blood vessel by computer, this paper improved the UNet++ network structure and proposed an algorithm model DAUNet++ (Deformable attention UNet++) that can effectively extract retinal blood vessel structure. Firstly, the deformation residual module is designed to construct the encode structure to enhance the feature extraction capability of the network for target details. At the same time, the attention mechanism is used to remove redundant features in the original network decoding module group, and the feature enhancement module is designed to enhance the performance of features. In order to verify the robustness of the optimized network model, DRIVE dataset was used for experimental tests. The test results showed that the accuracy, sensitivity and specificity of the optimized network model reached 97.07%, 83.25% and 98.36%. The experimental results show that the network model designed in this paper has a good performance in retinal vessel segmentation task and has certain competitiveness compared with other existing methods.

articleTitle: A Phishing Website Detection and Recognition Method Based on Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper compares and analyzes three popular phishing website detection methods, i.e., text mining based model, configuration file matching model, machine learning classifier model. Based on the URL, HTML and other peripheral information characteristics of the phishing website, the paper adopted machine learning method and designed a set of phishing website detection and recognition program based on Naive Bayes algorithm. Experiments show that the program can identify phishing websites in a timely, fast and effective manner, and can provide a certain reference for combating phishing practice.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of the YSI 600R Temperature and Salt Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper describes how to analyze a fault of the YSI 600R temperature and salt sensor commonly used for observing marine hydrological elements in terms of measurement principle and technical index,power supply detection,communication cable inspection and signal transmission etc, identify the fault cause. In the fault analysis part, it focuses on how to test whether the output data of the sensor is normal through the communication connection between the self-made RS232 serial port debugging line and the temperature and salt sensor, and finally judge the fault point, and puts forward common solutions for the failure of this type of sensor in the future. It can be used for reference to deal with such faults in marine environment monitoring field.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of regular banking based on improved support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the low efficiency of the bank's regular financial products, an improved support vector machine (SVM) algorithm is proposed. Combining SVM algorithm with grid search algorithm (GS) and K-CV, named GS-SVM, according to the parameter distribution law of SVM algorithm, K-CV and GS are used to select the model parameters, which improves the accuracy of the model. And GS-SVM algorithm is applied to the customer data mining of a bank's fixed-term financial products, and the validity of the SVM model based on the optimal parameters is verified in the bank's fixed-term financial customer data, which effectively reduces the customer range of bank push-subscribe time deposits and improves the efficiency of bank financial products.

articleTitle: A DOA Estimation Algorithm for Dual-Polarized Cylindrical Conformal Array with Unknown Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a calibration algorithm based on dual-polarized cylindrical conformal array with un-knowing mutual coupling. Combined with the characteristics of cylindrical array, the elevation can be estimated based on GEESE algorithm. Then, the azimuth estimation can be obtained after projection transformation and smoothing. In general, the proposed algorithm can realize joint estimation of angle information, polarization parameters and mutual coupling coefficients through iteration. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-Source Information Fusion Integration Platform for Testing and Commissioning of High Speed Railway
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The traditional commissioning and testing each system chimney construction, information can't be shared, single point strong and overall weak, lack of professional, professional and external environment between the correlation analysis and centralized fusion of intuitive display. Through the research on key technologies such as multi-source information fusion, cross-platform information interconnection, data sharing, space-time synchronization, multi-graph collaborative linkage, and integrated display, the ‘multi-source information fusion integration platform’ was designed and developed. The application of Beijing-Zhangjiakou and other lines shows that the platform realizes the integration of information fusion among organizations (horizontal), specialties (vertical) and data (end-to-end), and improves the overall judgment, abnormal alarm, collaborative command and scientific decision-making level of testing and commissioning.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-channel DC/DC Converter System and Its Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since the output characteristics of the fuel cell are relatively soft, the voltage of the single cell is lower, and there is no power regulation ability, the output voltage changes easily, and the generated DC is unstable, which cannot directly meet the voltage and power requirements of the motor controller. In this paper, research on some problems of fuel cell working alone. A new multi-port DC / DC converter is designed based on the traditional single bidirectional DC-DC converter, so that the auxiliary energy (super capacitor, accumulator, etc), the main power supply of fuel cells and the load are effectively combined to work together. The experimental results show that the converter has higher energy conversion efficiency and voltage conversion ratio, and Low frequency current ripple at input and output sides.

articleTitle: Power System Over-frequency Control Strategy for High Proportion of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the high proportion of renewable energy regional power grids where a large amount of power is sent out through transmission lines, transmission channel blocking leads to the over-frequency problem. Over-frequency generator tripping is a significant control measure to restrain frequency increase. Considering the over-frequency protection of wind turbines and system frequency security and stability margin, an over-frequency generator tripping control and configuration method of the scheme are proposed. The frequency stability margin index is transformed into the generator tripping quantity by analyzing system static frequency stability. The linear difference method and perturbation method are used to solve the generator tripping quantity of the scheme. And the sensitivity of frequency deviation security is analyzed. By comparing and analyzing the control effects of the over-frequency generator tripping scheme configured with different methods, the effectiveness and the adaptability of the scheme configured by the method in this paper are verified under different operation modes.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction in High Resolution ADC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The pipelined successive approximation analog to digital converter is widely used to implement the Nyquist ADC with the resolution higher than 16 bits. Its residual amplifier can contribute a significant portion of ADC total noise. The paper proposes and analyzes a noise reduction technique which is based on the auto zero method. It can be used in a closed-loop amplifier with a resistor-feedback network to reduce low-frequency noise, especially 1/f noise. The amplifier inputs are shorted to amplify its own noise which is saved in 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> stage DAC. The saved noise would be subtracted from the amplified residual signal to remove low-frequency noises. The method is verified by an 18-bit SA-ADC in a 180-nm CMOS ADC. Simulation results show that the in-band noise contribution from the residual amplifier in the ADC output is reduced by about 40%.

articleTitle: Research on Human-Computer Interaction Following Motion Based on Kinect Somatosensory Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the rapid development of somatosensory technology, now a human-computer interaction control method using somatosensory technology to control robots is proposed, which can control robots and other equipment through body motion. This paper analyzes and studies the machine vision principle of the somatosensory sensor Kinect. Based on the principle of human body recognition, it obtains real-time human body 3D modeling data, and realizes that the robot can follow the human body in real time. Instability, this article innovatively uses fuzzy logic control to establish a mathematical model of language analysis and obtains accurate control information following the motion through the calculation of the fuzzy controller to realize the trajectory control of the biomimetic robot and use MATLAB to verify the fuzzy control. The correctness of the device improves the robustness and stability of the entire system.

articleTitle: Causal analysis of vertical mill process failure based on Bayesian network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The vertical mill is a key part of the cement raw material preparation process, and it has an impact on the quality and energy consumption of the cement raw material. Because traditional manual fault judgment cannot match the criteria for cement vertical mill diagnosis as equipment reliability and production processes improve, this study offers a technique of vertical mill process fault causation analysis based on Bayesian networks. The normal operating range of process parameters is first determined using the clustering method, followed by the construction of a Bayesian network of vertical mill process failure using Bayesian theory, and finally, the causes of vertical mill process failure are investigated and the proposed method's effectiveness is verified by combining it with the vertical mill production process. The method presented in this study can be used to regulate and alter the process parameters of the cement manufacturing process in real time in order to achieve cement production stability and high quality.

articleTitle: Research on new integrated network management system based on SDN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power communication integrated network management system plays a significant role in the planning, design and maintenance of the whole power communication network. This paper analyzes the characteristics of the current power communication network and the corresponding integrated network management system, and improves the design of the existing power communication network integrated network management according to Sdn. This network management system can be used as a supplementary system for the current power system integrated network management function, realizes the global visualization of the power communication network, and provides a strong support for the operation and maintenance of the power communication network. The test running environment is built in the laboratory to realize the mapping of physical route and logical link. The preliminary verification test of the new network management system based on openflow technology is carried out, and the key design methods and ideas of the system are given.

Author Keywords: integrated network management and global visualization

articleTitle: A Stereo Matching Algorithm for Fast Extraction of Binocular Depth in Visual SLAM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the wide application of artificial intelligence in intelligent driving, visual SLAM technology has become one of the popular research areas. Binocular SLAM, as one of the cheapest cost technologies in SLAM, has become a research hotspot for many scholars. For the problems of high time consumption, poor accuracy and high mis-matching rate of traditional binocular stereo matching algorithm, an adaptive weight cost aggregation D* algorithm based on Dijkstra's idea is proposed. The algorithm improves on the local stereo matching Census algorithm, and fuses the Census algorithm and grayscale histogram in the cost matching stage to make it compatible with computational efficiency and accuracy, which can achieve real-time effect when combined with hardware acceleration. The experimental results show that the improved Census algorithm greatly improves the stereo matching accuracy, and computational efficiency. In comparison with other algorithms on the Middlebury 2.0 testbed, the improved algorithm is found to be 42% more efficient and 1.2% better in terms of mis-matching rate.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network Based on Ant Colony and Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Reactive power optimization of distribution network is an effective means to ensure the safe and economic operation of distribution network, and it is an important measure to improve the voltage quality of distribution network. The reactive power optimization of distribution network can improve the voltage distribution of distribution network system, improve the voltage quality of users, reduce the power loss of power transmission, reduce the power cost, and improve the power transmission and distribution capacity and stable operation level of distribution network. This paper studies the optimality of ant colony algorithm and artificial bee colony algorithm for distribution network reactive power optimization. Taking the minimum system active power loss as the objective function, the mathematical model of distribution network reactive power optimization is established. Based on IEEE33 node system, the simulation experiments of distribution network reactive power optimization based on ant colony algorithm and artificial bee colony algorithm are carried out respectively, and the experimental results are compared and analyzed. The experimental results show that both algorithms can improve the system node voltage, the artificial bee colony algorithm has better performance in reducing the efficiency of system active power loss, and the ant colony algorithm runs faster.

articleTitle: Research on Security Vulnerability Mining Technology for Terminals of Electric Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the specificity and complexity of the power IoT terminal, a method of power IoT terminal firmware vulnerability detection based on memory fuzzing is proposed. Use the method of bypassing the execution to simulate and run the firmware program, dynamically monitor and control the execution of the firmware program, realize the memory fuzzing test of the firmware program, design an automatic vulnerability exploitability judgment plug-in for rules and procedures, and provide power on this basis The method and specific process of the firmware vulnerability detection of the IoT terminal. The effectiveness of the method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Burst Frame Synchronization for MC-DS-CDMA System in Multipath Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Multi-Carrier Direct-Sequence Code Division Multiple Access (MC-DS-CDMA) has gradually been widely used due to its advantages of high transmission rate and multi-user access. The burst frame synchronization detection indicates the start position of the information, which is an important step in the synchronization of the MC-DS-CDMA receiver. In this paper, we propose a time-frequency two-dimensional frame synchronization model, with coherent accumulation in the time dimension and non-coherent accumulation in the frequency dimension for enhancing its performance in multipath channels. Specifically, we derive the closed-form expressions of false alarm probability and detection probability, and verify the expressions through the simulation results. Finally, we conduct the comparative simulation between the MC-DS-CDMA system with the traditional Single-Carrier Direct-Sequence Code Division Multiple Access (SC-DS-CDMA) system. The result shows that the MC-DS-CDMA system has better performance.

Author Keywords: multi-carrier direct-sequence code division multiple access (MC-DS-CDMA)

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Research of Automatic Nail Shooting Device for Screen Panel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the furniture industry develops rapidly, however it still needs a lot of manual production. Take the wooden screen panel as an example, the decoration of its covering cloth still depends on the workers' manual operation of the clothing and nailing. According to the production process and mode of office screen panel in the market, this paper designs and manufactures an automatic nailing device for screen panel, which can realize the automatic nailing and automatic nail shooting of screen panel covering cloth. At the same time, the device has a certain self-detection function. Through the design of the control system scheme and the corresponding device experiment, it is verified that the design scheme is reasonable and feasible, which can achieve the desired effect and effectively improve the production efficiency.

articleTitle: Track-association Algorithm Based on Synthetical Similar Approach Degree
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Track-association has been recognized as one of the major problems in distributed multi-sensor information fusion systems. This paper mainly discusses the track-association problem for the distributed multi-target tracking system. Synthetically considered of three kind s of measures of approach degree (Hamming distance, fuzzy nearness degree and grey association degree) between two fuzzy sets, a new algorithm named synthetical similar approach degree is put forward. And then apply this algorithm in the problem of the track-association. At last, the simulation results under the two sensor environment are given. Compared with the nearest-neighbor method and the weight method, the result show its advantage in the rate of correct correlation.

articleTitle: Application of Small World Network in the Dissemination of Unsafe Behaviors with Masks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to study the spread process of the unsafe behavior of employees wearing masks after returning to work, an SIR (virus propagation) model based on the small world network model was established to construct the propagation model of the unsafe behavior of employees wearing masks. The results show that: the SIR model based on small world network can simulate the complex propagation process involving employee behavior, and can make visual prediction on the propagation process of related violation behaviors related to wearing masks after returning to work. When the enterprise does not carry out any intervention, with the increase of enterprise scale, the time for employees who do not wear masks as required to reach 50% of the enterprise scale is longer and longer; in large-scale enterprises, the interpersonal transmission speed of employees who do not wear masks as required is faster, and the number of people growing in a single day is more likely to lead to large-scale infection. However, the effect of pre intervention is better than that of post intervention. The effective rate of intervention before and after the event has an important impact on the transmission process of not wearing masks as required. When the effective rate of enterprise control pre intervention reaches 30% or post intervention effectiveness reaches more than 50%, large-scale spread can be prevented. When the effective rate of enterprise control pre intervention reaches 70% and after intervention reaches more than 80%, it can effectively prevent the spread of non wearing masks among employees. The results showed that both pre intervention and post intervention had better effect on slowing down and preventing the spread of non wearing masks.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Grinding Temperature Field of Grooved Grinding Wheel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Grinding burns have always been a pressing problem in the grinding process. The use of grooved grinding wheels is one of the solutions. This paper focuses on the study of temperature simulations. Firstly, simulations based on a triangular heat source model and a rectangular heat source model are compared and it is concluded that a triangular heat source is more in line with the actual grinding situation; then, a method for simulating a triangular intermittent heat source for a grooved grinding wheel is proposed; finally, the variable parameters of the grinding temperature of a grooved grinding wheel are investigated. Finally, the variable parameters of the grinding temperature of the grooved grinding wheel are investigated.

articleTitle: Siamese Network with Feature Fusion for Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The visual tracking based on deep learning has developed greatly in recent years and has great advantages in accuracy and real-time speed. The target features are extracted through the backbone network. However, most networks only use the features extracted from the last layer of the network as output. In some complicated networks, the final features are mostly semantic feature information. The shallow appearance information is ignored. This greatly reduces the effective use of extracted feature information. In this study, a non-linear multi-layer feature fusion network combined with Siamese network is proposed to improve it. It uses CNN to fuse multi-layer features in a non-linear manner. The utilization of feature information and tracker performance indicators have been significantly improved. The new tracker is evaluated on the VOT2016 and UAV123 benchmarks. The result shows that the new tracker achieves very good performance and its performance has been significantly improved compared to the previous ones without the fusion network. The EAO is increased by 1.9% on VOT2016.

articleTitle: A Systematic Assessing Model of Regional Aquatic Ecosystem Health Based on Entropy Weight
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the social development and more high demand of sustainable development, more complicated problems on water ecosystem need to be deal with. To a regional sustainable development, water is the most basic condition and the regional aquatic ecosystem health is the constraint to the development. In this paper, the systematic assessment model(SAM) is proposed to assess the status the aquatic ecosystem health using systemic method. In the SAM, the indexes include 5 factors. Besides the factors about water,the human activities and area of the forest etc, are included in the index system. The factors on the system restore also take into account in the system.Through the experiment, SAM is more reasonable and comprehension than the methods which only use the water quality to assess the status of aquatic ecosystem health.

articleTitle: Local Temperature Difference Calculation Method in Infrared Test of Overhead line Composite Insulators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the temperature rise test accuracy of composite insulator heating defect, the temperature curve character was analyzed and a local temperature rise calculation method based on the composite insulator temperature curve was constructed. It is found from the field heating composite insulator that temperature variations exist in un-heating section, which could lead to positive deviation when using temperature span as the temperature rise value. The temperature curve were decomposed and reconstructed by dmey wavelet to attain the low frequency component. The zero-crossing of the low frequency component gradient and the highest point of temperature curve were utilized for obtaining the heating area range of the temperature curve, then the calculation of local temperature rise of heating defect is realized. The verification calculation of actual heating case shows that compared with the temperature span, the local temperature rise of a considerable part of insulators can be reduced by nearly 20%.

articleTitle: Interconnection Technology of FPGAs Array in Large-scale Radio Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Multi-channel digital correlator based on field programmable gate array (FPGA) has been an important component of antenna array radio astronomy detection system. However, as the scale of the antenna array keeps increasing, the amount of signal processing operations grows in a square relationship and exceeds the processing capacity of a single-FPGA. In this paper, we propose a system architecture for a digital correlation processor, which is an extensible multi-node interconnection structure with a hierarchical cascade. High throughput and instruction interaction based on electrical or optical connections was realized between nodes using high-speed transceivers. The flexibility and scalability of the whole system were improved by designing modular logic firmware, standardized data transmission, and control interface protocol. The architecture effectively solves the problem of multi-node data distribution and aggregation in a large-scale correlation system. And it realizes massive real-time correlation processing operation.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm combining tag information and rating difference
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the low calculation accuracy of similarity between users in the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm combining tag information and rating difference is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm introduces time weights to describe the dynamic change of users' interest, and defines users' preference values for tags according to tag information so as to calculate the interest similarity between users. Secondly, considering the influence of rating difference between users on recommendation effect, the algorithm uses the mean ratings as the benchmarks to calculate the rating difference between them. Finally, the algorithm comprehensively considers interest similarity and rating difference between users, generates target user's nearest neighbors and makes recommendations. The experimental results based on movieLens dataset show that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the calculation accuracy of similarity between users and the recommendation performance.

articleTitle: Stability analysis method of slow injection process based on edge detection theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The quality control of the current die-casting process is judged by parameters such as injection speed. There are certain shortcomings in practical applications. In order to better ensure the quality of die-casting, this paper proposes a slow injection process stability analysis method based on edge detection theory. Based on the monitoring data of the injection process, the idea of image edge detection is introduced. First, the color space transformation is used to convert the movement data of the slow injection process punch into image data, and then the edge detection theory canny algorithm is used to extract the fluctuation characteristics of the image data. The stability index of the slow injection process is proposed to realize the quantitative characterization of the stability of the slow injection process of die casting. The effectiveness of the method is verified by the data accumulated in the actual die-casting manufacturing process. The results show that the method in this paper can better evaluate the stability of the slow injection process and provide a new reference for the control of the die-casting process.

articleTitle: A Cross-Camera Pedestrian Retrieval Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Existing pedestrian retrieval algorithms have many problems, and we explore and optimize the algorithms. Pedestrian retrieval is the process of combining pedestrian detection and pedestrian re-identification. The existing algorithms are designed with an end-to-end framework, and we train pedestrian detection and pedestrian re-identification separately to improve the accuracy of the algorithms separately, and then do the combination during testing. In addition, global features are used to achieve advanced results rather than local features, which are slower to train. And a lightweight pedestrian detector is created, which helps the model to run and compute efficiently. Our approach is evaluated on publicly available datasets, and the results on single-domain and cross-domain scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Design and Research of a Self-powered Temperature Measurement System for Transmission Line Condition Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The development of the energy Internet has increasingly higher requirements for the perception of the status of transmission lines, and temperature measurement of transmission lines has become an important part of ensuring the stable operation of the power grid. This paper first analyzes the problems faced by different temperature measurement technologies of power transmission lines at this stage, and studies the problems of low data accuracy and poor real-time performance caused by insufficient power supply of current temperature measurement systems, and design a self-powered temperature measurement based on the transmission lines system. Finally, the design of its deployment in the transmission line is carried out, which provides a solution for the reliable and stable temperature measurement of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Compressed computational ghost imaging based on array sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Computational ghost imaging as a new imaging method, has attached the interest of many researchers. However, the practical application of computational ghost imaging is limited by the slow imaging speed of computational ghost imaging and the low quality of reconstructed images. Therefore, this paper proposes a compressed computational ghost imaging method based on array sampling, which uses the array detector to significantly increase the imaging speed of computational ghost imaging and achieve high-quality image reconstruction under low sampling times with compressed sensing. The experimental results show that the imaging method proposed in this paper achieves a speed increase of more than 4 times compared with single-pixel computing ghost imaging. Even at the sampling rate of 1.8%, high quality reconstructed images can still be obtained. Therefore, the method can promote the application of computational ghost imaging in real-time imaging, real-time detection and other fields.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Inspection System for High Voltage Transmission Tunnel Based on Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional RF radio communication and the current situation of tight spectrum resources, VLC (visible light communication) has the advantages of deep coverage, safety and reliability, anti electromagnetic interference and supporting accurate positioning. It can solve the communication problems of radio signal deep fading, electromagnetic sensitivity and other scenes in high voltage transmission tunnel. Based on a “lighting communication integration” technical scheme based on VLC and PLC, combined with the deep integration technology of VLC and PLC, this paper designs the system business architecture and technical architecture, and develops an intelligent inspection system for high voltage transmission tunnel. The system improves the tunnel construction and maintenance, cable inspection and maintenance management level, reduces the inspection personnel and power grid facilities in danger due to timely communication and accurate positioning caused by the probability of major accidents, for the safe and stable operation of power grid provides a reliable guarantee.

articleTitle: Research on non-contact measurement based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In industrial measurement, due to the limitation of working environment, it is often impossible to carry out manual measurement. Using geometric optics and image processing technology, the target can be measured indirectly through affine calculation. This paper takes the 7mm standard gauge block of national standard level 1 as the target to be measured, compares the measurement results under the environment of front and rear light sources, extracts the edge corners of the target to be measured by sub-pixel corner detection, and proposes a method to measure the target width based on iterative calculation of point line distance. For 7mm target, the calculation result is 7.052mm and the error is 0.74%, which is better than the measurement accuracy based on the minimum circumscribed rectangle.

articleTitle: A Text Code Recognition and Positioning System for Engineering Drawings of Nuclear Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a text code recognition and positioning system for engineering drawings of nuclear power equipment is designed to promote the informatization and automation of paper work created in nuclear power projects including construction procedure and maintenance procedure. Its core function is to analyze engineering drawings, and identify the user-searched code contents in them, and then extract the codes and related information, so that the staff can more quickly retrieve the required codes, obtain the drawing files containing the codes, and locate the codes on the engineering drawings precisely. The code recognition system proposed in this paper is based on the Teigha toolkit, ezdxf open source library, CRNN and PaddleOCR open source library. For engineering drawings in picture format, VGG16 is used for feature extraction of code regions. CRNN based on VGG16 is used to divide the entire coding area, and PaddleOCR is used to identify the coding information. The experiment results show that the system can be effectively used in engineering practice of nuclear power project with high usability, which can greatly improve the work efficiency of staff.

articleTitle: Principal Component Analysis Based on t-Distribution Moth Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the process of studying multivariable topics, it may be made too complex as too many variables should be considered. Thus, it is necessary to reduce variables and simplify statistical analysis, which can be realized by a statistical algorithm called principal component analysis (PCA). However, PCA has its own shortcomings, as it uses gradient ascending (GA) method to do the optimization, and makes the algorithm easy to fall into the trap of local maximum, which means that the actual optimal solution cannot be acquired properly. In this paper, a t-distribution moth swarm algorithm has been proposed so as to solve the shortcomings in traditional PCA, the proposed algorithm classifies each individual, then iterates and optimizes, and finally obtains the optimal solution in the global search.
