The robustness and effectiveness of the proposed t-distribution moth swarm algorithm in dimensionality reduction data processing has also been verified through numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the coordinated development of industries in the Optics Valley Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Optics Valley Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor plays an important role in the deep integration of sci-tech resources and promotes the coordinated development of industries. It is an important carrier for integrating sci-tech resources. This article uses a composite system synergy model to measure the synergy of the industrial collaborative development of the Optics Valley Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor. The results show that the degree of the synergy of the Optics Valley Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor industry cooperative development system has shown an upward trend year by year, reaching the highest degree of synergy in 2019, which was 0.2807.

articleTitle: Research Ideas and Analysis of The Electronic Archive Data Erasure and Destruction Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The large number of electronic archives which are stored in various storage media, provide a great convenience for electronic archives work. However, the risk of data leakage is faced, due to the storage media being retired or sent out for maintenance. In order to solve the problem of leaking electronic file data and improve the confidentiality, the development of a erase and destroy platform for electronic archive data are analysed and the application of equipment are described in detail. The equipment developed using the guiding ideas of this paper has been practically applied and good results have been obtained. The equipment developed using the ideas in this paper has been practically applied and good results have been obtained. The design ideas in the design process of the platform are dissected. Some working tips and technical key points are detailed in the process of using the platform. For other similar applications, a good solution is provided.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experiments on Current Distribution of 25MW High-Voltage Slip Ring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Through detecting contact current on the first high-voltage electric slip ring in our country, we found the current transmitted by each contact is uneven. The length of the wire connected to each contact can affect current distribution on the ring. We calculated the ratios between inner and outer rings resistance, wire resistance, and contact resistance. The results match with measured values.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Design of an Airborne Electronic Equipment with High Heat Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A thermal design of high heat consumption airborne electronic equipment is introduced. The internal flow field and heating devices of the module are simulated and analyzed by using FloEFD. The results show that under the condition of forced air cooling, when the square heat dissipation spoiler column with side length of 3 mm is spaced at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\ \text{mm}\times 5\ \text{mm}$</tex> (3 mm perpendicular to the wind direction and 5mm parallel to the wind direction), the heat dissipation capacity of the module is the best. The test results verify the correctness of the simulation results, which can provide a reference for the thermal design of similar airborne electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Irregular Shape Recognition Algorithm based on Rotation Invariant Features
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the shortcomings of the existing irregular shape recognition algorithms that has a large amount of calculation and poor resistance to scaling and rotation transformations, an irregular shape recognition algorithm based on rotation invariant features was proposed. A rotation-invariant direction vector was constructed through the central axis and mass points of the irregular shape. The projection of the irregular shape to the direction vector was calculated, and the rotation-invariant contour moment feature sequence was constructed with the average distance from the contour to the direction vector. Then the rotation invariant feature of the image was constructed by combining the projection sequence and the contour moment feature sequence. Finally, the dynamic time warping (DTW) algorithm was selected to measure the similarity of image feature sequences. The experimental results shows that the algorithm in the article has a small amount of calculation and time-consuming, meets the real-time requirements basically, has good robustness to image scaling and rotation transformation, and has certain resistance to slight perspective distortion of the image.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the economic vitality of the nine cities and prefectures in Guizhou Province based on the entropy weight-TOPSIS method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Urban economic vitality can be used to reflect the current economic development of a region and the future economic development potential, and it plays a vital role in measuring the economic competitiveness of a city. The evaluation of urban economic vitality has instructive significance for urban development, which can effectively guide the future development of cities, promote coordinated and balanced, high-quality development between cities. This article takes nine cities and prefectures in Guizhou as the evaluation object, establishes the evaluation index of urban economic vitality, and uses the entropy method to objectively assign weights to the original index data. The purpose is to eliminate the strong subjective evaluation results caused by the decision makers based on the experience of assigning index weights. The shortcomings of sex, and then sort the evaluation objects through the sorting method that is close to the ideal solution. The result is that the economic vitality rankings of the nine prefectures in Guizhou are: Guiyang City, Zunyi City, Qianxinan Prefecture, Qiannan Prefecture, Bijie City, Qiandongnan Prefecture, Liupanshui City, Anshun City, and Tongren City.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Ecological Environment in Futuanhe Nature Reserve Based on Remote Sensing Ecological Index
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The remote sensing ecological index is an index to evaluate the quality of the ecological environment, which is obtained through principal component analysis on the basis of 4 ecological indicators. Based on Landsat8 satellite data, this paper uses the Remote Sensing Ecological Index Model (RSEI) to evaluate the ecological environment quality of the Futuan River Nature Reserve in 2020. The index model is constructed based on four indicators: humidity index (WET), greenness index (NDVI), heat index (LST), and dryness index (NDBSI). The remote sensing image data is processed using ENVI software to obtain 4 Then, the remote sensing ecological index (RSEI) is obtained through principal component analysis, and the evaluation and comprehensive comparative analysis are carried out in combination with each index factor. The results show that the remote sensing ecological index of the Futuan River Nature Reserve in 2020 is 0.639, and the overall environmental quality evaluation level is good. The vegetation coverage in the area is high, the biodiversity is rich, the soil organic matter is rich, the climate is suitable, and it is suitable for human habitation.

articleTitle: Research on temperature and humidity decoupling control of process air conditioning in cigarette factory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the requirements of production process, the production area of cigarette factory is generally equipped with large process air conditioner to realize high-precision constant temperature and humidity control. Under the typical software and hardware configuration and classical PID control algorithm, the coupling phenomenon of temperature and humidity exists in humidification condition and cooling and dehumidification condition, resulting in the deterioration of the dynamic response performance of the system. In this paper, the decoupling controller of each link is designed, and a split compensation algorithm is further proposed to eliminate the adverse effects caused by coupling. Matlab simulation results show that the design can greatly improve the dynamic response performance of temperature and humidity control.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of wideband detection of airborne maritime surveillance radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Airborne maritime surveillance radar adopts wideband signal and fast scanning technology to ensure the detection of slow moving targets in strong sea clutter background. The selection of signal bandwidth is a problem of multi-discipline. The paper first makes an analysis of the optimum detection theory in clutter background, then makes an evaluation of the influencing factor from Radar Cross Section (RCS) value of clutter, clutter amplitude distribution, clutter spatial correlation, false alarm rate constraint and frequency agility characteristics, makes a simulation of the minimum detection RCS of the radar for different distance resolution. As radar's distance resolution increases, the detection ability up-growth is not so obvious, the paper presents the advises that compromise between capability and implementation complexity play an important role in radar design and performance prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of the vibration characteristics of the transformer based on the Hilbert-Huang Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Transformer can produce vibration in the working status, in this article, through analyzing the characteristic of the transformer normal vibration signal, based on the Hilport-yellow algorithm for transformer condition monitoring, in order to further, realize the transformer fault diagnosis of transformer fault type, generally the severity of the failure positions, failure and failure trend of the development of provides a new train of thought. It reduces the probability of transformer failure and has important guiding significance for safe production and safe operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Ultrasonic Multi-function Ranging System Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a simple low-cost ultrasonic ranging method controlled by a single chip microcomputer. We use 51 micro controllers and HC-SR04 to achieve distance measurement. We give the hardware device connection scheme, complete the software and hardware design and simulation. The range finder system we designed can accurately show the number. Able to give a beep alarm and LED flash at close range. We can display the measurement distance and threshold distance with a nibble tube or LCD1602. The simple scheme implemented in this paper can be used in large-scale experimental teaching equipment, car reversing radar, vehicle alarm and other scenarios.

articleTitle: Evaluation of service level of power trading hall based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Facing the new requirements of optimizing the business environment under the new power reform situation, based on the functional positioning of the power trading center, strengthen the service attribute of the power trading center, and establish a service level evaluation method for the power trading center. On the basis of combing the functional business of the power trading center, this paper establishes the service evaluation index, constructs the service evaluation system, and puts forward the service level evaluation method of the power trading hall based on analytic hierarchy process from four aspects: the power trading hall, the power trading online platform, the management mode of the power trading center and the main business of the power trading center, Analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the trading center and putting forward corresponding improvement measures will help to further improve the service level of the power trading center.

articleTitle: Application Research of online label defect detection based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In industrial production, label is one of the important marks of products. In order to ensure the label quality, a visual on-line detection method is proposed to detect the label quality in the production line in real time. By building an image acquisition system to complete the image acquisition of the label, the text image information and identification image information in the label are highlighted by binarization, the region in the label is segmented and detected by morphological operation, a variety of detection methods are compared, and the histogram matching is selected to detect the label in different regions in combination with the needs of online detection. Taking the qualified label as the detection standard sample and using the designed system to detect the defective label, the defective area can be detected and located, and the detection cycle is 10.03ms, which can meet the basic online detection requirements

articleTitle: Power data classification processing method based on isolation forest
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the amount of power grid data, the traditional method is to remotely transmit data to the cloud for equipment fault classification and detection. When a fault occurs on the equipment side, it is often unable to respond and deal with it in time, which brings security risks to power grid equipment. The current variable selection research on network connectivity data is mainly aimed at homogeneous samples, that is, the individual effects α of the samples are the same, but in reality, the individual effects of most samples are heterogeneous, without considering the heterogeneity. will cause a large deviation in the estimation and prediction of the model. Therefore, when there is group heterogeneity in the individual effect in the network data, this paper proposes a new variable selection method. Using the network cohesion effect, we analyze the variable coefficients and connected sample individuals At the same time, the isolated forest algorithm is used to solve the problem, and the convergence of the algorithm is proved. Numerical simulation and empirical analysis show that our method improves the accuracy of variable selection and reduces the prediction error.

Author Keywords: long and short memory neural network

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Model of Generation Dispatching for Medium and Long-term Electricity Contracts Based on CPLEX Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the market development stage where only medium and long-term power transactions are carried out, the article studies and proposes a multi-period power generation dispatching optimization model based on medium and long-term electricity contracts. Aiming at the medium and long-term electricity trading market before the establishment of the spot market, a pre-bidding monthly deviation electricity balance mechanism was proposed; on this basis, considering factors such as load demand forecast deviation, unit operation constraints, and grid operation constraints, a monthly forecast was constructed. A multi-period power generation dispatching optimization model with rolling revision of power generation plan, day-ahead power generation decomposition and power generation plan optimization, and intra-day power generation plan adjustment. The simulation results show that the mechanism and model can minimize the cost of monthly deviation electricity adjustment while ensuring the safe operation of the power grid, and at the same time realize the substitution of low-cost units for high-cost units, and improve the economics of system operation.

articleTitle: Applies to DSSC Model Predictive Control Research of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the system with strong load fluctuation and uncertainty, it is difficult for DSSC to achieve fast and stable tracking of the target. In order to solve this problem. Firstly, this paper sets up the mathematical model of DSSC electric converter based on the topological structure of DSSC and the working principle of DSSC. Then the DSSC model predictive control is introduced for the system with strong load fluctuation and high uncertainty and analyzed qualitatively the advantages and disadvantages of the DSSC Finite Control Set MPC method. In order to optimize the shortcomings of the Finite Control Set MPC mentioned above, a power control strategy of DSSC based on predictive model is proposed. The power control strategy of DSSC with the direct control target of power predict the output voltage of DSSC and reconstructs the prediction model of DSSC. This strategy is verified by simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC software.

articleTitle: Editable Blockchain Scheme Based on Shamir Chameleon Hash Secret Sharing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Blockchain has attracted extensive attention because of its decentralized and tamper-proof characteristics. However, with the vigorous development of blockchain, problems also follow. Once the data is stored in the blockchain, it cannot be tampered with, making the blockchain an extrajudicial place for low-cost cybercrime. Criminals use the blockchain to store pornographic, attack scripts, dark network service addresses and other lousy information; Even if the blockchain is used commonly, it will encounter a series of problems, such as that malicious transactions cannot be eradicated and wrong transactions cannot be modified. Therefore, the editable blockchain scheme under specific conditions has broad application prospects. This paper proposes an editable blockchain scheme based on Shamir chameleon hash key sharing. Using the characteristics of chameleon hash, the overall structure of the edited blockchain is not affected. Shamir key sharing algorithm can ensure that each editing is the collective will of nodes. Simulation results show that this scheme has higher security and compatibility than similar schemes.

articleTitle: Gaussian Process for the Machine Learning-based Smart fire Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Smart fire detection systems should be able to detect the fire and trigger the automatic alarm at an early stage. It should also trigger the automatic fire extinguishing system and broadcast the fire alarm under different fire conditions. Due to the strict detection accuracy requirement of the fire detection system, most of the modern smart fire detection systems are based on multi-sensor, or image/video surveillance system to reinforce its fast reaction and high reliability in the action process. In this paper, the multi-sensor detection system is combined with image recognition process. Image recognition is utilized to help the fire detection, when the decision from the multi-sensor system is uncertain or the data is not available/faulty. Image features are extracted by using machine learning methods. Then, the Gaussian classification method is applied to detect the specific fire case. Images from real environments are used to evaluate the proposed method. In addition, we investigate and discuss the detection results when the training data is adequate or inadequate, which verifies that the image-based fire detection scheme combined with multi-sensor system can achieve better accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Wireless TDOA Positioning Station Synchronization Based on RTL-SDR
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high precision time synchronization between station signals and high hardware cost in wireless TDOA positioning, a method of high precision time synchronization between station signals with low cost was proposed by using RTL-SDR TV stick as station signal receiver. Chengdu FM 102.6 Mhz radio station was taken as the synchronization time standard, and the synchronization error of the radiation source signal and the radio signal was estimated by two TV sticks. The GCC correlation algorithm was used to carry out the composite signal correlation calculation, and then the integer and decimal delay filtering was used to carry out the precision synchronization of the signals between the stations. In the proposed time synchro-nization implementation method, when using 100 ppm and 1 ppm built-in crystal oscillator receiving equipment, the accuracy of time synchronization error calculated by the station is 400 ns and 200 ns respectively. The 1 ppm equipment has a better synchronization accuracy range, which meets the synchronization accuracy requirements in general scenarios. The experimental results show that the RTL-SDR device can achieve the synchronization accuracy of wireless TDOA positioning time and frequency, and the hardware cost is much lower than the market synchronization equipment.

articleTitle: Minimum variance and range-based k-means optimization algorithm-Rdk-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To address the problem that the traditional k-means randomly generates initialized centroids leading to the instability of the algorithm, Rdk-means (Range and density k-means) is proposed to improve the clustering algorithm. The algorithm introduces the concept of global density to select sample points. The centroids are initialized by selecting the sample points with the maximum density and distributed by a certain distance. At the same time, the concept of spatial location is introduced in the process of sample partitioning to filter out the centroids that are closer to each sample point, thus avoiding unnecessary centroid distance calculation and optimizing the shortage of longer clustering time caused by the initialization centroid process. Through experimental validation and analysis, the algorithm has been improved in clustering effect and stability.

articleTitle: Source-load-storage Control Strategy and Optimization Configuration of Energy Storage based on Time-of-use Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Energy storage is an important measure to solve renewable energy consumption and improve the reliability of system operation. Different operation modes, typical load characteristics, and renewable energy output characteristics affect the energy storage capacity configuration results. In this paper, the optimal configuration model of energy storage capacity is established to minimize the configuration capacity of system energy storage based on the actual demand of the power grid. Then, under the constraints of power balance, renewable energy consumption, charge and discharge of energy storage system and economy, the source-load-storage control strategy based on time-of-use electricity price is proposed, and the optimization model is solved. Finally, an example is given to analyze and verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on multi-end trust based on blockchain in distribution network business
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of 5G communication application in the field of power Internet of Things, a large number of terminal devices are widely distributed in the distribution network, and a large amount of data needs to be trusted in a relatively short time.The traditional manual inspection method is inefficient and has insufficient safety protection. This paper first analyzes some common consensus mechanisms, and then proposes an improved consensus mechanism, which inhibits the phenomenon of node dishonesty and reduces the hidden danger of data security by means of proof of reputation (PoR).

articleTitle: Development of A New Standard Metal Tank Based on Automatic Control and Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper introduces an automatic reading device of standard metal tank based on image recognition and automatic control technology. The device can identify the lowest point of the concave liquid level in the liquid level pipe of the standard metal tank, and automatically read the value of the metering neck to calculate the liquid volume in the tank. It solves the problem that the difference of liquid level reading caused by different line of sight angle in manual reading, which leads to the difference of liquid volume calculation. The first class standard metal tank is used for capacity comparison, while the difference between automatic reading and manual reading of 20L standard liquid volume is no more than 0.03%. This work provides a feasible direction for the develop and improvement of new standard metal tank in the future.

articleTitle: Modeling and Application of Transmission Line Panoramic Monitoring Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The power grid has gradually developed into a complex system, and the transmission lines are all over different geographical and climatic regions. The continuous change of climate has led to great challenges to the security of the power grid. The safe operation of transmission line is the basis for ensuring the safe and economic operation of power grid, and it is also the main asset of power enterprises. It is of great significance to build a transmission line panoramic monitoring platform that can comprehensively monitor, fault diagnosis and condition evaluation of transmission line. The transmission line panoramic monitoring platform is an important part of pms3.0, It is the implementation practice of digital transformation of transmission specialty in the construction of pms3.0 system, which scientifically improves the availability of transmission lines and the stability and safety of power grid operation. Considering the advantages of the application of Internet of things technology in transmission line on-line monitoring, this paper establishes a standardized panoramic information model based on the physical space, information space and application space of transmission line, and provides a general data interface to meet the data sharing between different systems and eliminate the problem of multi-source heterogeneity of information in multiple information systems in power system, It has important theoretical and practical significance for the realization of panoramic information integration platform for condition monitoring of power transmission and transformation equipment.

articleTitle: Video Traffic Volume Extraction Based on Onelevel Feature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a single-level feature detector network based on YOLOF is built to detect objects and extract traffic volume information for videos. YOLOF does not have a multi-scale feature fusion structure (such as FPN, PAN). It uses the dilated encoder and uniform matching method to replace the fusion feature module, which simplifies the network structure and improves the response time while maintaining good accuracy. Finally, the target tracking algorithm is used to obtain the traffic flow statistics in the video sequence. Generally speaking, YOLOF has higher detection performance and faster speed than RetinaNet, DETR and other networks of similar structure.

articleTitle: Copy-Move Forgery Detection Algorithm based on Feature Point Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the high time complexity of the feature matching stage of the current copy-move forgery detection algorithm, an image copy-move forgery detection algorithm using structure tensor and HSV color model to cluster feature points is proposed. First, cluster the SIFT feature points based on the structure tensor, and divide all feature points into flat feature points, edge feature points, and corner feature points, which are divided into 3 clusters; Then, based on the clustering method of HSV color model, the feature points are divided into 63 clusters. Finally, feature matching is carried out in each cluster, which makes full use of the similarity of texture and color between the source region and the tampered region, effectively reduces the time of feature matching and improves the efficiency of the algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively detect tampered areas, has a greater advantage in matching time, and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Design of Marine Environmental Protection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It uses the camera to collect face and ocean image information, and realizes face input and robot automatic startup based on OpenCV visual library. The main controller uses Raspberry Pi 4B and STM32 to monitor the video information on the ocean in real time according to the camera, control the robot to move and pick up garbage, remotely control the robot through Wi-Fi wireless communication, and use the turbidity sensor to collect and display the current ocean turbidity information during the robot movement. This design has the characteristics of low cost, simple and friendly GUI interface, good stability and so on.

articleTitle: Detection Efficiency Evaluation of Mobile Radar based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multiple factors affecting the detection capability of mobile radar, this paper puts forward the detection effectiveness evaluation method of mobile radar based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, establishes the three-level evaluation index system of mobile radar detection capability comprehensively, and evaluates the detection capability of mobile radar scientifically by using the theory of fuzzy mathematics. The evaluation method of detection efficiency of fixed radar is applied flexibly to mobile radar, and the factors affecting detection ability of mobile radar are analyzed comprehensively, which solves the lodo target decision problem by combining the advantages of qualitative and quantitative analysis. The experimental results show that the method is simple and feasible, which provides a reliable decision-making basis for the deployment and application of mobile radar.

articleTitle: Design of Laboratory Fire Safety Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Laboratory safety is related to life safety and property safety, prevention and monitoring are the key factors to improve the safety level. Therefore, it is of great significance to study a fire safety monitoring system to monitor the influencing factors in real time and improve the laboratory safety factor. This paper takes the laboratory as the research object, designs a laboratory fire safety monitoring system based on QTouch and STM32, which is used in the daily safety monitoring of the laboratory, using sensors and active equipment as technical means, upload and release with microcontroller as the center, adopt Modbus data communication protocol, the configuration QTouch is used as the host computer to realize the monitoring and control of on-site parameters. The experimental results show that the system data test is stable and meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of “Tripartite and Bilateral” Space Deterrence Based on Signaling Game
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A “tripartite and bilateral” dynamic game model was constructed to study the impact of space deterrence on the challenger's military strategy in a military conflict. Based on the signal game theory, the payment matrices and optimal strategies of the sheltering side and challenging side were analyzed. In a theoretical framework, the indicators of the effectiveness of the challenger's response to space deterrence and the influencing factors of the sheltering's space deterrence were examined. The feasibility and effective means for the challenger to respond to the space deterrent in a “tripartite and bilateral” military conflict were concluded.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Roaming System Design Based on Motor Imagery-Based Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To increase the immersion for brain-computer interface (BCI)-visual scene system, a brain-controlled virtual reality (VR) roaming system in museum scene is designed in this paper using MI-based BCI and virtual reality engine. Firstly, an online logarithmic band power (LBP) feature extraction algorithm combined with support vector machine (SVM) classifier is applied to recognize the left / right motor intentions. Secondly, a real-time communication mechanism between BCI platform and virtual scene is established to real-time control the virtual human in the virtual scene based on the recognition results. Then, a newly designed VR museum scene is accomplished by Unity engine to make subjects feel more relaxed and immersed. Finally, experimental results reveal that the motor imagery tasks of left / right hand are distinguished online effectively, and the virtual reality roaming scene is driven accurately in real time by the proposed system.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Detection Method of Machine Tool Rotation Axis Angle Based on Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Bionic surface has been widely concerned in aerospace, shipping, medical and other fields because of its special function. Machining is an important method to fabricate periodic bionic textured surface. The angle motion precision of rotation axis is one of the key factors affecting surface texture. In this paper, the angle detection method based on gyroscope is studied, and the machine tool rotation axis angle wireless detection device is developed. The detection device can detect the accuracy of the rotation angle of the machine tool rotation axis, transmit the information wirelessly and stably at the sampling frequency of 50–200Hz, and display and store the detection data in the self-developed software. Finally, the experiment carried out on the metrology-grade rotation axis to verify the detection accuracy of the device. The angle wireless detection method and device studied in this paper are convenient and effective, which is of great significance to realize the pose monitoring of five-axis CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Theoretical channel simulation modeling and software implementation in quantum secure communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Through the technical means of computer simulation modeling and calculation, this paper systematically studies the influence of different kinds of communication channels on the key indexes such as bit error rate and communication rate of quantum communication system represented by quantum secure communication system. For the theoretical channels such as bit flip channel and phase flip channel, the transformation model of quantum state is analyzed, the mathematical model of actual physical dimension parameter transformation is established, and the software is designed and implemented.

articleTitle: Application of electric field coupling method in electric energy measurement for high voltage lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The power consumption of each branch of 10-35kV high voltage line should be measured in real time, so as to centrally manage and count the power demand of power consuming enterprises and power consuming equipment. Considering the problems of huge volume of metering equipment and inconvenient to carry in traditional metering methods, a new high voltage line power metering method is proposed according to the power metering requirements of 10-35kV line. This method mainly uses the principle of coupling between three-phase electric fields to obtain the phase signal of high-voltage line, uses the principle of current mutual inductance to measure the current signal, uses the special electric energy metering chip IDT-90e36 and microprocessor to measure the phase difference, current RMS and current harmonic of transmission line voltage and current, and carries out data transmission through wireless transmission technology. Through the above technology, the separation of high pressure and low pressure is realized to ensure the safety of testers. Finally, a high-voltage line energy metering device is designed by using the above method, which meets the design requirements through field measurement.

articleTitle: Design and Control Method of Power Conversion System for Emergency Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power conversion system is the key equipment to realize two-way energy transfer between energy storage battery and AC power grid. This paper introduces a design and control method of power conversion system for emergency power supply. The power conversion system can select grid connected operation or independent on load operation to meet the multi scenario application requirements of emergency power supply site. During grid connected operation, the input power is controlled by controlling the input current, and then the output voltage at the DC side is controlled. During independent load operation, the load voltage and frequency are controlled by controlling the output voltage amplitude and frequency of the converter. The proposed constant voltage current limiting control strategy can maintain the DC bus voltage near the reference value and improve the reliability of battery charge and discharge.

articleTitle: Answer Sentence Selection Method based on Multi-granularity Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The development of question and answer technology is of great significance to the rapid processing of Internet information. The selection of candidate answer sentences is an important part of the question and answer (QA) system, and its accuracy will directly affect the effect of answer extraction. To solve the problem of insufficient feature interaction between question and answer sentences, this paper proposes a candidate answer sentence selection method based on Multi-granularity attention. The method used a Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BLSTM) network to encode the words in the sentence, and then use the attention mechanism to obtain the relationship between sentences and words, words and words. The result of experiments on DBQA dataset show that our method can learn the relationship between question and answer sentences from different granularity of sentences and words, and improve the selection effect of answer sentences.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Multi-agent Cooperative Search Control Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning on Uneven Terrains
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Anti-flocking algorithm for multi-agent to search a given area of interest(AOI) has been relatively mature. Multi-agent is basically used to search for uneven terrain, but the most existing anti-flocking algorithms are designed for flat terrain, so agents often use the shortest path to move between navigation targets. Using the shortest path to move in uneven terrain will consume more energy. At present, agents basically use portable energy to provide power, so we should try to reduce energy consumption. This brief proposes an energy-efficient multi-agent cooperative search control based on deep reinforcement learning on uneven terrains. The proposed algorithm selects the navigation target points through deep reinforcement learning, and encourages the agent to move between the navigation target points along the contour line. Simulation results show that the proposed control protocol is a promising energy-efficient solution for multi-agent operating on uneven terrains.

articleTitle: Applied Research on Large Area Water Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In present graphics application interfaces, the addition of Computer Shader makes some complex paralleled computations extremely convenient. Nowadays, it has become the mainstream method for ocean rendering in big games that using Compute Shader for Fourier variation to generate the height field of seawater, utilizing octree to create multi-level details of the ocean plane. Using SSR (Screen Space Reflection) technique, Fresnel effect and BRDF (Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function) model can achieve a much realistic ocean water surface simulation result. Experiments prove that the algorithm can meet the current requirements of real-time rendering well and attain a great balance between rendering efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Cloud-Based Smart Legal Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, there are approximately 44,000 law firms and some legal aid agencies in China. However, the distribution of legal resources is not balanced. Legal organizations are mostly concentrated in economically developed areas. However, the lack of legal organizations in economically backward cities has a low quality, and it is difficult to meet people's legal needs. To solve this problem, develop a collaborative, open, shared, multi-organization, multi-tenant smart legal service cloud platform, connect remote legal organizations to the platform, sort and analyze legal organization data, and build a legal organization profile and legal organization The recommendation model provides services for people seeking legal help to push legal organizations, and transforms legal organization entities and legal services into digital legal organizations and legal services, thereby connecting legal organizations in different places and people seeking legal help, and solving the backward economic development Areas where people find legal help with difficult problems.

articleTitle: An Improved GA-based Approach for UAV Swarm Formation Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) swarm formation has drawn the attention of researchers in various military and civilian domains. Formation transformation is also a significant issue for the swarm of UAV. This article studies the transformation of UAV formation problem, and a modified formation transformation method based on genetic algorithm for UAV swarm in 3D environment is developed to improve the efficiency of UAV formation. In our method, firstly, variable mutation rate is used in the genetic algorithm to increase or reduce the mutation rate in the iteration of the algorithm. At the same time, the population is grouped before the crossover operation according to the fitness value. These strategies can not only maintain the speed of the algorithm, but can also avoid the premature convergence to the local optimum and find a better solution. Then, the shortest total flight length of UAV swarm and the shortest formation completion time are formalized as two different problems respectively. Comparison experiment indicated that our proposed methodology can provide a better solution in comparison to conventional methods and particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, the comprehensive experiment in UAV simulation platform, named XTDrone, is conducted and the feasibility of the proposed method is validated.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Dual-Band Stacked Structure Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This letter describes the construction of a dual circularly polarized satellite navigation microstrip antenna that operates in the B2b and L bands of BDS. The unit is a double-fed double-layer laminated structure, with miniaturization achieved through high dielectric constant and thick dielectric thickness; the isolation between the ports is improved by fitting a ring of metal holes surrounding the probes leading to the top patch; impedance matching is accomplished through the inclusion of a C-shaped slot loaded in the top patch. The simulation results show the isolation between the ports is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${S_{21}\,<\, - 26dB}$</tex> (1.196~1.217GHz) and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${S_{21}\,<\, - 20.2dB}$</tex> (1.611~1.627GHz); At 1.207 and 1.62GHz, RHCP gain of 5.12 dB and LHCP gain of 5.92 dB are also observed.

articleTitle: Power data quality inspection method based on improved particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the shortcomings of particle swarm optimization algorithms that are easy to fall into local extremes and slow convergence speed and low accuracy in the later stage of evolution, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm that integrates multiple strategies for power grid data quality exploration is proposed. By adopting a grouping control strategy, According to fitness value, the population is divided into superior solution group and inferior solution group. The superior solution group performs genetic crossover operation, the inferior solution group performs mutation operation, and the elite strategy is used to update the population, improve the particle learning mode, and make full use of the population information to improve The mean value of the population replaces the optimal position of the individual, and probabilistic control is introduced to control the probability of the algorithm entering the crossover and mutation operations. The simulation results of the test function show that the improved algorithm can effectively take into account the global exploration and local mining capabilities, and has fast convergence speed and solution The advantages of high accuracy and avoiding local optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Model of Space-based TT &C Network Based on Time-Space Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: During the operation of space-based TT &C network, a series of space user nodes such as launch vehicle, remote sensing satellite, deep space detector, space station and missile need to be considered. These nodes operate at high speed in orbit, which makes the links between them change in real time and connect intermittently. The topology of the network evolves with time. The traditional static graph mathematical models are difficult to describe this time-varying topology, so the corresponding dynamic graph model must be studied. To solve this problem, this paper analyzes the evolution mechanism of the link by using the theories of celestial mechanics and time-varying graph, constructs the dynamic model of space-based TT &C network, extracts the key indicators of the dynamic network model, and studies the main impact of satellite node movement and link change on the network model.

articleTitle: Linear displacement sensors based on the anisotropic magnetoresistance effect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study introduces the basic principle of anisotropic magnetoresistive sensors and proposes a high-precision displacement sensor based on the anisotropic magnetoresistive effect. The sensor consists of an anisotropic magnetoresistive probe, an analog-to-digital converter, and a microcontroller. The relationship between the output voltage and the displacement of the magnetoresistive chip is analyzed, and a linear input and output fitting algorithm is obtained. The experimental results show that the error of the displacement sensor is less than 0.6% and the linearity is better than 0.3%, which meet the requirements of practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Potential Energy Recovery Technology of Bridge Crane Lifting Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to realize energy saving and emission reduction of bridge crane, potential energy recovery technology is applied to lifting mechanism of bridge crane. On the basis of analyzing the working principle of the accumulator, the potential energy recovery system model is created. The simulation analysis is studied by using simulation software SimulationX, and reasonable potential energy recovery system parameters is got. The results show that when the load mass is IOT, the displacement of variable pump/motor is 230mL/r, the speed is 1450r/min, and the accumulator capacity is 63L, the recovered gravitational potential energy accounted for 17.76%. The potential energy of bridge crane hoisting mechanism is proved the feasibility of recycling technology, which provides a theoretical basis for the next physical prototype test and future engineering application.

articleTitle: Exploratory Research on The Functional Surface Texture Generation Based on Ball-end Tool Machining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a hot spot of attention and research, the bionic functional surface has been widely used in the fields of national defense and people's livelihood. Machining is one of the effective methods to generate bionic functional surfaces. In this paper, a new method to generate surface texture structures by using cutting residues of ball-end tool machining is proposed. The influence of machining parameters on texture structure and surface function was analyzed by establishing a simulation model of surface texture generation. The study shows that the surface texture structure can be generated directly by the residual height of the ball-end tool machining, and the surface function performance varies with the difference of the machining parameters. This study provides a new idea for surface texture generation, and also provides a reference for the planning and optimization of milling parameters of ball-end tool.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of Mobile Manipulator based on Floating-Like Base
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve strong dynamic coupling problem between manipulator and mobile base, a a floating-like base method was proposed. In this paper, the model of the mobile manipulator is regarded as a combination of a floating-like base and a fixed manipulator. During the movement of the mobile manipulator, the mobile base provides three degrees of freedom. This three degrees of freedom can be converted into three virtual member bar, which connect the manipulator and the ground. In this way, the dynamic modeling of the mobile manipulator is carried out based on the floating-like base, and then the floating-like base is converted into a fixed base for dynamic calculation.

articleTitle: Construction of Troposcatter Communication Channel Model Based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Troposcatter communication is an over-the-horizon communication method using atmospheric scattering propagation phenomenon. Compared with conventional wireless communication means, troposcatter communication has stronger ability of destruction resistance, disturbance resistance, interception resistance and obstacle crossing, so it always plays an important role in radio communication, especially in the field of military communication. By analyzing the characteristics of troposcatter communication channel, this paper builds a scattering channel model based on OPNET network simulation software that can reflect the transmission loss characteristics of troposcatter communication, providing a reasonable and reliable channel model reference for further in-depth simulation demonstration of troposcatter communication.

articleTitle: Abnormal Fault Analysis of Current Transformer Based on Multiple Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In 2020, multiple abnormal tensile faults of normal current transformer expansion were occurred continuously, which brought serious harm to the safe and stable operation of the power network. Through the comparison and analysis of this type of current transformer, it is found that the chromatographic data are generally abnormal. Hydrogen, methane, ethane, total hydrocarbon exceed the standard, and some transformers have trace acetylene, but carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide are not involved. At the same time, the transformer expander is extraordinarily stretched, part of the expander top cover falls to the ground. In addition, it is generally difficult to find the discharge point through the breakdown of factory, but the accident time is concentrated in the alternate winter and spring season. In this paper, the fault reason of the current transformer of this type is analyzed and summarized by the case of a 220kV current transformer A phase return factory, and the corresponding suggestions are put forward for the operation and maintenance of the later-stage current transformer.

articleTitle: Collaborative Analysis and Processing Technology of Electric Power Business Based on 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The 5G network infrastructure has been fully developed and put into use, which allows users to experience high bandwidth, extremely low latency, and long connectivity, bringing unprecedented changes to today's society. This paper aims to explore the collaborative analysis and processing technology of power business based on the 5G network. First, the modern smart grid services are analyzed, the power service QoS requirements of 5G network are summarized. Then, the basic technologies for 5G application collaboration scenarios are proposed, such as content caching technology, UE-to-Network assistive technology. At last, this paper analyze the impact of different user densities and D2D distance limits on the success probability of caching under different demand allocation and caching procedures, as well as the impact of cache auxiliary throughput. The test results show that when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\gamma} = 0.2$</tex>, according to the most common cache program algorithm, the function of cache auxiliary throughput is the smallest; User weight density has a significant impact on the selected caching strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear System Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article introduces the principles, algorithm flow and key technologies of the three non-linear filters: the unscented Kalman filter (UKF), cubature Kalman filter (CKF) and the particle filter (PF); then analyzes the UT transformation principle and sampling strategy in the UKF algorithm, the volume rule of the CKF algorithm, and the PF algorithm Sequential importance sampling, resampling, particle degradation and scarcity and other issues. The performance analysis of the advantages and disadvantages, scope of application, accuracy and complexity of the three nonlinear filtering algorithms are given.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture Design Method of Joint Information Environment of Space-based Network Information System based on Multi-viewpoint
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the design goal of the joint information environment architecture of space-based network information system, this paper proposes the basic framework and design process of the joint information environment architecture of space-based network information system according to the multi-viewpoint design idea of “competency-based, information-oriented and service-oriented”. The view models of Capability Conception CV-1, Information Activity Model IAV-1, Advanced Operational Concept Diagram OV-1, System Composition Description Diagram SV-1 and Information Service List SvcV-1 are constructed, which provide theoretical basis and technical reference for the research of joint information environment of space-based network information system.

articleTitle: Self-tracking technology of Frequency hopping signal based on digital phased array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of anti-interference measurement and control, frequency hopping signals avoid interference signals from the frequency domain, and good performance gains can be obtained in the environment of broadband white noise interference. [1]The all-digital phased array antenna achieves the purpose of adjusting and controlling the main part of the direction by digitally weighting the sampled signals of each element, and can realize the tracking of multiple beams at the same time. [2]This technology adopts an all-digital phased array frequency hopping system to realize the de-hop function of band-pass sampling signal and frequency hopping local oscillator mixing, and then perform digital phase modulation to realize term shifting and beamforming. This technology realizes de-hopping and beam tracking in the digital domain, saves analog phase shifters, and improves user capacity from the two dimensions of space and frequency.

articleTitle: Method of Emergence Communication Topology Planning based on MGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a topology planning method for emergency communication network based on a multi-group co-evolution algorithm. Two initial populations based on uniform deployment and neighboring deployment are constructed, and population crossover and mutation operations based on variable-length strings are designed. The strategy of multi-group co-evolution is used to update the elite population, which improves the problem of low search efficiency and easy to fall into local optimal solutions when the communication network topology is planned and solved. Simulation analysis shows that compared with the traditional single-population evolutionary algorithm, this method can significantly improve the search efficiency. It can be used to assist communication personnel in drawing up network organization schemes and planning communication network topology, which has good theoretical and application value.

articleTitle: Modified Model of Squeeze Film Gas Damping of Circular Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Squeeze film damping is an important damping mechanism in MEMS resonators. Considering the end effect of MEMS squeeze film structure, Veijola modified the squeeze film damping model of Reynolds equation, and proposed a modified model for rectangular plates, but Veijola did not give a modified model of squeeze film damping of circular plate. In this paper, based on Vejiola's theory, the calculated size is corrected for the squeeze film of the circular plate, and establish a circular plate squeeze film damping modified model, which is verified by numerical simulation. The research results show that the damping error between the modified model and the numerical model is very small, with a mean error less than 1 %, while the unmodified model has an error of more than 7%. This paper also discusses the influence of the size of the circular plate radius and gap height on the end effect. It is found that the larger the radius of the circular plates and the smaller the height of the gap, the smaller the influence of the end effect on the squeeze film damping.

articleTitle: Improvement of DV-Hop Algorithm based on Error Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Node localization technology has an extremely important position in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), and the mutual transmission of information in WSNs is meaningless without localization. Since GPS circuit hardware is expensive and has a high demand for sensor energy, making the sensors increase the cost of maintenance, and when the wireless network is deployed on a large scale, the hardware cost becomes considerable. WSN localization techniques can be broadly classified into two categories: range-based and range-less, as the latter is widely used in various fields due to its low hardware requirements. The DV-Hop algorithm is one of the most commonly used WSN localization techniques without range. In this paper, we propose improvements to the DV-Hop algorithm to address the shortcomings of each of the three aspects of the algorithm and conduct simulation experiments through Matlab to verify that the improved algorithm significantly reduces the positioning error compared with the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Fusion Model for Precipitation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new fusion model is established based on the regression (ARIMA) model and BP (Back Propagation) neural network prediction model, which is used to predict the precipitation in Henan Province. In the Henan Statistical Yearbook, the precipitation in Henan can be obtained for nearly 20 years. Firstly, the differential integrated mobile mean auto regression (ARIMA) model is used to fit the future data according to the relationship between the precipitation and the time series. Secondly, BP (back propagation) neural network prediction model is used to establish a linear relationship between dependent and independent variables. These two models have both their own disadvantages, so we can combine the two models together to get a new fusion model. The precipitation of Henan province in the next 8 years can be well predicted by using the new fusion model.

articleTitle: Research on Early Warning of Transmission Line Hidden Trouble Based on Improved YOLOV4 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the wide range of power transmission channel monitoring, the proportion of targets in the captured pictures is small, especially in the complex background of mutual occlusion, forests, mountains and rivers, and the problem of target early warning in inspection images under multiple interference factors. Use K-means clustering combined with intersection over union (IoU) loss function to determine the anchor frame, and solve the problem that the preset anchor frame is not suitable for the detection of small target defects with hidden dangers in transmission lines. Use MobileNetV3 as a feature extraction network to improve the detection performance of small target defects with hidden dangers on transmission lines, and at the same time facilitate deployment on the lightweight mobile terminal on site. Inceptionv3 is introduced as a detection network, and a variety of convolution kernels are used to perform operations to meet the detection requirements of multiple categories of hidden defects in transmission lines. Taking the transmission line hidden danger data set as the test object, the method in this paper is compared with Faster R-CNN, SSD, YOLOv4, etc. to carry out comparative verification experiments. The results show that the mean average precision (mAP) of the method in this paper is 93.44%, the model size is 53.2MB, the detection speed is 0.05FPS, the detection mAP is increased by 4.19%, 4.98%, and 3.05%, respectively, and the model size is reduced by 0MB, 203.2MB, 3.3MB, the detection speed is increased by 0.14FPS, 0.3FPS, 0.2FPS, respectively, to meet the requirements of high detection accuracy and detection speed for hidden dangers of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian Network in Performance Evaluation of Talents with Five Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The results of 32 courses in grade 2019 in Big Data Technology at the Chongqing Vocational Institute of Tourism were used as the data sample. It was categorized into five dimensions, which include being physically and mentally healthy, being culturally competent, being skilled, being innovative, and having developmental potential. Correlations between the training criteria for talents with five dimensions were learned through the structure of Bayesian Networks. parameter learning was based on the structure of Bayesian Networks. The Bayesian Networks structure is implemented so that conditional probabilities of achievement in the five dimensions are obtained. Finally, Bayesian reasoning was used to predict students' talents with five dimensions. From the predicted results, it was concluded that it is feasible to macro-regulate student shadowing and centralized practical training. It can provide a basis for departmental decision making and student selection of placements for shadowing.

articleTitle: Internet of Things privacy security protection access control Research
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The application of the Internet of Things will become more and more extensive, and solving the problem of access control of the Internet of Things nodes and the problem of privacy and security protection is the focus of current research in the field of Internet of Things security. This paper proposes an access control model based on a mixture of attributes and roles, which has a good security protection effect on the entire system. Aiming at the possibility of various types of privacy leakage in the information transmitted in the Internet of Things, a two-way authentication mechanism between the master node and the terminal base station is proposed. Analyze the mixed access control model of this article. Users check in to simulate the model of this solution. On this basis, simulation comparison analysis is simulated, attribute encryption and time constraints are introduced, which protects users ‘privacy and security, and solves the problem of The increase of roles takes up too much resources, causing uneven resource allocation and waste. Let attribute-based access control and role-based access control work together, which is in line with a safe and efficient access control model.

articleTitle: ISIGHT-Based Optimal Analysis of Torque Distribution in the Four-wheel Drive System of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The torque distribution of the front and rear four-wheel drive system motors of pure electric vehicles generally adopts a fixed ratio. This paper dynamically adjusts the torque distribution ratio of the front and rear motors according to the driver's torque request and the current vehicle speed. The efficiency analysis model is built with simulink, and the simulink model is called with ISIGHT to obtain the most efficient torque distribution ratio based on vehicle speed and torque request. The whole vehicle simulation model is built by Modelica to simulate and analyze the efficiency of the motor system under three typical operating conditions of NEDC, WLTC, and FTP75, and compare the motors in the three drive modes of single-motor drive, fixed torque distribution ratio, and dynamic adjustment of torque distribution ratio. System efficiency found: dynamic adjustment of the torque output ratio can greatly improve the efficiency of the motor system under FTP75 working conditions. In the power system used in this paper, the single motor drive efficiency is the best under the condition of a small torque request at the same vehicle speed. With the increase of the torque request, the motor system reaches its best efficiency when the torque output ratio of the front motor is around 0.3.

articleTitle: Research on Identification Technology for Electric Power Industry based on Negative List
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the characteristics of power industry data, this paper studies the extraction technology of sensitive words in negative list, identifies the metadata of negative list based on sensitive thesaurus, and discusses the method of automatic identification of negative list by combining metadata with data content, which provides support for accurate control of power data.

articleTitle: Social sentiment analyzer for online post of the COVID-19 Pandemic based on Neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to explore the emotions of people during this pandemic by using the Baidu Post Bar, we propose a neural network to classify text based on emotions. The data for training the proposed model and performing experiments is obtained from various online forums. The results of the proposed model are compared with other models presented in literature. The experimental results show that the proposed CNN_BiLSTM model has good results in classifying the data samples and it satisfies the requirements of emotion classification of forum Chinese texts. The proposed method accurately classifies the emotion of each sentence and provides necessary technical support for subsequent emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Research and design of agricultural production monitoring platform based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the development of cloud computing and big data technology has promoted business model changes and productivity development in more and more industries. Traditional agriculture, especially the production process of agriculture, requires manual processing in most of the links, resulting in low efficiency and failure to detect abnormalities in the crop production process in time. Based on this, this article analyzes and designs an agricultural production monitoring cloud platform, and uses big data technology and machine learning technology to complete the storage and analysis of massive crop data. Provide agricultural producers with visualization of crop growth monitoring data and early warning of abnormalities and smart suggestions. And ultimately promote the development of agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Variable Inertias of Wind Turbines in Interconnected Power System for Transient Stability Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The virtual energy generated by the variable speed wind turbine with virtual inertia control not only changes the frequency response of the system, but also has a significant effect on the transient stability of rotor angle. In this paper, the equivalent model of interconnected system with wind turbines is derived. According to the extended equal area criterion, the conversion between the virtual energy of wind turbine and the transient energy of synchronous generator (SG) is calculated, and the first swing stability of rotor angle is evaluated. The integral manifold method is then adopted to reduce the order of the system model, and the influence of variable inertia control on system damping is analyzed. A variable inertia optimization control strategy is proposed to reduce rotor angle variation by exchanging transient energy with SG while providing rapid inertia response. Finally, a two-area interconnected power system with high wind power penetration is established. The results demonstrate that under the proposed control strategy, the transient stability of system frequency and rotor angle can be both significantly improved.

articleTitle: Electricity data analysis method based on K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the amount of grid data, more and more data needs to be backed up and restored in the data backup system. However, the similarity between each backup file exceeds 60%, and all storage on the hard disk is a waste of storage space, so it is proposed A DELTA compression method based on K-medoids clustering is used to remove duplicate data in backup data. By performing pairwise DELTA compression on the file blocks, the size of each compressed file is obtained as the similarity between the two file blocks. Through the obtained similarity, K-medoids clustering is performed as a preprocessing step before DELTA compression. Then, according to the clustering results of K-medoids, DELTA compression is performed after merging small file blocks. The test results show that this method can improve the compression rate and reduce the number of fingerprint searches in DELTA compression.

articleTitle: Design of Bandgap Reference Voltage Source with Low Temperature Drift and Low Offset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A low-cost bandgap reference voltage source (BG) design solution for the low-temperature drift and high-precision requirements is proposed in this article. By introducing a pair of MOS transistors operating in the sub-threshold region, high-order temperature compensation of the reference voltage is realized. At the same time, the influence of operational amplifier offset voltage on the reference accuracy is reduced. The BG circuit is designed based on 0.18 μm CMOS process. The simulation results show that the temperature drift of the BG is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.59\mathbf{ppm}/^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex> in the temperature range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-40\sim 125^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex>, and the power supply rejection ratio reaches -73 dB. The BG designed in this paper is suitable for industrial chips that need high-precision reference voltage.

articleTitle: Prediction of foF2 frequency based on BP neural network with single point extrapolation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a BP neural network prediction model based on single point extrapolation is used to improve the prediction accuracy of ionospheric foF2. According to the optimization of parameters of input layer analysis to build appropriate training samples, by trial and error method to determine the hidden layer structure, using the experiment and simulation to train network to forecast, adopt the method of average test analysis prediction error, the final analysis of single point extrapolation and prediction of IRI2016 prediction model of BP neural network.

articleTitle: A method of data export based on ASP.NET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Under B/S structure, the data of the server is displayed on the web page. Aiming at the problem that some data displayed on the web page need to be exported to the local area for processing and storage, this paper introduces a method of using ASP.NET technology to export data to Excel with examples. In this method, the data of web page is exported by the way of Datagrid control, the arrangement of the exported data is basically the same as that of the web page, and corresponding reports can be made according to the site requirements. The concrete realization process of data export is introduced emphatically.

articleTitle: Prediction Method for Remaining Useful Life of Rolling Bearings Using Variable Interval Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the remaining useful life (RUL) prediction algorithm of a rolling bearing produces a large amount of power consumption in the long-term operation of edge devices, a RUL prediction method using variable interval sampling is proposed. Firstly, extract the time domain features, frequency domain features and abstract features of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) of the original vibration signal of the rolling bearing.
