After normalization, the features are selected according to certain criteria, and then the features are input into the long short-term memory (LSTM) network to construct the RUL prediction model. Finally, the degradation state of rolling bearings is divided into early, middle, and late periods. Different sampling intervals are used for different periods, and linear interpolation is used to fill in the vacant degradation features to realize the RUL prediction of rolling bearings using variable interval sampling. Experimental results show that the proposed variable interval algorithm can significantly reduce the number of data sampling, data processing and prediction times in the RUL prediction process, and the prediction effect remains unchanged in the late period of rolling bearing degradation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of a 2-stage helical gear transmission system using NSGA-III
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This study attempts to propose an optimal design method of the geometric parameters of gear transmission system under the condition of meeting the requirements of gear strength and shaft strength and performance. In this paper, the two-stage reduction gear box is taken as the research object, and the design objective is to minimize the volume, center distance and power loss in the transmission system, and 12 parameters such as the number of gear teeth, module and helix angle are taken as design variables. And in the optimization, gear strength, shaft strength, etc. are included as constraints A special discrete non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm III (NSGA-III) is used to optimize the problem. Discover the relationship between gear volume, power loss and center distance under different parameters.

articleTitle: A CPM-DSSS Based Low Complexity Carrier Phase and Symbol Timing Offset Joint Estimator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Continuous Phase Modulation-Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (CPM-DSSS) is a promising technique with the advantages of constant envelope, high spectral efficiency and anti-jamming. The demodulation of CPM-DSSS requires precise synchronisation of carrier phase and symbol timing offset at the receiver side. However, the existing synchronization methods have the problem of high computational complexity. In this work, a low-complexity joint estimator of carrier phase and symbol timing offset based on CPM-DSSS and PAM decomposition is proposed. By performing PAM decomposition on the CPM-DSSS signal and optimising the estimation algorithm with energy weights of each pulse, the computational complexity is reduced by 90 %. Simulation analysis shows that the proposed estimator can achieve the same estimation performance as the ML algorithm with low operational complexity.

Author Keywords: Symbol Timing and Carrier Phase Offset Joint Estimate

articleTitle: Pre-training with Phonetics and glyphs for Chinese Spelling Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Spelling error correction is a challenging task. Extensive approaches nowadays either use rule-based statistics and language models or sequence-to-sequence deep learning methods. In this paper, we propose a new end-to-end CSC model that uses powerful pre-training and fine-tuning methods to integrate phonetic features, stroke features into the language model. The selected tokens are masked according to the confusion set using similar characters, instead of using a fixed token mask as in BERT [10]. in addition to the prediction of the characters themselves, this paper introduces phonetic prediction to learn knowledge of spelling errors at the phonetic level. In addition to this, we add a probability weight in order to balance error detection and error correction throughout the framework. experimental results show that the model achieves a significant improvement over the SIGHAN dataset and outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Extraction Based on Semantic Similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the thorny problem of ‘information explosion’ in tunnel construction design, the knowledge extraction model based on semantic similarity (KEMSS) is proposed in this paper. In this model, the key words of designer's demand and the tunnel geological exploration and bidding texts are preprocessed; secondly, the Bert pretraining model is used to represent the two as semantic vectors containing context information; then the two feature vectors interact in the interaction layer to extract the matching features between texts; finally, semantic similarity is calculated by matching layer to extract the target text of the tunnel geological exploration and bidding texts. KEMSS is proposed for the semantic matching between short text and long text from a new perspective in this paper, which only needs a small part of the corpus in the field of tunnel construction to fine-tune based on knowledge transfer. The comparative experiments show that the accuracy and range of knowledge extraction of KEMSS are better than those of the comparative baseline models, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Magnetic gradient tensor positioning system based on AMR sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Magnetic anomaly detection is a widely used detection method. Because magnetic detection is not affected by soil, water and other media, it is widely used in prospecting, positioning and other fields. Magnetic gradient tensor, as a new detection method, can realize the inversion of the target position by measuring the change rates of the three components of the magnetic field in three directions. It has good mathematical characteristics and is a research hotspot in the field of magnetic detection. In this paper, the magnetic gradient tensor based target location technology is studied for weak magnetic target location, and a target location algorithm based on magnetic gradient tensor information is proposed. A corresponding location system is built with AMR magnetic sensor, which can achieve accurate location of magnetic anomaly targets within 0.25m.

articleTitle: Modeling and Correction Analysis of Regional Ionospheric Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), due to its all-weather lobal monitoring and high precision, makes it possible to use GNSS observation data to accurately extract the total electron content (TEC) of the ionosphere and to study ionospheric activities. At the same time, the delay error caused by the ionosphere to GNSS signals is also one of the main sources of error in GNSS positioning. For regional users, using as few stations as possible to establish an ionospheric TEC model within the region has higher efficiency and range practicability. This paper realizes the establishment of a regional ionospheric TEC model based on spherical harmonics, and establishes an ionospheric TEC model in the 15∼45°N and 105°∼135°E regions, which is compatible with IGS (International GNSS Service, IGS) and CAS (Chinese Academy of Sciences, CAS), the overall difference is more than 70% within ±3TECU.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Compensation of Distribution Network Considering Wind Turbine Access
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In response to the concept of green low-carbon environmental protection, more and more distributed generations are connected to the distribution network. However, with the integration of various distributed energy into the distribution network, the safe and stable operation of the power system will be affected<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. This paper studies the reactive power compensation of distribution network with distributed wind power. Based on the traditional reactive power optimization model, the reactive power optimization mathematical model of distribution network is established. The objective function is network loss and voltage offset, and the constraint conditions are node voltage, reactive power compensation capacity and transformer ratio<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. Firstly, the network loss and voltage change of distribution network after wind power integration are analyzed, and then the reactive power compensation device is used to optimize. A hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to verify the IEEE30 node system. The results show that the algorithm can significantly reduce the distribution network loss, improve voltage quality, reduce investment costs, and has good economy.

articleTitle: Research on precise time synchronization technology in electric power intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accurate clock synchronization is very important to the monitoring and protection control of power system. We analyzed the typical hierarchical network architecture for intelligent substation, and time synchronization application scenarios and accuracy requirements. Based on the interconnected network of substation, this paper proposed a synchronization system based on precise time synchronization protocol, and a two-level time deviation and link delay adjustment method based on IEEE1588. The proposed method provides a precise synchronization between the intelligent terminals and the systems for the substation. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed time synchronization protocol are verified in this paper.

Author Keywords: Time synchronization for electric power system

articleTitle: A Class of Adaptive Control for Stochastic Nonlinear Systems Based on Backstepping Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses an adaptive control scheme for the stochastic nonlinear strict-feedback system with unknown interference signals and unknown input dead zones. Solving adaptive control problems often requires accurate information about the system model. When the unknown interfering signal is added to the system model, the design of the controller becomes more difficult. This paper uses the backstepping method to solve this adaptive control problem. Firstly, the mean-value theorem is applied to transform the strict-feedback nonlinearity into the measurable function. Secondly, In the design process of the backstepping method, the disturbance of the unknown interference signal is effectively controlled by selecting the appropriate adaptive rate. Further, the complete design process of the adaptive controller and proof of convergence are given. Finally, simulation example verify the feasibility of proposed adaptive controller.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Pulse Injection Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates a pulse injection device that can inject pulse interference signal directly into the pin of IC chip. The device couples the pulse interference to the pin of the IC chip through the coupling capacitance. In this paper, the mechanism and frequency spectrum of double exponential pulse wave are analyzed, and the frequency band of double exponential pulse wave used in the experiment is determined. Secondly, the circuit-level simulation of the pulse injection device was carried out with ADS software, and the selection of components was determined. Finally, through the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50\Omega$</tex> test system, the output pulse voltage of the pulse source is divided into two parts by a power divider, and the actual injection waveform of the pulse is monitored by two voltage dividers, and the output waveform after the injection probe is used to ensure that the waveform through the injection probe is not distorted.

articleTitle: Depth estimation method of deep-sea underwater vehicle based on vertical array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The deep sea has a relatively stable sound velocity distribution. Based on the acoustic characteristics of reliable channels, this paper presents a method for estimating the depth of underwater targets for vertical arrays arranged at critical depth. This method is different from the matched field technology and time mirror technology. It does not need to obtain the marine environment information in real time and establish an accurate sound field prediction model. It can track the moving target and estimate the target depth at the same time. Simulation results show that this method can effectively obtain the target depth and has high estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Static Voltage Assessment based on Electro-thermal coupling V-Q Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Although the traditional V-Q sensitivity can quickly determine the stability of the system bus voltage, its mathematical model only considers the electrical model of the line and ignores the electro-thermal coupling relationship of the line under actual conditions. Therefore, the use of traditional model calculation results as a reference for the actual bus voltage stability judgment has a large deviation. With this as a background, this paper establishes an electro-thermal coupled power flow model, which is based on the IEEE standard heat balance equation and regards the transmission line resistance as the state variable of the power flow. Then, based on the expansion of the Jacobian matrix in the improved power flow model, a V-Q sensitivity analysis method considering the electro-thermal coupling is proposed, and the calculation example is compared and analyzed with the traditional model in different seasons. The results show that the traditional model ignores the influence of the line temperature and resistance due to the electric and heat balance, which will introduce certain errors in the calculation results for different seasons.

articleTitle: Fault Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Satellite Receiver based on Constellation Error
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The concealment and complexity of receiver nonlinear faults are important influencing factors limiting its diagnostic performance. For this reason, a joint feature extraction method based on constellation error is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the nonlinear fault model of the modules of filter, power amplifier, and oscillator gives in conjunction with the physical structure of the super outlier receiver. Then the visual representation of the fault on the constellation diagram is analyzed. The extraction of the fault features of each module is realized by decomposing the constellation diagram; finally, the support vector machine is used for fault classification. The experimental results show that, compared with existing fault feature extraction methods, this paper can jointly extract the nonlinear fault features of each module within the receiver, which significantly improves the correct rate of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Practical Prediction Method of Investment on Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to years of investment estimation experiences on electrical engineering construction, the majority investment of transformer substation is used in purchasing electrical equipment. If the fluctuation of electrical equipment price can be well forecasted in the early stage of construction, the economic benefit will be improved. This paper tries to explain the fluctuation of equipment price considering influencing factors from supply-side, demand-side and transaction environment. A modified random forest algorithm (MRFA) is adopted to predict the investment on electrical equipment during electrical substation construction. The prediction accuracy of proposed method is verified by the actual bidding price of several devices in a construction project. The predicted result is much better than the k-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm and the linear regression algorithm (LRA).

articleTitle: Dynamic Adjustment and Application of Substation Project Cost Index to adapt to Cost Marketization Reform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In July 2020, the Ministry of housing and urban rural development issued the project cost reform plan, which proposed to “abolish the regulation that the maximum bidding price is priced according to quota, gradually stop publishing budget quota, and implement project pricing methods such as list measurement, market inquiry, independent quotation and competitive pricing”. However, at present, the pricing mode of power grid enterprises in the development and contracting stage is mainly budget quota pricing. In the future, technology and economic management will face a series of new problems such as how to price. Taking the 220kV modular intelligent substation project in Tianjin as an example, this paper uses the 2018 quota to calculate the construction cost, and constructs a typical cost dynamic adjustment model based on market price fluctuation. The model calculation results provide reference and basis for pricing in the development and contracting stage after the cancellation of budget quota, in order to explore a new cost management model to deal with the market-oriented reform of project cost.

articleTitle: Design of induction power collection device for overhead lines based on magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliability and safety of the power supply of the power system, it is necessary to monitor the status of the overhead lines. Overhead line online monitoring devices make up for the shortcomings of traditional offline testing, but require a separate power supply to maintain operation. Most of the batteries in the market are used to supply power to the online monitoring device. However, due to the limited capacity of the battery and short running time, the maintenance cost of the device is greatly increased. Therefore, the online monitoring device can be powered by collecting energy such as the magnetic field around the overhead line. In this paper, a magnetic induction power collection device that can provide 3.3V voltage for an online monitoring device installed on a 10kV overhead line is designed. In order to obtain the maximum power as possible from the overhead line and stabilize the output voltage of 3.3V, this paper designs the toroidal core power coil and the control circuit of the magnetic induction power device. Finally, the experimental test verifies the good performance of the device.

articleTitle: Optimization Simulation of Hybrid Assembly Line Production Scheduling in Garment Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the production order scheduling of garment enterprises is based on manual experience, Plant Simulation software is used to model the mixed production line of the enterprise, and genetic algorithm combined with the scheduling rule of the shortest operation time is adopted to achieve the optimal sequencing with the goal of minimizing the completion time. The experimental results show that: The production time of the optimized order is reduced compared with that of the not optimized order. This method is simple and feasible, and provides a method for the order scheduling of garment production enterprises, and has certain application value for improving the production efficiency of enterprises.

articleTitle: The Research on Location Method of Partial Discharge in Switchgear based on Radio Frequency Sensors and Time Difference of Arrival Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) in the switchgear will affect the stability of the power system, so it is of significance to accurately detect and locate the PD source in the switchgear. Based on the radio frequency (RF) detection technology and the time difference of arrival (TDOA) algorithm, this paper proposes a location method of partial discharge in the switchgear. The threshold method, the signal initial peak method and the energy method are used respectively to obtain the wave front time of the matched pulse signal from four RF sensors, and then the hyperboloid location method and the spatial grid search method are used respectively to locate the PD source. The above methods are compared by establishing a simplified switchgear simulation model. The simulation results show that the threshold method has the smallest error in calculating the arrival time difference, and when the accuracy of the arrival time difference is not very high, the location accuracy of the spatial grid search method is higher than the hyperboloid location method. Finally, the threshold method and the spatial grid search method are selected to locate the PD source of the switchgear in the laboratory. The location error is 10cm, which can prove the effectiveness of the proposed location method.

articleTitle: 3D Point Cloud Attribute Compression Based On Geometric Transformation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of 3D point clouds, it can better represent the surface of objects in real life. However, the data volume of point cloud is huge, which requires an effective compression algorithm to compress the point cloud. In this paper, we propose a point cloud attribute compression method based on bidirectional prediction and color weighted graph transformation (CWGT). First, the k-d tree is designed for the partition processing of the point clouds. This hierarchical representation provides roughly the same number of levels for each leaf node. Second, we introduce a block-based bidirectional intra prediction scheme, which proposes a reasonable prediction model to eliminate spatial redundancy. Finally, in order to adapt to the irregularity of the point cloud, we apply graph transformation to deal with the prediction residual of the transform block, where the edge weight of the graph is weighted by the color attribute and the geometric space distance. The experimental results show that the average bit rate of this scheme is reduced by about 24.58% on the upper body dataset. In terms of visual quality, it can effectively improve the fineness of point cloud model compression reconstruction.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation model of spare parts support effectiveness for large phased array radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Spare parts support plays an important role in the application of radar equipment, especially for large phased array radar. Scientific spare parts support evaluation is an important means to improve the integrity of radar equipment and reduce life cycle maintenance funds. Spare parts support rate, spare parts out of stock and spare parts utilization are three important indicators for the evaluation of spare parts support capacity. In view of the lack of evaluation indicators, an evaluation model based on these three indicators is proposed, and finally an example application is proposed. The effectiveness and feasibility of the model in evaluating the effectiveness of equipment spare parts support are verified by an example. Finally, the results are obtained, which improves the integrity of equipment and saves equipment funds.

articleTitle: Fracture location based on transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the automation of crack location in concrete wall is low, and most of them rely on manual crack location. Such manual location efficiency is low, and the error rate will be greatly improved due to long-time work. In order to solve this problem, a concrete crack location system based on transfer learning is proposed. By modifying the trained and mature deep learning model through transfer learning, a better crack location effect can be obtained in only a small number of samples and a short time. The experimental results show that the transfer learning method can effectively solve the problem of samples and time required for deep learning.

articleTitle: Circular truncated cone conformal array beamforming based on directional array element
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper studies the capon beamforming optimization method of the circular truncated cone conformal array. According to the characteristics of the conformal array, a deterministic expression describing the beam pattern of the circular truncated cone conformal array with arbitrary weight is derived. In addition, the directional array element is applied to the antenna array, and the synthesis example of the three-dimensional circular truncated cone conformal array is given. Through the analysis of the experimental results, the method in this paper has a better beamforming effect when applied to the circular truncated cone conformal array than the conformal array using omnidirectional elements, and there will be a deeper null in the direction of interference.

articleTitle: The Effects of Energy Harvesting Backpack on the Kinematics, Kinetics, and Muscle Activity of Human Lower Limbs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of portable and wearable electronic devices has brought new challenges to battery power supply, especially in field operations or combat. Researchers have tried to harvest energy from the environment to solve the burden of carrying additional batteries, and the energy harvesting backpack is a promising solution during load carriage. However, few studies have focused on the actual biomechanical effects of energy harvesting backpacks on the human body. The purpose of this article was to determine the effects of carrying an energy harvesting backpack on the kinematics, kinetics, and muscle activity of the lower limbs when compared with ordinary backpacks. In this paper, we processed the data and compared the differences between the two backpacks. When carrying an energy harvesting backpack for short-distance activities, joint kinematics and kinetics were influenced and caused some increase in muscle activity of the lower limb. The changes may be a mechanism to maintain balance and reduce the stress on the lower limbs when walking and running.

articleTitle: A hexapod robot for Outdoor Environment Data Acquisition based on STM32 Single Chip Microcomputer and Gizwits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Every year in the world, a large number of natural disasters and man-made disasters, such as earthquakes, mudslides, mining disasters and so on. These disasters will inevitably cause serious building collapse and casualties, after the disaster is faced with a crucial problem, is the search for survivors, however, in the complex ruins of the environment of search and rescue missions, but also to rescue workers, trapped people will bring huge security threats, such as secondary collapse, which also led to the difficulties of rescue work. This paper introduces a six-legged robot based on stm32 microcontroller and witty cloud applied to post-disaster environmental monitoring, which can adapt to various complex terrains through triangular gait algorithm, six-legged robot can pass the obtained data to the database through various sensors, users can view real-time environmental data by accessing the cloud platform, convenient for rescue workers to understand the disaster situation in a timely manner to implement rescue, this paper briefly introduces the background of the project, the main technology and implementation methods developed.

articleTitle: Design of an Electronic Code Lock Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: People's quality of life needs to be improved, and the anti-theft risk needs to be paid more attention. Therefore, a simple electronic lock is becoming more and more important. The system takes STM32f1 series single chip microcomputer as the main control chip, and the matrix keyboard is used to input and modify the password. In the password input function, the input password is compared with the original password in the memory to determine whether the unlocking function should be performed. The hardware is mainly composed of minimum system development board, relay module, matrix keyboard module, buzzer module and display module. Its function and circuit are designed and analyzed in detail. The software design is mainly composed of three parts: key detection part, key event part and OLED state change to complete the four main functions: key password input and unlocking, password modification, wrong password alarm and display screen. According to the previous design, the software simulation and physical installation and debugging are carried out, and the results fully realize the functions and requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Troposcatter communication node model and transport protocol design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The troposcatter node is the core part of the scattered communication network, which is mainly used to generate, transmit, receive and forward information in the networking process. In this paper, two kinds of scattering node models are innovatively designed, and the workflow and transmission protocol between the central node and the peripheral node are described in detail, which lays a foundation for the construction of the next node model.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Image Block and Double Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the sensitivity and unpredictability of chaos to the initial value, chaos mapping is widely used in the field of image encryption. In this paper an image encryption algorithm based on image block and double diffusion is presented. The algorithm adopts the structure of permutation-diffusion-block diffusion, which can encrypt the image in only one round, and the security is high. On this basis, a fast diffusion algorithm with row and column simultaneous diffusion is proposed, and a block diffusion algorithm using the previous pixel to influence the current pixel is designed. The SHA-256 algorithm and cipher image are used to update the initial values and parameters of the chaotic system, which enhances the ability of the algorithm to resist the chosen plaintext attack. Experimental results and encryption performance analysis show that the algorithm runs fast and has high security.

articleTitle: Intelligent Service Cluster Construction Method Based on Remote Sensing Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The production of remote sensing products needs to go through various links of evaluation and deploy a variety of software and hardware resources. It is necessary to study how to improve the efficiency of service cluster deployment, simplify the evaluation process, and optimize its structure. This paper designs an intelligent service cluster construction method based on remote sensing applications, which realizes the accurate and efficient deployment of various complex network structures and equipment on the visual interface. The method is convenient and simple to operate. It can set various types of resource information according to the needs of users, can choose a more reasonable server cluster deployment plan, improve the efficiency of data storage and processing of remote sensing products, better serve users, and greatly promote The development of related industries.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation analysis of fluid-solid erosion in three-way pipeline
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Pipeline is a common transportation mode in oil and gas industry. Erosion wear is one of the important factors leading to pipeline failure. In order to better analyze the erosion of the inner wall of t-tee pipe, the erosion of gas-solid two-phase flow on the inner wall of pipe was analyzed based on CFD numerical simulation method. Through the analysis, the effects of gas flow rate, mass flow rate and particle diameter on the erosion wear of T -tee are obtained. At the same time, the corresponding experimental platform was built to verify the erosion wear of tee pipe. The research shows that the results of numerical simulation and experimental verification are basically consistent within the allowable error range. The experimental results verify the conclusion of numerical simulation, and then illustrate the reliability of numerical simulation in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Calculation of Available Transmission Capacity of Power Grid Considering the Influence of Environmental Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The available transmission capacity (ATC) is an important measure for evaluating the margin of safety and stability of interconnected grid operations. Because the traditional optimal power flow (OPF) model ignores the influence of environmental factors around overhead transmission lines (OTLs), the use of ATC calculated by traditional OPF as a reference for the safety and stability margin of grid operation has a large deviation. With this as a background, this paper proposes an electro-thermal coupling OPF (ETC-OPF) model suitable for ATC calculations, which adds line resistance as a state variable. Finally, through the simulation test of the IEEE 6-bus test system, the validity and correctness of the model are verified.

articleTitle: ECT Image Reconstruction based on Improved Sensitivity Field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the actual industrial production process, we often encounter two or more kinds of objects mixed flow conditions, this phenomenon is generally known as multiphase flow in academia and industry. Process Tomography (PT) is an important technique for Process detection in two-phase flow. Electrical Capacitance Tomography (ECT) is a kind of process Tomography technology. It has the advantages of non-invasive, low cost, simple structure, etc. It can be applied as long as the dielectric constant of each phase is different between the media. Its principle is to use a set of sensors installed on the device under test array electrodes, formed from different angles analyte scanning space of sensitive field, according to the measured object in the different medium has different dielectric constant of the properties, and the implementation of the distribution of the field of incomplete information extraction, using the appropriate image reconstruction algorithm, each phase of analyte pipe field distribution in the form of a visual image. This paper mainly improves the quality of reconstructed images by improving the sensitive field, and jointly uses ANSYS Maxwell, C++ and MATLAB for research.

articleTitle: An On-line Fault Diagnosis Method for Winding Deformation of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at eliminating the need to install online monitoring devices, an on-line fault diagnosis method of a distribution transformer is proposed. First, according to the electrical parameters provided by the power grid company, an equivalent mathematical model is established by using the theory of power flow calculation, and the voltage at the primary side of the distribution transformer can be obtained. Therefore, on-line detection of internal parameters of a distribution transformer is realized without installing monitoring devices. In order to draw the reactance trend chart, the least square method is used to estimate the value of the short-circuit reactance. Then, using the quartile outlier detection method to predict the health status of distribution transformers. Finally, based on the distribution transformer fault data, the distribution transformer fault diagnosis is simulated, and simulation results verified the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the effectiveness of the configuration of new phased array radar spare parts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the performance and working characteristics of the new phased array radar, the radar maintenance strategy based on reasonable spare parts configuration is studied. Firstly, the evaluation index system of spare parts configuration effectiveness of new phased array radar is constructed. The weight of each evaluation index is calculated by using relevant mathematical models. According to the weight of evaluation index and relevant theories, an evaluation model for evaluating the effectiveness of spare parts configuration of new phased array radar is constructed. The effectiveness of the spare parts configuration maintenance strategy is evaluated by using the evaluation model. Finally, a large number of real data and examples are used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the configuration method.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Pressure Reducing Valve and Leakage Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Leaks in distribution systems can lead to loss of water resources. Pressure reducing valve is widely used in water diversion and urban water supply projects, and it is also the key to control leakage. The pressure reducing valve used in the water supply network is self-operated pressure reducing valve with a pilot system. The conventional pressure relief valve can only be changed by manually tightening the regulating thread of the pilot valve. At present, the problem is that the pressure can not be intelligently controlled. Furthermore, the leakage of the water distribution system can not be a timely and accurate perception. Therefore, this work puts forward a new intelligent pressure reducing valve and diagnostic method for leakage. We determine the overall design scheme of hardware and software. The intelligent pressure reducing valve proposed in this paper adopts a new structural design. The valve uses a stepper motor instead of a manual regulating guide valve. Meanwhile, pressure sensors are set in front of the valve and behind the valve to collect data by the deep residual shrinkage network to train the pressure. The leakage can be judged effectively and timely through the trained model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the trained model over 95%. Furthermore, it can judge the leakage situation of the water distribution system in time. The intelligent pressure reducing valve proposed in this paper has more significant advantages than the traditional pressure reducing valve. The novel valve greatly facilitates the pressure management of the water distribution system and has the possibility of wide application.

articleTitle: Design of A Three-Phase Software Phase-Locked loop for UPS Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Since the auxiliary three-phase oil pump motor of ship machine set needs uninterrupted power supply(UPS), the oil pump motor needs to be switched to UPS equipment for power supply in case of power loss of the generator. In order to realize the smooth transition of the oil pump motor when switching to UPS, the three-phase voltage output by the inverter in UPS needs to be in the same frequency and phase as the generator voltage. In this paper, the basic working principle of UPS is introduced, the advantages and disadvantages of two phase-locked loops for tracking phase are analyzed, and a phase-locked loop(PLL) based on second-order generalized integrator is selected to be used in inverter. Finally, the feasibility of this method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of distribution network equipment decommissioning data based on three-dimensional matrix
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Distribution network equipment has the characteristics of multiple types and wide distribution, and the factors that advance its decommissioning are difficult to be identified. In order to get the important factors affecting the early decommissioning of equipment, this paper proposed a correlation analysis algorithm, which introduced the three-dimensional matrix into Apriori algorithm, operating more efficiency by reducing the computational redundancy in the classical algorithm, and digs out the set of important factors affecting the early decommissioning of distribution network equipment. By comparing the experimental results, it can be seen that the three-dimensional matrix algorithm can obtain the association rules of distribution network equipment decommissioning factors and significantly improve the computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A Low-noise and Compact Very Low Frequency Sinusoidal Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this letter, a novel very low frequency sinusoidal (VLF-sin) generator is proposed and established based on rectification circuit and power amplifier. A sinusoidal signal with a high frequency of 10kHz and a amplitude varying between 0 and 5V is generated by the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). The voltage level and power of the signal are amplified by a power amplifier and transformer. Through the rectification circuit, a low-noise high-voltage (HV) VLF-sin waveform can be generated. The voltage can be applied to partial discharge (PD) detection because there is no noise from the switching device. Finally, a simulation verification is carried out to prove the feasibility of the generator.

articleTitle: Snow deformation simulation research based on particle system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: On the basis of in-depth analysis of domestic and foreign research work, this paper conducts research on the lack of dynamics of existing snow simulations, which leads to insufficient realism. The particle system is used to simulate the deformation effect of snow to achieve higher realism while ensuring real-time performance. In this paper, the physical behavior modeling analysis of snow, based on the conditions of snow physics modeling, proposes a low-cost solver to achieve the effects of snow deformation and fracture similar to the use of the material point method.

articleTitle: Improved Elitist Genetic Algorithm Optimization based PTS to PAPR Reduction for Multi-Carrier Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation systems can significantly reduce the energy efficiency of high power amplifier (HPA). For PAPR reduction in OFDM systems, partial transmit sequence (PTS) scheme is a widely used technique to reduce the high PAPR problem inherent in 5G waveform design. Traditionally, the existing PTS algorithms attempt to minimize the PAPR, in which the computational unpredictability and cost of customary PTS strategy are enormous. Thus it is urgent to enhance computational efficiency to obtain the optimal phase factors of PTS scheme. In this paper, an improved scheme called elitist genetic algorithm based PTS (EGA-PTS) scheme for optimum phase rotation factors searching is presented. Simulation results show that, EGA-PTS scheme can achieve better PAPR reduction performance with the same searching complexity compared with traditional PTS scheme, simple genetic algorithm (SGA) based PTS scheme and binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) algorithm based PTS scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Precision Positioning Control System of Punching Machine Feeding Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the working efficiency and safety of the stainless steel spoon punching, after analyzing the punching and cutting process and the production requirements of enterprise, a precision positioning control system for the automatic feeding device based on integral separation PID algorithm is designed. The system uses Siemens S7-200SMART PLC as the master station. Design parameters and display data through the touch screen, and use DC motors and pneumatic circuits to achieve coordinated control of the punch and feeder. Through actual production verification, the system has high relocation accuracy and reliable operation, the efficiency increased by 40%. At the same time, it reduces safety hazards and labor costs, provides a reference and theoretical basis for the automation upgrade and transformation of stamping feeding.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Detection Technology of Abnormal Behavior of Power Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous and in-depth development of smart grid construction, the degree of automation of the power system is rapidly increasing, and the number of grid sensors, the scale of information network and the number of decision-making units have greatly increased. The network security of the power industry control system is facing severe challenges. This paper studies the in-depth analysis technology of real-time interactive protocols of power industrial control systems, captures data packets and analyzes the data packets layer by layer to obtain application layer field data streams, and realizes in-depth analysis of power industrial control system protocols such as IEC104 protocol and IEC61850 protocol. Research on anomaly detection technology of power industrial control system real-time interaction process based on feature matching, and realize the detection of abnormal behaviors of terminals, networks, and host devices through syntactic and semantic analysis and business command analysis, as well as the detection of regular network attack behaviors such as malicious code and virus Trojan horses.

articleTitle: FSMS: An Enhanced Polynomial Sampling Fusion Method for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, end-to-end audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) has been proposed with great success. However, due to the heterogeneity between different modal data, an effective audio-visual fusion strategy is in need to learn the correlation between the audio and the video information. In this paper, we propose a fusion strategy in which the high-level features output from audio and video encoders are fed into a siamese neural network with shared weights, and then feature-level masking and polynomial sampling are incorporated to train the fusion of the high-dimensional features of audio and video, achieving inter-modality information alignment. In comparison with the traditional fusion methods as concatenation, it results in improvement of performance. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach on the word-level AVSR task.

articleTitle: Design of An Induced Voltage Withstand Test Device for Potential Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Potential transformer (PT) is widely used as a sensing device in AC power systems. It is necessary to carry out an induction withstand test on the PT before it is put into operation to ensure its safety. However, due to the influence of stray capacitance, the port current of the PT will rise rapidly during the tests, which will bring risks to equipment and personnel. In engineering, the port current can be limited by connecting an inductor in parallel with the protection winding. However, it is hard to determine the value of the compensation inductance, which restricts the application of this method. This paper proposed an improved PT induction withstand test method. This method obtains the value of the compensation inductance by the pre-test and then conducts the induction withstand with the inductor in parallel with the protection winding. Then, the port current of the PT can be greatly reduced during the test, which guarantees the safety of the test. The corresponding device has been designed to perform the test steps automatically. The experiment results show that the improved method can greatly reduce the port current during the induction withstand tests, which proves the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Evaluation Method of Employee Ability and Quality based on Behaviorally Anchored Rating Scale
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the Competency Model, the composition of human ability and quality not only has measurable knowledge and skills, but also has ability and potential that is not easy to be quantified. in order to ensure that the evaluation index can scientifically reflect the relationship between people and posts, it is necessary to choose appropriate evaluation methods to quantify the evaluation indicators. In this paper, how to use the Behaviorally Anchored Rating Scale (BARS) to evaluate qualitative indexes is discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A Fast Calculation Model of Buried Cable Ratings based on Distributed Temperature Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper presented a fast calculation model of underground cable ratings based on distributed temperature sensors (DTS). Using the finite element method (FEM), the DTS temperature measurement results are taken as the first boundary condition to calculate the temperature field of the cable body. Obtaining the conductor core temperature, the steady cable rating is calculated by the secant method. This fast calculation model retains the advantages of high precision of conventional FEM, and reduces the calculation amount by avoiding modeling soil around the cable. The accuracy of the model was verified in COMSOL. Compared with IEC60287, This fast calculation model has a positive significance to reduce the cost of cable and maintain the safe and stable operation of cables.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of database data based on the throughput coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The data in the database with correlation is frequently separated into distinct data tables, making it difficult to query the target variable data of interest to users while also locating the correlated variable data. The throughput coefficient is used to propose a correlation analysis of database data in this research. The data of selected variables is first pre-processed, after which each variable is assessed using the pass-through coefficient and the corresponding variable association table is created in the database; finally, the method's practicality is tested by putting it into action on a web page. This research presents a novel approach to increasing the efficiency of database queries.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-Profile Polarization Tracking Active Phased Array Antenna for Satcom On the Move
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Design method and key technologies of a Ku band low profile Active Phased Array Antenna (APAA) with polarization tracking for satcom on the move (SOTM) system are given. The approach presented here realizes polarization tracking and wide-angle beam tracking simultaneously comparing with traditional antennas. To be adequate for wide-angle beam scanning, the microstrip patch array antennas are presented. The choke groove is also adopted to improve the isolation between the transmitting and receiving antenna under the condition of limited size. Finally, a low profile active phased array antenna has been developed successfully. The test result shows arbitrary linear polarization and wide-angle beam tracking can be obtained from different phase setting. There is enough isolation between transmitting and receiving antennas to ensure that the performance of receiving antenna will not deteriorate.

articleTitle: Auto-Tuning Flink Configurations Based on GBDT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Apache Flink is widely used in distributed computing scenarios, and its real-time performance is more powerful than Spark, so to maximize the performance of Flink, we need to set the relevant configuration parameters reasonably. However, it is quite difficult to select and tune the appropriate parameters from many parameters. To improve the overall efficiency of computation, it is important to study the performance modeling and Auto-Tuning Flink Configurations. In this paper, we analyze the key parameters affecting the execution time of Flink tasks and build a performance model to automatically optimize the Flink parameters based on the performance modeling. By extracting the parameters that have an impact on performance during job execution, we use GBDT to build a performance prediction model for a specific task, and finally use Particle swarm optimization (PSO) to find the optimal combination of parameters based on the performance model. Experimental results show that the tuned execution time is reduced by an average of 30% compared to the default configuration parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-fiber neural network brain tumor segmentation under multi-GPU conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The brain tumor is a disease that seriously affects people's life safety, so early detection and treatment are of great significance to prolong the life of patients. Compared with the traditional 2D convolutional neural network, the 3D convolutional neural network has a better advantage in segmenting the tumor sub-regions of the multi-modal brain tumor MRI. More context information can be extracted in the whole process, which is helpful for more precisely segmenting the various parts of the brain tumor. The method in this article uses group convolution to replace conventional convolution to significantly reduce the memory usage, further reduce the sampling volume of 3D images, increase the batch value, and enhance the information exchange of each component through the multi-fiber unit. In order to make full use of the advantages of existing computer equipment, the experiment uses the cross-GPU synchronization normalization method, which alleviates the poor segmentation effect caused by the 3D convolutional neural network because the batch value is too small and the gradient direction cannot be determined. Finally, we replaced the original activation function to further improve the segmentation effect. The experiment in this article uses the brain tumor public dataset Brats2018 for testing. The average Dice value of the improved model in this article is 89.79%, 85.59%, and 79.83% in the whole brain tumor area, the tumor core area, and the brain tumor enhancement area respectively. The training time of the entire network is 321.89 minutes, compared with other similar segmentation models, the experiment has achieved good results.

articleTitle: Social Recommendation Algorithm Based on Trust and Distrust
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Recommendation system can alleviate the problem of information overload effectively and enable users to obtain target information quickly. However, data sparsity is one of the important factors affecting the accuracy of recommendation system. The matrix decomposition algorithm based on trust makes use of the rating information and trust relationship between users to make recommendations. However, most matrix decomposition algorithms based on trust only consider the explicit trust relationship between users, and rarely consider the distrust relationship and implicit social relationship between users. Therefore, this paper proposes a new recommendation algorithm, which makes use of the rating information between users, explicit social relations and implicit social relations obtained through the rating information to recommend, which can alleviate the problem of data sparsity to a large extent. Finally, experiments with real data set Epinions show that the proposed algorithm can further improve the accuracy of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: Research on Multi - mode Switching of Distributed Static Series Compensator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problems such as insufficient transmission capacity and reduced system reliability caused by the increasing proportion of new energy access in modern power grid, Distributed Static Series Compensator (DSSC) with high cost efficiency and reliability is the best choice for flexible regulation of future power grid. In this paper, the basic principle of multi-mode switching of DSSC is introduced in detail. Firstly, a three-loop control strategy with high robustness is constructed based on the mathematical model of DSSC, and the control principle of different working modes of DSSC is analyzed. Then, a multi-mode switching strategy of DSSC that can make different working modes switch smoothly is proposed, and the reset strategy of PI controller during mode switching is given. Finally, the electromagnetic transient model of DSSC is constructed based on PSCAD / EMTDC, and the effectiveness and reliability of the multi-mode switching strategy of DSSC are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: RTK-based Measuring System of Vehicle Turning Radius
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The motor vehicle handling stability test is extremely important in modern automobile testing, and the steering radius occupies an important technical index in the handling stability test. At present, the measurement of the turning radius of motor vehicles mainly adopts the water drop method, which has large measurement errors, difficult operation, and high requirements for the test environment. This paper studies the measurement method of vehicle steering radius based on RTK technology, establish a suitable test model according to the test scenario, performs data fusion by GNSS system and RTK base station, obtain precise positioning coordinate information, calculate the minimum distance from the test point to the setpoint (i.e., the center of the circle). To obtain the minimum relative steering radius, calculate the maximum value of all test point coordinates, and obtain the minimum absolute turning radius. This study has high testing accuracy, adaptability, operability, and has excellent use in practical applications.

articleTitle: Mobile Phone Interactive Test System for Household Appliances based on Robot Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, the interactive testing between household appliances and mobile phones is mainly done manually by testers. Most of the test procedures have problems such as high repetition, low work difficulty, and boring process, which greatly reduces the work efficiency of testers. This article uses a six-axis collaborative robot, supplemented by a binocular industrial camera as an image acquisition device, and uses target detection technology to make the robot have intelligent perception capabilities, guide the robot to click and slide operations, instead of manual testing between household appliances and mobile phones. After experimentation, the test efficiency of the method proposed in this paper is equivalent to that of labor, and it can meet the demand of replacing labor, and it has been practically applied in the enterprise.

articleTitle: Q-V Modal Analysis Considering Electro-thermal Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the IEEE standard heat balance equation, it can be concluded that the resistance of the transmission line is closely related to its operating environment. For this reason, when the power grid operating environment changes, the power flow calculation results and voltage stability of the power grid will have an impact. Based on this, this paper combines the electro-thermal coupling equation of the transmission line with the conventional power flow calculation equation and derives the power flow equation that takes into account the electro-thermal coupling. Then, the linearized equation of the traditional improved power flow equation is replaced by the linearized equation of the improved power flow equation, and a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q-V$</tex> modal analysis method considering the electro-thermal coupling is proposed. Compared with traditional modal analysis methods, the calculated eigenvalues and participation factors can consider the impact of environmental factors on voltage stability, thereby further quantifying the impact of changes in electro-thermal coupling parameters. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the proposed method and index are verified by the test and analysis on three scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of User Side Benefit in Smart Grid Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: A novel loads adjusting method based on game theory has been proposed for peak load cutting and valley filling applications. The loads model, the benefits of the power consumers model, and the benefits of the grid model are established by regarding the power consumers and the grid side as the main game players. To combat imbalances in the relationship of the consumer side and the grid side. The strategy of the price regulation based on the game theory is designed and adjusting the benefits of the main game players dynamically throughout the process. Then with considering the constraint conditions of loads and price, compute the result of the benefits and the load regulation by the Cplex solver. The simulation result has verified the electricity price forecasting method can reduce the difference between peak-valley loads effectively and ensure the benefits of the consumer side.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Pollution Flashover Voltage of Porcelain Insulator in Transmission Line under Overheavy Pollution Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Due to the shortage of transmission channels, individual transmission line towers inevitably need to pass through overheavy pollution environmental areas. The so-called overheavy polluted environment means that the SPS (site pollution severity) exceeds level-e. In the overheavy polluted environment, how to configure the insulation of transmission tower is a great test for the design, operation and maintenance of transmission line. Based on the above situation, through the existing test data, this paper predicts and calculates the flashover voltage(<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50%</inf>) of various types of disc suspension porcelain insulators; Through calculation, the external insulation configuration schemes under different ESDD (equivalent salt deposit density) are given to solve the pollution flashover problem of transmission lines in overheavy pollution environment.

articleTitle: SCUC decomposition and coordination algorithm for multi-area power system considering information barrier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Given the difficulty of the traditional unit commitment model to consider uncertainties of renewable energy output and the non-interoperability of information between sub-areas in the multi-area system, this paper proposes a security constrained unit commitment (SCUC) distributed algorithm for the multi-area system. Firstly, comprehensively considering the coal consumption cost and unit start-up and shutdown costs of thermal power units, a multi-area system SCUC model considering the combination of wind energy and energy storage system is established. Secondly, based on the idea of analytical target cascading, a decomposition-coordination algorithm is proposed, which decomposes each connected sub-area by introducing a virtual generator, and establishes a coordination layer to correct the phase angle of the virtual generator. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by the test and analysis of a dual area system.

articleTitle: A dual-band active polarization converter based on metasurface loaded with PIN diodes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band active polarization converter based on a metasurface structure loaded with PIN diodes is proposed, which can rapidly switch between multiple polarization conversion modes. In the frequency range of 9.5-13GHz, it can switch between two modes of total reflection and linear-to-circular polarization conversion, and in the frequency range of 14-18GHz, it can switch between two functions of linear-to-linear polarization conversion and linear-to-circular polarization conversion, and the cross-polarization conversion rate is over 90%.

articleTitle: Analysis public opinion of the COVID-19 pandemic based on online post text data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore the changes in the attention of the public and the trend of emotional changes in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic, based on web crawlers and big data statistical analysis technology. Public opinion information related to COVID-19 was especially obtained from Chinese online forums. The data was cleaned and filtered through data preprocessing operations, and statistical analysis was performed on multiple data characteristics to grasp the public opinion trends on the pandemic. The results of this study are of great significance for maintaining the social stability of China, the stable development of the economy, and the implementation of regular epidemic prevention and control measures and fully advancing work resumption.

articleTitle: PSO-SVM-based method for predicting the demand for airline material carriage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As an important military aircraft material, with the increase in the number of off-site flight missions, it is inevitable to transfer to other sites for carrying security. With the increase of joint exercises, target training and other missions, the mission environment is complex and changeable, which puts forward higher requirements on the level of carry guarantee, among which the accurate prediction of the demand for aviation materials in the mission is one of the main elements of good carry guarantee. In this paper, we propose to use Support Vector Machine (SVM) to predict the number of aircraft materials to be carried, and apply the Particle Swarm Algorithm (PSO) to optimize the SVM parameters. By simulating and comparing PSO-SVM, GS-SVM and GA-SVM, the PSO-SVM algorithm is able to predict the airline material carrying requirements more accurately in a shorter period of time.

articleTitle: Survey on indoor fingerprint localization for BLE
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The advent of Bluetooth Low Power (BLE) provides new opportunities for indoor positioning. BLE fingerprint positioning technology supports the use of battery-powered portable beacons, which can be widely used at low cost and is significantly superior to traditional WiFi transmission methods. At the same time, the transmission mode has been successfully applied to indoor positioning and navigation, nursing personnel tracking, accurate positioning in dangerous environment, fire rescue and other scenarios. This article reviews existing wireless indoor location solutions and classifies the different technologies and systems. Secondly, the ranging and non-ranging indoor positioning technology in BLE environment, as well as some evaluation indexes and influence factors of fingerprint positioning technology are introduced. Then, the current fingerprint localization applications and solutions are summarized and analyzed. The principle and process of fingerprint localization are emphatically expounded. Finally, this paper not only introduces BLE fingerprint positioning technology, but also puts forward the research problems and directions of indoor positioning.

articleTitle: A Lightweight YOLOv5 Transmission Line Defect Detection Method Based on Coordinate Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, in the power industry, there has always been a demand for intelligent computing and real-time feedback on the edge side using embedded devices. Due to the number of parameters, calculations, and memory usage of the deep learning model, its deployment on edge devices is severely affected. Based on this, this paper proposes a lightweight object detection network based on coordinate attention. The network is based on YOLOv5, decouples the large convolution kernels in the network in channel and space, reduces the parameters of the convolution kernel and the calculation amount of convolution operations, and realizes the lightweight processing of the network. In addition, a lightweight coordinate attention module is introduced into the network, and the model can obtain a larger area of information by embedding position information into the attention map without introducing large overheads, so that the model can increase a small amount of calculation while being significant improve the mAP of the model. The lightweight YOLOv5 model based on coordinate attention makes it possible to deploy on embedded devices with limited resources and achieve better detection results. Lightweight YOLOv5l, YOLOv5m, YOLOv5s, and YOLOv5n reduce FLOPs by about 60.94%, 55.69%, 46.25%, and 46.51%, respectively.

articleTitle: Cucumber Leaf Diseases Detection Based on An Improved Faster RCNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Crop disease is one of the main agricultural disasters. Using object detection technology for precision spraying is of great significance to environmental protection. In order to achieve cucumber leaf diseases detection under the natural environment, this paper proposes a cucumber leaf diseases detection method based on the improved faster region with convolutional neural network features (Faster RCNN). The model uses the residual convolutional neural network ResNet 50 as backbone to extract features from the input image, adopts feature pyramid networks (FPN) for feature fusion, then generates a series of proposal boxes through region proposal network (RPN), and ultimately generates bounding boxes and corresponding classes by the classification network. The results demonstrate that the network can reach a mAP value of 83<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the processing speed is 0.56 seconds per image. When the loss function is modified into GIOU, the mAP value boosts by 2%; when the anchor ratios are changed to 0.665, 1 and 1.53, mAP rises by 3.2%. The improved model has respectable generalization and robustness, which could be applied to the cucumber leaf diseases detection work well, gifting significantly promoting impact on farmland ecological protection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Novel 5G Wireless Communication Coverage Enhancing Service Mode with Power Towers and Street Lamp Poles Integrated
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the process of rapid deployment of 5G base stations (BSs), some prominent problems have been encountered: first, with the increase of signal frequency, the coverage area of existing BS poles and towers are insufficient; second, it is usually difficult to locate new BS poles and towers, and the investment for new BS poles and towers are huge. Public power facilities such as power towers and street lamps distributed in urban road systems at all levels, can provide a more flexible scheme for the location of 5G wireless communication BSs. Using the infrastructure of public power distribution system as tower resources can not only effectively solve the coverage problem of 5G wireless communication, but also revitalize the existing resources for power grid enterprises and improve the economic benefits to a great extent. In this paper, a novel 5G wireless communication coverage enhancing service mode with power towers and street lamp poles integrated has been proposed, which is based on the power supply companies in Zhejiang Province of the State Grid. By investigating the ownership and opening-up capacity of power towers and street lamp poles, the operation conditions, products and service mode has been studied, and relevant conclusions has been given.

articleTitle: Heuristic RRT fusion A* for 3D path planning of UAV
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Path planning is the key to the autonomous flight of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Aiming at the problems of blind search, long and zigzag path in the path planning of three-dimensional space environment, A heuristic bidirectional target RRT fusion A* algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the algorithm combines heuristic probability and bias expansion strategy to improve the target orientation of sampling. After obtaining the complete path point, the shortest path is obtained by fusing redundant nodes in the complete path of A* algorithm. Finally, B-spline algorithm is used to smooth the path, which obtains a smooth feasible path. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional B-RRT algorithm, the improved B-RRT algorithm improves the node utilization by 9.6 times, reduces the extension nodes by 86.9%, shorts the search time by 21.46%, and shorts the path by 7.9%.

articleTitle: Noise Classification Speech Enhancement Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of speech enhancement is to extract the speech signal from various noise backgrounds, improving the quality of the speech signal. After the emergence of the Speech Enhancement Generative Adversarial (SEGAN), it has achieved good results in the field of speech enhancement. However, SEGAN does not have an excellent speech enhancement effect in the case of low signal-to-noise ratio, it has weak generalization ability in the face of unknown noise. In this paper, we propose a method of generative adversarial network speech enhancement using noise background classification. In this method, the inputs are noisy speeches, which have a variety of background noises. Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) features of noisy speeches are extracted, convolutional neural network is used to classify each noisy background, and the classified noisy speeches are labeled with the type of background noise. The labeled noisy speeches are sent to the speech enhancement model. There are several SEGANs in the speech enhancement model. Each SEGAN enhances noisy speeches with a particular of background noise. Under extremely low signal-to-noise ratio conditions and in the face of unknown noise, we evaluate this method in extensive experiments, using objective evaluation indicators to evaluate the effectiveness of the model. Compared with the SEGAN model under the condition of extremely low signal-to-noise ratio, the model in this paper can eliminate noise better, and each objective index has been improved. In the face of unknown background noise, objective evaluation index of NCSEGAN is better than SEGAN, which confirms the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Security Gateway for Transmission Line Panoramic Monitoring Platform based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the scale of power Internet of things, the accumulation and increase of acquisition equipment and data, the traditional secure access gateway can not well meet the complexity requirements of relevant business systems in the transmission industry.
