This paper studies the common access technologies and business scenarios of Internet of things gateway. Combined with the design concept of micro service architecture, this paper puts forward a design scheme of unified access security gateway in transmission industry, which meets the needs of multi type equipment access and massive third-party data exchange of transmission platform, and realizes authentication, authorization, flow control, access control, routing conversion, protocol conversion, log monitoring and other functions. At present, the security gateway based on this design scheme has passed the system security detection of Electric Power Research Institute, and has been applied in the panoramic monitoring platform of transmission line in Qinghai Province, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Detection of Weak Ship Radiation Characteristic Signal based on Wavelet and Chaos Array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The ship radiated noise not only has the chaotic characteristic, but also the characteristic signal in the radiated noise is often covered by the complex marine environment noise. This makes the performance of many algorithms greatly reduced in the actual target recognition. This makes the performance of many algorithms greatly reduced in the actual target recognition. In this paper, a new detection method based on wavelet transform and chaos theory is proposed, the existence, frequency and phase of weak signal are detected by wavelet chaotic oscillator array. Firstly, a threshold selection algorithm based on wavelet packet decomposition coefficients and unbiased estimation is proposed to automatically determine the decomposition level and denoising threshold of wavelet. This method can overcome the blindness and irrationality of decomposition and threshold selection in wavelet denoising. Then, the judgment basis based on the Melnikov function and the zero-crossing detection method is proposed, which not only avoids the ambiguity between the chaotic critical state and the large-scale periodic state in the chaotic system, but also successfully detects the frequency and phase of the signal to be measured under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio. Finally, the correlation algorithm is applied to the sea survey experiment. The experimental results show the correctness and effectiveness of the algorithm. Finally, the algorithm is used to detect the radiation noise of the actual ship, and the line spectrum component in the noise is successfully detected. This provides new theories and methods for the subsequent detection and target recognition of ships and underwater targets.

articleTitle: UAF-based Air Transportation Cooperative Information SoS Modeling under ‘Belt and Road Initiative’
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the research on System of Systems (SoS) modeling is carried out based on the Unified Architecture Framework (UAF), to solve the problems of system heterogeneity, information inconsistency, insufficient data sharing, and low operational efficiency in the ‘Belt and Road Initiative’ air transportation environment. Firstly, the comparison between UAF and other architecture frameworks is carried out, verifying the superiority of the former. Then, combing with the classical Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF) development procedure, the process of UAF -based Air Transportation Cooperative Information (ATCI) SoS modeling is put forward, and the corresponding minimum UAF grid is cut out. Furthermore, according to the proposed process, multi-view modeling is carried out in the domains of requirements, parameters, strategic, operational, personnel, resources, etc., and different characteristics of the target SoS are shown from multiple perspectives. The research results can effectively facilitate the development of the prototype system, and provide an important means for exploring the new mechanism of ATCI SoS and its optimization and evaluation.

articleTitle: TFChain:Blockchain-based Trusted Forensics Scheme for Mobile Phone Data Whole Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the usage of mobile phones to commit crimes is becoming more and more common. Mobile electronic evidence can be used to convict suspects. However, the credibility of electronic evidence is a key issue in the research of mobile phone forensics. Therefore, credible mobile phone forensics is crucial in police investigations. In previous studies, some scholars have used the computer live forensics of memory analysis to obtain the physical memory mapping files of mobile phones. This model can naturally distinguish the various stages of online forensics and meet the requirements of physical evidence technology. The rapid development of blockchain technology has brought research opportunities to the academic community. The decentralized, tamper-resistant, and traceable characteristics of blockchain technology have given new opportunities and connotations to the electronic evidence collection system. In this paper, we combine the advantages of blockchain and the effectiveness of memory analysis to propose a trusted mobile phone forensics program based on blockchain and memory analysis. Blockchain runs through the whole system process to ensure the credibility, integrity and auditability of evidence. Then, we use access control to realize the access authority of police investigators and forensic experts to the evidence. Next, forensic experts analyze the evidence and generate a forensic evaluation report. In the forensic phase, we use credible mobile phone memory acquisition tool to obtain evidence. In the identification phase, we use memory analysis to check the integrity and credibility of the evidence. Moreover, the online forensics based on memory analysis that we use is repeatable and verifiable. In addition, we choose the consortium chain to record the transaction behavior of entities. Finally, we tested our system on Hyperledger Fabric and analyzed the security and privacy of TFChain.

articleTitle: Classification of Arrhythmia From ECG Signals Using CSL-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) has become one of the main diseases threatening human life and health. As an important tool for doctors to diagnose and analyze cardiovascular diseases, it is necessary to improve the accuracy of Electrocardiogram (ECG) classification. In this paper, we proposed a new network model called CSL-NET that uses a combination of convolutional neural network (CNN), SE block and long short-term memory (LSTM) for ECG signal processing and arrhythmia classification. The algorithm uses wavelet transform to filter the ECG signal, and then input it to CNN to extract ECG features automatically. An SE block is added to the end of CNN layer, in which, the extracted features are recalibrated to selectively emphasize useful features and suppress less relevant features. After that, input the data to the LSTM layer to extract the temporal information from the ECG signal. The experiment was performed on the ECG signal collected in the MIT-BIH database. Ultimately, the accuracy, sensitivity (recall rate), predicted value and F1 score of the CSL-NET model we proposed reached 99.52%, 98.23%, 99.22% and 98.93% respectively. Experimental results indicate that the proposed model has great potential for application in clinical practice, including wearable devices and intensive care units.

articleTitle: Intent detection model based on dual-channel feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The intelligent customer service system is an important part of power marketing and an important window for the power sector's external services. Spoken language understanding(SLU) is the core module of the dialogue system. Intent detection is a key subtask of the spoken language understanding module, which directly determines whether the spoken language understanding module is correct. Understand the purpose of the user's words. In view of the current use of commonly used deep learning methods such as RNN and CNN to deal with the limited semantic representation and insufficient feature extraction caused by intent detection, this paper proposes an intent detection model based on dual-channel feature fusion (Dual-channel Model), using The capsule network captures rich text features, makes up for the lack of local spatial information in the pooling operation, and further improves the representation limitations of CNN and RNN. At the same time, it uses the high-level features extracted by the pooling operation and the capsule network to form a dual-channel feature extraction mechanism, and The feature fusion of the two channels is used for the final intent detection. Experiments show that on the ATIS and SMP2019-ECDT datasets, the proposed model has an accuracy of 98.1% and 96.25% in intent detection, and an F1 value of 88.5% and 89.76%.

articleTitle: A precise location method for mine personnel based on residual estimation Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Passive moving target localization is one of the key technologies for the safety of operators in underground spaces of mines and timely rescue after disasters. The current algorithm for locating personnel in mines has problems such as low positioning accuracy and susceptibility to non-line-of-sight (NLOS) error interference, etc. In this paper, we propose a method for accurate positioning of mine personnel based on residual estimation Kalman filtering. Firstly, a dual-range TOA ranging technique is used to effectively suppress the measurement errors caused by equipment time asynchrony in signal transmission; then the measured data are pre-processed using the trend shift method to suppress the noise of small probability and large interference in the measured signal; finally, a Kalman filter introducing the idea of residual estimation is designed to overcome the effects of nanosecond dense multipath signals and background noise existing in the mine, thus The accuracy of the measurement of the personnel position in the mine tunnel is improved. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method has strong robustness in the tunnel environment, and the localization accuracy is significantly improved, reducing the impact of non-visual error noise and dense multipath effect on the performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Spam Classification Method Based on Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Currently, spam will do everything possible to bypass or destroy the spam classifier. This paper proposes a naive Bayesian spam classification method, and designs Bernoulli naive Bayes algorithm and polynomial naive Bayes algorithm to classify English spam and Chinese spam respectively. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper has a high precision rate and recall rate, and can classify spam simply, accurately and efficiently.

articleTitle: 5G Smart Grid Network Slice Backup Method Based on the Quality of Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the 5G mobile communication network virtualization scenario, how to deploy network slicing with high quality is a prerequisite for large-scale commercial use of 5G in the future. Cut for 5G networks. The quality of the chip deployment is based on the NFV backup configuration of the power business. In ultra-reliable and low-latency scenarios, high-quality VNF backup configurations in slices are realized. And on this basis, construct a mathematical model of network slicing deployment, which will benefit. Solve with a highly reliable backup algorithm based on reinforcement learning, and find the deployment plan with the lowest deployment cost of network slicing. Simulation experiments show that the deployment strategy is ensuring deployment security. Under the premise of reducing deployment costs, while obtaining better security benefits and deployment profitability.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Setting of Calciner Temperature Under Typical Abnormal Working Conditions Based on Rule Based Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the setting temperature of the decomposing furnace cannot be timely and accurately given under typical abnormal conditions in the process of raw cement predecomposition, the key variables of the raw cement predecomposition link are analyzed based on the technological characteristics of the raw cement predecomposition process. Based on Rule Based Reasoning (RBR) technology, the working condition recognition rule base was established to identify typical abnormal working conditions, and then the disposal suggestions and the optimal temperature setting value of the calciner under corresponding working conditions were given, which provided guidance for the working condition recognition and disposal of the calciner under typical abnormal working conditions as well as the optimal temperature setting.

articleTitle: Low Energy Consumption Adaptive Adjustment Link Protocol Suitable for UAV Transmission Line Inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have unique advantages in size, speed, mobility and other aspects and the ability to work continuously. They have gradually become an economic and feasible intelligent new choice in the process of power patrol. Due to the characteristics of the distribution of power transmission lines, the topology of the UAVs patrol network is presented as link structure. In the process of patrolling, it is necessary to ensure that all UAVs work in a coordinated and orderly manner, and can achieve high speed and large capacity information interaction. For the characteristics of UAVs transmission line inspection that UAV joins into the network one by one, this paper proposes a protocol that can make adaptive adjustments to changes in the network scale. Simulation results show that the protocol can dynamically adjust the number of nodes to find the optimal solution that minimizes the energy consumption in the network size for a certain length of patrol line.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electric Power UI Automation Construction System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As an important part of the system, UI is an indispensable part of all systems. UI directly interacts with users. The quality of UI directly affects the user's experience and evaluation of the system. In the B/S architecture, UI refers to the web interface that the user sees. Since the UI is displayed on the client and the server runs on the server, and the UI and the server use different languages, the UI and the server are often separated from each other, and the logical correlation between the UI and the server code is not considered. In fact, a lot of server-side information can be used for UI development. At the same time, there are many repetitive structures and behaviors in the UI, which need to be coded each time. This article proposes a UI automation construction technology, which investigates and determines the minimum information set required to generate the UI, the mapping relationship between the information set and the UI, and the common display units. Finally we complete a high-quality user interface with a minimum of work.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Health Management Technology of Opto-electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of China's weapon equipments and the continuous progress of information technology, the demand for the mobility, reliability, unmanned and flexible networking ability of opto-electronic measurement equipment is increasing. Breakthrough in the intelligent health management technology of opto-electronic equipment has become a major requirement for unmanned intelligent shooting range construction. Focusing on the opto-electronic measuring equipment in the shooting range, this paper detailed analyzes the development status of health management technology at home and abroad. Then it introduces the health diagnosis and decision-making strategy of opto-electronic equipment. According to a certain type of opto-electronic equipment, three health state early warning models are established and compared: health state early warning model based on statistical analysis, health state early warning model based on machine learning and health state early warning model based on neural network, subsystem simulation is given. Finally, the development direction of intelligent health management technology of opto-electronic equipment is predicted, the next work to be carried out is pointed out.

articleTitle: Power Stability Control Model of Tie-line Containing Wind Power Grid Connection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The high proportion of renewable energy and its uncertainty increase the difficulty of switching power control in multi-regional AC interconnection systems. To ensure the coordinated distribution of the inter-regional tie-line power and the relative balance of fluctuations, this paper proposes a switching power stability control model that considers the external characteristics of the interconnected power grid. Firstly, considering the relationship between the AGC(Automatic Generation Control) participation factors of the interconnected system and the distribution of the tie-line power flow, the power flow model under the control of the interconnected system AGC is derived and constructed. Secondly, with the minimum power fluctuation amplitude of the tie-line as the objective, a robust optimization-based regional switching power stability control model is established, and a co-evolution algorithm based on the relaxation method is proposed to solve the robust model. Finally, case studies based on the dual IEEE30 bus system demonstrate that the proposed robust optimization can more effectively cope with the influence of the random output of renewable energy than no optimization. Moreover, the proposed model has a significant improvement effect on the stability of external characteristics. The calculation example verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: GhostSiamRPN++: Optimizing SiamRPN++ via GhostModule
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: SiamRPN++ is a Siamese network based tracker in object tracking and it has excellent performance. However, SiamRPN++ is a ResNet-driven tracker with huge amounts of parameters and calculations. It has extremely strict requirements for hardware and devices without professional GPU are difficult to meet the requirements. So SiamRPN++ should become more lightweight by optimization. In this paper, we propose a lightweight tracker named GhostSiamRPN++ by optimizing SiamRPN++ and replacing the ResNet backbone with a lightweight backbone build by GhostModule. When compared to SiamRPN++, GhostSiamRPN++ reduce 84% parameters, 92% calculations and 52% memory usage and it boost the FPS by 55% on GPU and by 545% on CPU. Large scale optimization does not bring great loss of performance. When tested on VOT and OTB datasets, GhostSiamRPN++ shows excellent performance in all videos and leading performance in some specific videos and it has 4.5% to 13.6% lower accuracy than SiamRPN++.

articleTitle: Research on Precision Positioning Technology of High Dynamic Target Based on Motion Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The research on the high precision target measurement method and its key technology based on the motion platform can provide a new measurement system and a new mode of high precision, full function, quick response, small and light, free and flexible, close observation, high efficiency, and strong generality for photoelectric measurement field. According to different usage requirements, this article focuses on the real-time positioning requirements of the target based on the motion platform, and analyzes principle and process in detail of these four real-time high dynamic target positioning methods: single station angle measurement and distance measurement positioning method, the single-station settlement solution based on the collinear equation, the high-precision positioning solution with cooperative identification, the double - machine intersection measurement solution. Then the sources of error and methods to improve accuracy are analyzed [1]–[3]. The measurement mechanism based on motion platform in this paper can be networked with the existing range measurement system to achieve target tracking and measurement in a full range, which is conducive to enhancing the comprehensive test capability of the range and can be widely used in missile weapon system and naval navigation system and other range tests.

articleTitle: Performance Output Tracking for an ODE-PDE Cascade System with Non-collocated Configurations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Output tracking for a type of ODE-PDE cascade system where the performance output are non-collocated to the controller is researched in this paper. Trajectory planning is adopted to overcome the problem of unmatched configuration between input and output. Firstly we design state feedback by using the method of pole assignment. According to the separation principle, the state feedback can be designed separately from the state observer. Therefore, a state observer based on feedback law is put forward to reconstruct the whole state of system. Due to the only measurement point is the output point, output feedback control law is given by combining state feedback control and state observer. Finally, the numercial simulation is given to prove the exponential convergence of the error between the output and reference signal.

articleTitle: A Digital Twin Model for Dynamic Optimization of Metal Cutting Process Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Metal cutting process optimization problem has been extensively studied in the past few decades, researchers either conduct experimental design, develop heuristic algorithms or design expert system to optimize process parameters. The main idea of the past research is to optimize a set of process parameters before executing the entire process steps, which fails to effectively respond to the needs of dynamic manufacture environment. However, very little research has focused on the dynamic optimization of process parameters during the process. Digital twin is commonly known as the enabling technology to solve the dynamic problem in the industrial sector. This paper proposes a novel digital twin framework for metal cutting process dynamic optimization during the metal cutting process. Five characteristics of digital twin model of the proposed framework are analyzed. In this framework, a metal cutting process digital twin model is proposed to dynamically infer the optimal process parameters while interacting with its physical counterpart during the process. An information model for the metal cutting process digital twin is put forward to formalize the representation of the comprehensive information between the digital twin and its physical counterpart. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed digital twin model are tested in a case study on a milling process.

articleTitle: A Study of E-learning Style
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide new empirical evidence on online learning style measurement, a topic of great interest in the academic literature during the last several years. This paper comes up with learning style modeling on the footing of Felder-Silverman theorem. Bayesian Network Methodology is resorted to solve the specification by virtue of data arising from selected sampling learners, who specialize in learning tasks through Service-Oriented Adaptive Learning System. This paper finds that the most popular mode for e-education is reflective-typed, representing 65% of all sampled students, followed by the visual style accounting for 55% and the sequential style accounting for 45%, in their own dimension. However, the global learning fashion under the dimension of comprehension is found to comprise 10% of the experimented, showcasing that this learning style is less employed in e-educational activity. This paper also discovers that the balance style of e-learning has gained ground among e-students, capturing 45%, 35% and 30% in the comprehension dimension, perception and input, separately. Furthermore, the results turn out to be of high accuracy and robustness, confirmed by Solomon Scale. This paper concludes with pointing out implications for online schooling and future research.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Person Re- Identification by Mining Semantic Features and Applying New Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Person re-identification performance has progressed greatly in recent years, and this technique has been applied to many fields. While many person re-identification algorithms are devoted to building complex network structures for robustness and accuracy, this approach often places a high demand on hardware and software support. To overcome the performance-complexity trade-off, in this paper we propose a Semantic Attention Network(SA-Net), which does not need a complex network while bringing clear performance gain. Firstly, we design a lightweight semantic segmentation subnetwork, which can effectively remove the background redundant information. As a result, in the process of person re-identification, only the specific pedestrian features can be obtained, and the network can pay more attention to pedestrian parts rather than to the background. Secondly, considering the importance of attention mechanism in person re-identification tasks and to integrate the pedestrian features better, we apply the typical attention mechanism proposed in [5] and improve the module to integrate the persons' channel feature faster. The proposed Semantic Attention network has been evaluated on two publicly available benchmark datasets to show its superior performance over the state-of-the-art methods. The top-1 average accuracy of our method on the Market-1501 dataset reaches 96.35%. Compared the typical person re-identification model: Attentive but Diverse Network [3], the top-1 accuracy of our theory increases by 0.75% on Market-1501 dataset and 0.97% on DukeMTMC-reID dataset.

articleTitle: ASTS: Attention-based spectrum truncation synthesis for step frequency signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication technology, various special pulse waveforms are widely used in radar technology to meet specific requirements. The stepped frequency (SF) signal has properties of low instantaneous band-width, high synthetic bandwidth, and high resolution, which is popular in high-precision target detection. Therefore, researches on SF signals have attracted extensive attention recently. In this paper, we introduced an attention mechanism into spectrum synthesis and finally proposed a novel method called Attention-based Spectrum Truncation Synthesis (ASTS) to solve the problem of energy fluctuation caused by spectrum aliasing and our ASTS method performs better than spectrum superposition synthesis (SSS) algorithm in Peak Sidelobe Ratio (PSLR). Furthermore, we found a noticeable phenomenon in detection caused by a dramatic phase jump happening with the RSF signals when detecting the moving targets. Through the theoretical analysis, we concluded formulas indicating how we could compensate for this phase jump and make the RSF achieve a similar PSLR performance as the LSF does.

articleTitle: Additional PMUs configuration method based on system topology model and mathematical model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The dynamic behavior of the distribution network is more complex than that of the transmission network. The multi-source bidirectional flow of fault currents and the increase in power electronics can cause oscillations in the distribution network, so it is especially important to monitor and control the distribution network in real time. Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) is a realistic real-time measurement of distribution network data, and a reasonable configuration of PMU is an important way to monitor the distribution network. Achieving optimal configuration of PMUs not only reduces the number of PMUs and equipment investment on the premise of ensuring system viewability, but also alleviates communication pressure and reduces data latency. Typically, the initial PMU configuration ensures that the entire system is observable, but the situation may change when zero injection conditions are missing or when the system topology model changes. In this paper, we propose a method to configure additional PMUs based on the topological and mathematical models of the system, taking the unobservable nodes obtained through the mathematical model of the system as the object of study, and using the topological model of the system to obtain the location of additional PMUs, so that the number of configured PMUs is minimized and the redundancy of the system is maximized while ensuring the observability of the system. The method was applied to the IEEE standard node system for simulation and analysis, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the method were verified.

articleTitle: A prediction model of turbofan engine remaining life based on improved algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The turbofan engine is an important part of the aircraft. If the equipment life cycle can be accurately predicted, it can not only bring huge benefits to the airline company, but also reduce the safety accidents caused by turbofan engine failure. In the field of life cycle prediction, long-short-term Memory (LSTM) network is particularly favored by the field of prediction maintenance because of its ability to learn from sequences. It can use time series data for a longer time review, so it is suitable for device life prediction using time series data. In this paper, the c-MAPSS data set of rotary motor is taken as the research object, and its life prediction model is studied based on LSTM. In this paper, principal component analysis algorithm and SNM optimization algorithm are used to optimize experimental data and extract features, and the traversal parameters of LSTM model are optimized. Finally, the cross-validation method is used to learn and integrate the data model. The experimental results show that compared with the original algorithm model, the integrated model can improve the precision and recall rate of the model by optimizing the original data, reducing the data dimension and duplicate data, and reducing the operation complexity.

articleTitle: New Results on Attacking AES with a Secret S-box
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: AES has been an research priority and a difficulty in cryptography since it was proposed. Replacing AES S-box with a random S-box can highly increase the secret information of the cipher, which can be a significant method to improve AES, therefore research on AES with a secret S-box has great theoretical significance. Subspace trail cryptanalysis can be regarded as an expansion of invariant subspace, which was proposed recently to attack cryptographic cipher. Subspace trail cryptanalysis has the advantages that it works independently of S-box and can work together with other cryptographic methods, which can be used to attack AES with a secret S-box. In this paper, we present a new distinguisher of 5 rounds AES-128 that exploits subspace trail cryptanalysis and impossible differential cryptanalysis, then we show an attack on 6 rounds AES with data complexity of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">108</sup> and computational cost of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">106.35</sup>round-reduced AES encryption. Compared to the past attacking result, our attack has promotion in several respects.

articleTitle: The Construction Techniques of Artificial Intelligence Hierarchical Dataset in Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence datasets now are common in power electric companies for their own research work. Many Artificial Intelligence research are data-driven and require large amount of data. A single company's dataset only contains quite limited amount of data. In this paper, a hierarchical dataset is introduced, with larger and higher level dataset to unify lower level dataset to provide more valuable data than a single one. The basic ideas in designs of different existing datasets are analyzed and a hierarchical structure that integrate existing dataset features is proposed. In order to condense the data in higher level dataset, the data collection standard is designed based on data category priority and annotation. By separating the data synchronization API and data management API, both physically and logically data collection can be realized. We discussed the unification of annotation rules of the existing different datasets. Based on the relationship between the annotation data and the annotation rules, we put forward the method to get unified annotation rules. At last we introduced the implementation of hierarchical dataset, which considers the critical points of data storage method and data synchronization.

articleTitle: Research on Decomposition and Equivalent Model of Low Frequency Response Spectrum of Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Low frequency spectral lines based on frequency domain dielectric spectra contain multiple conductance dispersion processes. In order to solve the lack of low-frequency response analysis method and imperfect equivalent circuit model, Kramers Kronig transformation method is used to analyze the conductance, infinite frequency capacitance and relaxation process, and then introduce the Dissado-Hill model to establish the low-frequency dielectric response equivalent circuit model. Finally, the oil paper with different moisture content was prepared Insulation samples underwent FDS measurements, and the obtained frequency domain test data were analyzed by analytical spectral line analysis and equivalent circuit model parameter identification. The results show that the Kramers Kronig transform can effectively uncouple and analyze the polarization process, conductance process and infinite frequency capacitance, and it also proved that the Dissado-Hill model has good fitting with different moisture content sample.

articleTitle: Improved Stochastic Load Flow Model Considering Electro-thermal Coupling Effect Of Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To fully reveal the operating state of the power system and its potential operating risks, especially the thermal overload problem of the transmission line, this paper proposes an improved stochastic load flow model considering electro-thermal coupling effects of the transmission line. Firstly, the Latin-Hypercube sampling method is used to obtain the system status set according to the probability distribution of renewable generation output and load power. Then, based on the steady-state electro-thermal coupling power flow (ETC-PF), the stochastic load flow (SLF) mixed solution model is established to calculate system status. And the probability distributions of line temperature, power supply and bus voltage are obtained to fully reveal the potential operating risks of the system. To ensure the accuracy of the proposed model, the distribution of unbalanced power and the limitation of reactive power output are considered in the SLF. Take the IEEE30-bus system as an example to verify the effectiveness of the model and method.

articleTitle: Study on the Classification Method of Dry Alfalfa Samples with Disperse Quality Based on a Bionic Electronic Nose
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the development of grassland husbandry, it is necessary to use a fast and convenient method to classify and identify grasses. In this study, an electronic nose (Ε-nose) based on a highly sensitive heated metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) sensor was used to detect the odours of dried alfalfa samples with disperse quality. The data obtained by the Ε-nose were visually classified by principal component analysis (PCA) and linear discriminant analysis (LDA). In addition, four machine learning algorithms, namely, the radial basis function neural network (RBFN), naive Bayesian (NBM), Κ nearest neighbour (KNN) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms, are applied to build recognition models for different classification tasks. The experimental results show that the performance of the four algorithms is relatively good. The classification accuracy of the LDA-based algorithm is higher than that of the other algorithms, and the recognition accuracy is the best. at 100%. The results show that LDA can extract important information from the original data and prove that the Ε-nose is a fast and feasible identification technology.

articleTitle: Robust state estimation based on multi-kernel correntropy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of robust state estimation under multi-mode non-Gaussian noise environment is investigated. The standard Kalman filter is optimal under Gaussian noise assumption. However, when noise is generated by multiple sources and corrupted by outliers, it means that the noise distribution is multimodal and non-Gaussian, then the performance of the standard Kalman filter will be severely degraded. In this work, a multi-kernel correntropy based state filter is developed. Correntropy is a generalized similarity measure between two random variables, and is insensitive to outliers. Since the noise distribution is multimodal instead of unimodal, a new multi-kernel correntropy based optimization objective function is constructed. The proposed state filter mainly consists of two steps, prediction step and correction step, where priori estimate and posterior estimate are computed respectively. The capabilities of the proposed filter are demonstrated on a benchmark navigation problem.

articleTitle: Research on optimal control strategy for velocity stability of space two-dimensional tracking turntable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Focusing on the high-definition dynamic imaging requirements of space targets, based on the space two-dimensional turntable equipped with optical equipment, aiming at the image blur caused by speed fluctuation in a single exposure time, this paper focuses on the action mechanism of cable winding torque nonlinearity, torque fluctuation in brushless DC motor control, precision loss caused by speed measurement feedback error, so as to break through the optimal control strategy of turntable speed stationarity under large rotation range and strong coupling torque disturbance [1-3]. The problems are solved by the systematic strategies, such as cable bundle management, precision machining and assembly, high-precision speed feedback, torque compensation in commutation section of Brushless DC motor, target motion trajectory fitting and prediction method. Finally, the simulation realizes azimuth axis speed stability as 0.002°/s(σ) and pitch axis speed stability as 0.0016°/s(σ)[4]. The technology can be applied to the control field with high speed stability of optoelectric turntable or other moving mechanisms[5].

articleTitle: General style transfer model of wavelet network combined with self-attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Artistic style transfer refers to using two images (content image and style image) as a reference, preserving the content of the content image as much as possible and transferring the style characteristics of the style image to content image. Existing methods usually use various normalization techniques, but these techniques have limitations in completely transferring different textures to different spatial locations. The method based on self-attention has solved this problem and made some progress, but there are also unobvious image textures, resulting in unnecessary artifacts. There are also attempts to add a mask to fix the image layout for style transfer, but it is difficult to produce a coordinated result at the mask boundary. Someone tried to embed the wavelet network in the VGG network to obtain more detailed stylized images, and indeed achieved more visually pleasing results. To solve these problems, this paper attempts to combine the advantages of wavelet transform, self-attention mechanism, whitening and coloring transform WCT (Whiten-Color Transform) in image feature extraction, and propose a new general style transfer method to better weigh the semantic information and style characteristics of content images and style images. Moreover, this paper use the self-attention mechanism to obtain the high-level semantic information of the image to make up for the missing details of the reconstructed image. Compared with the previous methods, the proposed method does not need to train for a certain feature map, and any style map can be used to transfer the style of the content map. Experimental results show that the model has good effects in terms of style transfer and artifact removal, and also prove that the method has good versatility.

articleTitle: Optimization of vibro-noise in the pipeline system of centrifugal pump
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The vibro-noise of a homemade centrifugal pump excited by the internal unsteady flow are numerically investigated. The unsteady flow field is solved by using the shear stress transport <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{k}-\omega$</tex> model. The computed results are adopted to extract the pressure fluctuations on the inner walls which are fed to the structural analysis to excite the vibro-noise. The sound pressure level (SPL) of the internal noise of the centrifugal pump is experimentally obtained, confirming the effectiveness of the numerical method. In this paper, the structure of perforated plate is designed to optimize the vibro-noise caused by the pressure fluctuations of the fluid. It is found that the perforated plate has a significant effect on suppressing the vibro-noise of the pipe under the studied conditions by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Decision Table-based Conformance Testing Research of AUTOSAR Operating System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The Automotive Open Systems Architecture (AUTOSAR) operating system specification defines a series of abstract standard interfaces for automotive embedded operating systems and their related services. The traditional conformance test case design method suffers from high redundancy and poor reusability. This study designs a conformance testing method for AUTOSAR operating systems based on decision tables. The decision table is a symbolic means to express the logical interdependence of events, which can list the complex logical relationships and multiple condition combination cases in detail. Through the conformance testing experiments on the task management module of AUTOSAR standard operating system, the method eliminates 8 redundant test cases compared with the traditional method, and the test cases generated by the decision table method corresponding to the conformance class level are also reusable, reducing the testing effort by 16.3%.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph of Power Communication Planning based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent level of power communication network planning, a method for constructing a knowledge graph of power communication planning based on deep learning is proposed for the problems of lengthy power communication planning report text and low information extraction efficiency. This article takes the power communication planning text as the research object, constructs the knowledge organization structure of the power communication knowledge graph from top to bottom, and defines the entity concept and the relation concept. A variety of deep learning models are comprehensively used for knowledge extraction. Bi-LSTM-CRF model is used for named entity recognition, and PCNN model is used for entity relationship extraction, forming entity relationship table in power communication planning text. The effectiveness of the above method is verified by simulation experiment. Finally, the data storage and visualization are realized through Neo4j graph database.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Matching of an Improved ORB Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) algorithm in complex environments, such as low matching accuracy and poor real-time performance. An improved AGAST feature point detection fusion ORB algorithm is proposed. First, build Gaussian pyramid to generate scale-invariant AGAST, then use gray-scale centroid method to generate directional feature point descriptors, and finally use Hamming distance to complete the matching, and combine RANSAC to optimize the matching results; at the same time, this article focuses on the AGAST algorithm The fixed threshold is improved in the middle, and an adaptive threshold method is proposed. The experimental results show that, compared with the original ORB algorithm, the algorithm proposed in this paper improves the time by 15.41%, and has a good matching accuracy under the environment of varying illumination and rotation scale.

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Based on Pre-LN Transformer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to extract and integrate semantic information collected from multimodal data to identify the information and emotions expressed in multimodal data. The main focus of this area of research is to develop an extraordinary fusion solution that can extract and integrate key information from a variety of patterns. In view of the problems of the existing model, such as weak parallel computing ability and insufficient remote dependence processing, this paper proposes a cross-modal contextual interaction model (CMCI-PLNT) based on Pre-LN Transformer to carry out the information interaction between language, audio and video, and uses the self-attention module to filter redundant information. Finally, the residual network was used to fuse the information and perform emotion analysis. The core of the model is directed pairwise cross-modal attention, which focuses on the interaction between multi-modal sequences at different time steps. Our model achieves 81.2% accuracy on the MOSI dataset and 81.5% accuracy on the MOSEI dataset, The experiment shows the feasibility and effectiveness of the model in this paper.

articleTitle: Motion Simulation of 600 km/h High-speed Maglev Train Under the Condition of Multiple Groups
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: As a new type of transportation, maglev trans have the advantages of speed, safety and comfort. Maglev trains are different from traditional wheel-rail trains. Electromagnets generate levitation force and guiding force, and linear motors generate traction force[1]. Direct contact between the train and the track is avoided during operation. The development of maglev trains research is inevitably inseparable from the structure of the vehicle and its research on sports characteristics. As the core of the entire maglev transportation system, the operation control system completes tasks such as train operation control, safety protection, automatic operation and dispatch management. In order to verify the reliability of the operation control system and the feasibility of the control strategy, a reasonable and accurate vehicle kinematics model becomes particularly important. This paper draws on the research results of wheel-rail trains, and according to the characteristics of maglev trains, the mathematical model of maglev trains under the condition of multiple groups has greatly reduced the traction calculation error and is closer to the actual operation of the train.

articleTitle: An Analytical Solution for Inverse Kinematics of 7-DOF Redundant Manipulators with Offsets at Elbow and Wrist
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an analytical solution for inverse kinematics of the seven-degree-of-freedom (7-DOF) redundant manipulator with offsets at the elbow and the wrist which is modelled on Franka Emika manipulator. The modified Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) model of the manipulator is established. Then according to the manipulator's configuration, the elbow offset structure is analyzed with geometric method. The wrist offset is solved by transforming coordinate, and the 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> joint angle is given in advance. Based on the analysis of the elbow and wrist offsets, an inverse kinematic solution is derived by the fixed-arm-angle method. Moreover, due to the joint angle and workspace limits, the value range of the 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> joint angle needed is analyzed and calculated. At the end of this paper, the joint motion of the manipulator is simulated in MATLAB, which verifies the correctness of the method for obtaining the inverse kinematic solution of the redundant manipulator with offsets at the elbow and the wrist.

articleTitle: Radiographic Image Enhancement Method For Complex Components based on Deep Learning Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The internal defects of complex components are usually detected by X-ray, and the detection images generally have the problems of large gray change and low contrast. The research on image enhancement method is of great significance to improve the accuracy of defect recognition. To overcome the problems of adjusting parameters and the influence of personnel experience in traditional enhancement methods, this paper proposes a radiographic image enhancement method based on deep learning theory. Firstly, according to the requirements of radiographic image enhancement, the target data set of radiographic image enhancement is constructed. Secondly, using the deep learning theory, an improved U-Net network image enhancement model is designed to realize image structure preservation and noise removal. Finally, the proposed method is illustrated and verified by the radiographic images of complex metal components.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Domain Channel Estimation Method Based on OTFS System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G technology, the new generation of wireless communication system needs to support high-speed transmission in the high-speed mobile environment and has more stringent requirements for channel estimation. The wireless communication channel will inevitably produce multipath effect and Doppler effect in high-speed mobile environment, so that the channel response will experience time-frequency dual selection fading, which will seriously affect the system performance. In this paper, we mainly study the Orthogonal Time Frequency & Space (OTFS) system based on Frequency domain pilot channel estimation method. The channel impulse response is estimated by Basis Expansion Models (BEM) combined with Linear Minimum Mean Squared Error (LMMSE) channel estimation method. Simulation analysis shows that the channel estimation method proposed in this paper can be applied to OTFS system, and has larger signal-to-noise ratio gain and improved symbol error rate performance compared with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system.

articleTitle: Text-Guided Image Inpainting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Given a corrupted image, image inpainting aims to complete the image and outputs a plausible result. When we complete the missing region, we always borrow the information from a known area, which is aimless and causes unsatisfactory results. In our daily life, some other information is often used for corrupted images, such as text descriptions. Therefore, we introduce the use of text information to guide image inpainting. To fulfill this task, We introduce an inpainting model named TGNet (Text-Guided Inpainting Network). We provide a text-image gated feature fusion module to fuse text feature and image feature deeply. A mask attention module is proposed to enhance the consistency of known areas and the repaired area. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on three public datasets with captions demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Detection Algorithm for Broken Strands of Transmission Wires
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to discover hidden dangers such as broken strands and loose strands of transmission wires, a vision-based detection algorithm for broken strands of transmission wires is proposed in this paper. The edge detection algorithm is used to detect the edge information of the transmission wire in the image. Taking into account the shape of the transmission line, the improved LSD (Line Segment detector) algorithm is used to obtain the transmission line pixel points of the sub-pixel precision. Using a vision-based segmentation method, the discontinuous wire pixels are grown in regions to produce continuous wire pixels. Finally, the wire defect judging method is used to find the hidden trouble of the wire.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Compound Axis Control of Periscope Optical Communication Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In this paper, the problems of bandwidth matching, miss distance calculation and control loop coupling in the composite axis control system of optical communication terminal are analyzed and deduced in detail. Firstly, the relation between coarse and fine tracking bandwidth ratio is described. Secondly, the theoretical formula of miss distance under image rotation is derived by means of coordinate system transformation. Finally, a cooperative control strategy is proposed to achieve high precision tracking of the system. The accuracy and effectiveness of the above methods are verified by system simulation and test platform, which lays a theoretical and technical foundation for the application of the composite axis control system of the latent optical communication terminal.

articleTitle: Dynamic Time Slot Allocation for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks using Directional Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Directional antennas have several advantages compared to omni-directional antennas: higher gains, more robust against jamming and denial of service, etc, which make it favorable to use in mobile ad hoc networks (MANET). Combined with Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol that could achieve conflict-free data transmission, directional antennas provide significantly greater throughput. A crucial part of directional MAC protocol is time slot allocation, yet current allocation schemes cannot achieve a desirable balance between throughput, traffic demand and fairness. This paper proposes a novel, distributed as well as real-time time slot allocation scheme that adapts to the varying topology of the network and traffic demands, and at the same time decreases the control overhead of the algorithm. In such a scheme, each node will only have to collect the traffic demands from all transmitting nodes instead of from the whole network; in addition an innovative traffic demand geometric reduction algorithm is employed to guarantee the throughput as well as fairness of the network. Simulation results indicate that the proposed scheme can ensure both fairness and throughput according to each node's traffic demand in MANET.

articleTitle: Predicting Power Consumption Anomaly Using Statistical and Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power has become an essential element of daily life in the modern world. At the same time, over usage of electricity may lead to excessive power consumption, causing the device to short circuit or be on fire. Therefore, it is crucial to monitor and forecast the anomalies in power consumption to avoid any tragedy. In this paper, the authors proposed a method of predicting anomalies in power consumption. The proposed method uses a statistical approach in labeling; the labeled power consumption data are then used to form the data instances. Later, supervised machine learning classification techniques, namely Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, are implemented on the data instances to predict the power consumption anomalies. The experimental results demonstrate that the precision, recall, and F1 score are achieving better results when the training dataset is larger. Besides that, the results show that the techniques used to handle the imbalanced data will affect the performance of models.

articleTitle: Optimal design of high-efficiency series resonant capacitor charging power supply
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The series resonant capacitor charging power supply is the most important part of the pulse plasma thruster, so research work is carried out for its development process and parameter optimization design. Compared with previous related studies, this article clearly analyzes and points out the key parameters that affect the charging speed and efficiency of the capacitor, namely the switching frequency and driving pulse width, and gives their optimal solution instead of the previous range. Therefore, the research has certain reference value for optimizing the design of the series resonant capacitor charging power supply, improving the performance of the power supply, and selecting the device reasonably.

articleTitle: Multi-region Power Flow Stability Control Model Considering New Energy Active Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of new energy into the grid and the increasing proportion of power supply, the interconnected grid framework can promote the complementation and absorption of new energy sources on a larger scale. However, the uncertainty of new energy output is for grid power balance or regional discontinuity. Power regulation brings tremendous pressure. In this paper, a stable control model of the external characteristics of the tidal current in a single sub-area in a multi-area is established in this paper, and a stable control target among multiple areas is obtained, and a robust problem is finally formed. Then, a coordinated evolutionary algorithm based on relaxation method is introduced to solve robust optimization to reduce the impact of new energy output fluctuations. The proposed coordinated evolutionary algorithm has strong adaptability to general robust problems, even if the sub-problems are nonlinear problems. The analysis of an example based on IEEE14 shows that the proposed co-evolutionary algorithm has a better solution efficiency when dealing with optimization problems whose sub-problems are linear.

articleTitle: Research on traffic sign detection method based on multi-scale feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: SSD algorithm, as one of the mainstream detection frameworks, is a one-stage algorithm to obtain the target category and location by direct regression, which can act on the output feature map of the convolutional network for prediction and complete the target localization and classification at one time, but it is poorly applied in practical problems due to low accuracy of small target detection, and low accuracy of traffic sign recognition and weak generalization ability. There are countless types of traffic signs, and there are more than one hundred kinds of traffic signs in China, which can be divided into warning signs with black borders on yellow background, prohibition signs with red circles on white background, and instruction signs with white characters on blue background by category, and the shapes are mainly triangular, circular and rectangular. By loading the pre-trained model to initialize the network model parameters and adjusting the parameters in the aspect ratio set to reduce the number of default boxes generated, the training of the network model and the convergence speed are improved. Finally, after experimental comparison and analysis, the feasibility of the improved algorithm proposed in this paper is proved.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Rehabilitation System Design Based on Motor Imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To improve the rehabilitation efficacy for stroke patient, a brain-computer interface (BCI) rehabilitation system based on motor imagery (MI) is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are preprocessed by Laplacian spatial filter and Butterworth band pass filter with cutoff frequency of 8Hz~24Hz to enhance the interesting components of the EEG signals. Then, the logarithmic band power (LBP) features are extracted and the motion intentions classification model is established based on linear discriminant analysis (LDA) algorithm. Finally, the correct motion intentions recognition results are converted to executive command of our designed rehabilitation hand. The motion imagery dataset from OpenVibe is used to validate our system. Results show that the rehabilitation hand is driven to effectively actuate the hand to perform the pre-set actions according to the MI recognition results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Visual Tracking via Temporal-Spatial Regularized Multi-Patches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Recently, the research in the field of object tracking has made great progress, and exploiting the combination of correlation filtering method and other ones to improve tracking accuracy effectively has attracted the attention of many researchers. Most methods based on correlation filter introduce redundant background information when searching for the target position in the extracted search box. At the same time, unnecessary boundary effects are introduced due to cyclic shift. Therefore, in this study, initializing multiple particle patches near the real target under the framework of particle filtering is proposed, and a template-based spatio-temporal regularized correlation filter tracking algorithm is used to track reliable patches during the tracking process, simultaneously keeping the number of particle patches at a relatively sufficient level to focus on more real target information without losing important background information. In addition, the scale variation of final target per frame is adaptively estimated by the changes of reliable patches. Extensive comparative experiments conducted on popular general datasets demonstrate a relatively competitive performance on accuracy with some selected state-of-the-art trackers in the past few decades.

articleTitle: Compatibility analysis of UAS terrestrial CNPC links and MLS in the 5030–5091 MHz band
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) revised the 5030–5150 MHz frequency band allocation in the 2012 World Radiocommunication Conference (WRC-12), an aeronautical mobile (R) service have added sharing frequency with aeronautical mobile-satellite (R) service and aeronautical radionavigation service to support the safe operation of unmanned aircraft communication system. Any new service proposed for this band must be compatible with the existing Microwave Landing System (MLS) that has a spectral allocation in the band. The objective of this paper is to suggest the frequency planning through analysis potential new allocations in which the UAS terrestrial CNPC links can operate reliably without harmful interference to or from the incumbent services and systems.

articleTitle: Research on Fusion and Location Method of Indoor Targeted Spraying Robots Based on UWB\IMU
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For targeted spraying equipment in greenhouse environments, due to the poor positioning signal of global navigation satellite system (GNSS), automatic mobile operation cannot be realized. In this study, a method based on ultrawide band (UWB) and inertial measurement units is proposed. The integrated positioning method of inertial measurement unit (IMU) achieves positioning accuracy at the centimeter level in the visual range. The system adopts a loose coupling mode and extended Kalman filter according to the three-axis attitude angular velocity and acceleration information from the IMU, and the positioning coordinates from the UWB base station (EKF) correct the UWB error in real time and calculate the accurate position, speed and attitude information of the robot. The test results show that when the robot travels in a preset straight line at a speed of 1 m/s, the UWB/IMU fusion navigation positioning error is less than 2 cm, which significantly improves the navigation accuracy and provides a basis for the realization of automatic operation of the targeted spraying robot.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cancellation Method of Pseudo Code Phase Modulation Fuze Leakage Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The leakage noise of the pseudo-code phase modulation fuze system is the noise interference caused by the insufficient isolation of the radio frequency part. Since the leakage signal is similar to the echo signal waveform, it will affect the output of the correlator and lead to misjudgment of the fuze. In this paper, the pseudo-code phase modulation fuze's emission leakage signal is modeled, and its characteristics are analyzed, and an adaptive noise cancellation method for the pseudo-code phase modulation leakage signal is proposed. The algorithm simulation shows that the noise filtering effect is good. Pseudo-code phase modulation fuze prototype is used to actually test the algorithm. The algorithm can increase the correlation peak value of the actual target signal and reduce the influence of leakage noise and natural noise floor.

articleTitle: Optical fiber sensing technology based on Rayleigh backscattering curve
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Power cable plays an important role in power grid, and the safety of cable operation affects the stability of all kinds of power grid services. By analyzing the characteristics of the optical cable, optical fiber sensing technology calculate the optical cable environment and provide warning of possible extreme weather to ensure the safety of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on t- Distribution Sailfish Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the field of machine learning (ML), locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm, as a nonlinear dimensionality reduction method of manifold learning, has become an indispensable tool, is very effective in handling high-dimensional data arrays. The core idea of LLE algorithm is to find the proper mapping of data points from high-dimensional space to low-dimensional space, with their algebraic topology unchanged. LLE is usually transformed into two optimization problems, constrained optimization and unconstrained optimization, which are usually solved by gradient descent (GD) method or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method. However, gradient dependent methods often fall into the trap of local minimum and cannot find the global optimal solution. Based on the idea of employing swarm intelligence algorithm, in this paper, a t-distribution sailfish optimization algorithm has been introduced to overcome the problem of global optimization in the original LLE method. Via numerical experiment, it has been proved that the proposed sailfish optimization algorithm can improve the robustness and the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Metadata management technology of Navigation and Location Service based on Atlas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For navigation and location services with a large amount of data and data isomerism, space-time characteristics, characteristics of dynamic change, first put forward by unified service metadata standard navigation and position, navigation and location service data information heterogeneity, secondly build navigation and location services under the standard database, based on the Atlas metadata management tools, So as to realize the effective overall management of navigation and location service metadata, efficient query and retrieval, and improve the efficiency of data sharing and application.

articleTitle: Machine learning-based quality evaluation of 5G wireless network in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Effective network quality level evaluation can provide a reliable reference for the link selection of business transmission. The network quality level evaluation based on specific businesses can provide more accurate network quality level references for different services. To this end, this paper proposes a machine learning-based network quality evaluation model. The model first discriminates the type of business by a random forest algorithm based on the network needs of the business. Then, the temporal properties and nonlinearity of the evaluation index data were fitted by LSTM, using multi-head attention (MA) to learn and obtain the evaluation index weights under different businesses, so that the network quality rating evaluation results under the corresponding business are obtained. In this paper, the network quality level evaluation under the media services and precision control services in the smart grid is discussed, and the proposed model is compared with the Support Vector Machine model (SVM) and Recurrent Neural Network-Multi-head Attention (RNN-MA) model. The experimental results show that the proposed LSTM-MA model has the best prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Global Dynamic Path Planning Algorithm Based on Harmony Search Algorithm and Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For public places with complex environment and many dynamic obstacles, a dynamic path planning method combining global and local planning is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model is established, and solved by harmony search algorithm. Secondly, optimization is performed by opposition-based learning and optimal learning, and the extraction rate of the harmony memory is dynamically adjusted. Finally, by combining the artificial potential field method and adding local target points, a global dynamic path planning algorithm considering the global path optimization and real-time obstacle avoidance performance is constructed. Experiments show that the algorithm has more advantages in path length and smoothness, and can avoid dynamic obstacles.

articleTitle: Research on Bolt Visual Recognition of High Voltage Transmission Line Shockproof Hammer Resetting Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: An important part of the operation of shockproof hammer resetting robot on transmission lines is the identification of shockproof hammer bolt and the extraction of bolt center point. In view of the special complexity of the working environment of shockproof hammer resetting robot, this paper proposes an algorithm based on YOLOv5 to identify the shockproof hammer bolt on transmission lines. Thus, the recognition accuracy can be further improved. In addition, according to the bolt edge image is hexagon, use improved Hough algorithm to extract bolt center, according to the method proposed in this paper, the field verification is carried out on the shockproof hammer resetting robot. Results show that the proposed method can effectively realize the search, location and recognition of shockproof hammer bolt. Thus, the working efficiency of the robot is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Channel Estimation Algorithm Based on OTFS System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The wireless communication system under the high-speed mobile environment is still a research hotspot at present. The wireless communication channel inevitably produces multipath effects and Doppler effects in the high-speed mobile environment, which seriously affects the channel estimation performance. This paper is based on Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) technology, by inserting pilots in the time domain, using an improved Basis Expansion Model (BEM) combined with an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) channel estimation method to reduce the complexity while tracking the dynamic changes of the channel, compared to the improved channel, The estimation method is applied to the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system to improve the Symbol Error Rate (SER) performance and the Normalized Mean Square Error (NMSE) performance.

articleTitle: Physical Design and optimization method of a feedthrough signal line based on low-power integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of the contradiction between the optimization of chip area and the closure of signal timing in the physical design of low-power Integrated Circuit, by planning the input and output signals and calculating the resource of routing channel, as well as a deep understanding of the global macro unit of the chip, a new way to design and implement the signal line is proposed, which not only satisfies the demand of the chip's compressed area cost, but also satisfies the timing optimization of the key input and output signals, it lays a solid foundation for further improving the performance of the chip in the later period.

articleTitle: Multi-camera System Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the problem of multi-camera image depth measurement, a multi-camera depth estimation system based on semantic segmentation is proposed in this paper. The system first obtains the depth map between neighboring cameras by multi-camera calibration and stereo matching, then stitches multi-camera images by feature extraction and matching, then uses semantic segmentation network to identify and segment objects, and establishes an object height library, and finally estimates the object distance in the non-overlapping region based on the similar triangle principle and the object height library. The object depth obtained by the method of this paper has certain reference value and basically meets the distance measurement requirements of SLAM.

articleTitle: Cross-GAN: Unsupervised Image-to-Image Translation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, unsupervised image-to-image translation is a topic in computer graphics. This paper proposes a new architecture to translate the image through the idea of sharing and decoupling, termed as Cross-GAN, which can better extract the style in the process of translation, and does not change the original outline and background. We improve the cycle consistency loss and reconstruction loss for the unique properties of the model to make the image more realistic.
